* Education / Training

Freshers with strong communication and the right attitude are welcome.

**Location:** Gurugram

**Future Opportunity:** Potential conversion to Full\-Time Employee after successful completion of the internship

This is **not a remote internship**.

We are currently running a pilot project, so the initial compensation will be in the form of a **stipend / entry\-level salary**.

However, the role offers:

* Direct exposure to recruitment and HR operations
* Opportunity to conduct communication and training sessions

Job Description – Corporate Recruiter

**Company:** Turabit Solutions Pvt. Ltd.

**About Turabit Solutions**

Turabit Solutions is a technology\-driven organization focused on delivering innovative technology and AI\-enabled solutions. We are looking for a dedicated and career\-oriented **Corporate Recruiter** who can take ownership of the recruitment process and contribute to building a strong and high\-performing organization.

This role is ideal for an HR professional who has **at least 1 year of experience in US IT Services, US IT Staffing, or a similar technology\-driven environment** and is looking to build a long\-term career in Corporate HR and Talent Acquisition.

**Position Overview**

The Corporate Recruiter will be responsible for managing and executing the **end\-to\-end recruitment process** for corporate and technology positions. The person should have a strong understanding of recruitment fundamentals, excellent follow\-up and coordination skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work with a sense of urgency.

We are looking for someone who is **dedicated, disciplined, time\-bound, proactive and willing to go the extra mile** to achieve hiring objectives.

The candidate should also be comfortable using **AI tools and modern recruitment technologies** to improve sourcing, screening, communication, productivity, and overall recruitment efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities**  
1\. End\-to\-End Recruitment

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle from understanding hiring requirements to candidate onboarding.
* Work closely with hiring managers and department heads to understand manpower requirements and job specifications.
* Prepare and publish accurate job descriptions on appropriate job portals and professional networks.
* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, databases, social media, and other relevant channels.
* Screen resumes and conduct initial candidate assessments.
* Conduct preliminary HR interviews and evaluate candidates based on skills, experience, communication, attitude, and organizational fit.
* Coordinate technical and managerial interview rounds with relevant stakeholders.
* Maintain regular communication and follow\-up with candidates throughout the hiring process.
* Manage offer discussions, salary negotiations, documentation, and joining formalities.
* Ensure a smooth candidate experience from first contact through onboarding.

2\. US IT Staffing / Technology Recruitment Understanding

* Leverage previous exposure to **US IT Services / US IT Staffing** to understand technology roles, candidate profiles, and recruitment terminology.
* Understand common technology skill sets and be able to identify relevant candidates from resumes.
* Develop and maintain a strong candidate pipeline for recurring and critical positions.
* Build relationships with potential candidates for future hiring requirements.

3\. Corporate HR \& Recruitment Process

* Maintain proper recruitment records, trackers, interview schedules, candidate status, and hiring reports.
* Ensure recruitment activities are completed within defined timelines.
* Follow established HR policies, recruitment SOPs, and approval processes.
* Maintain confidentiality of candidate and employee information.
* Coordinate with HR and management for joining, documentation, background verification, and onboarding activities.
* Support other HR initiatives as required.

4\. AI \& Recruitment Technology

* Use **AI tools and recruitment technologies** to work smarter, faster, and more efficiently.
* Explore practical applications of AI for:
* Resume screening and shortlisting
* Candidate sourcing
* Job description creation and optimization
* Interview question generation
* Candidate communication
* Recruitment reporting and analysis
* Recruitment documentation
* Market and talent research
* Continuously identify ways to improve recruitment productivity through automation, AI, and digital tools.
* Stay updated with emerging AI\-based HR and recruitment technologies.

Key Skills \& Competencies

The ideal candidate should demonstrate:

* Strong understanding of **core recruitment and HR processes**.
* Minimum **1 year of experience in US IT Services, US IT Staffing, IT recruitment, or a similar technology environment**.
* Excellent sourcing and candidate screening skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good understanding of recruitment lifecycle and interview coordination.
* Strong follow\-up and candidate relationship management skills.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple vacancies and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Professional discipline and a positive attitude.
* Ability to work within deadlines and meet recruitment targets.
* Proactive approach with a willingness to **go the extra mile** when required.
* Ability and willingness to learn new technologies and recruitment tools.
* Basic understanding or hands\-on exposure to **AI tools for recruitment** will be an advantage.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a professional who:

* Is **serious about building a long\-term career in Corporate HR and Talent Acquisition**.
* Takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions.
* Is highly **dedicated, detail\-oriented, disciplined, and time\-bound**.
* Understands that recruitment requires consistent follow\-up, urgency, and persistence.
* Can work independently while collaborating effectively with managers and teams.
* Is willing to learn, adapt, and continuously improve.
* Has a **“can\-do” attitude** and is willing to go beyond routine responsibilities to achieve hiring objectives.
* Wants to develop into a strong HR professional and eventually take on broader HR responsibilities.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in HR, Business Administration, Management, or a related field.
* MBA/PGDM in HR will be an advantage.
* 1\+ year of relevant recruitment experience.
* Prior experience with **US IT Staffing / US IT Services / Technology recruitment** is preferred.
* Experience using job portals such as Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, or similar platforms.
* Exposure to ATS/HRMS/recruitment tracking systems is an advantage.
* Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT or other AI\-based recruitment/productivity tools is preferred.

Career Growth

This position is intended for a candidate who wants to build a **long\-term career in Corporate HR**.

Based on performance, capability, and demonstrated ownership, the role can provide opportunities to grow into areas such as:

**Corporate Recruiter → Senior Corporate Recruiter → Talent Acquisition Specialist / Lead → HR Generalist / HRBP / Talent Acquisition Manager**

title: Head of Talent Acquisition
description:
**Head of Talent Acquisition**

**Invisia Software Pvt. Ltd. \| Bengaluru, Kalyan Nagar \| Full\-time**

**Function:** People \& Culture  
**Location:** Bengaluru, Kalyan Nagar, On\-site  
**Experience:** 10–15 years  
**Reporting To:** CHRO / Executive Leadership  
**Team:** 2–4 TA professionals initially  
**Industry Preference:** SaaS / Product Technology

**About Invisia Software**

Invisia Software is a growing product technology company headquartered in Bengaluru. As the organization scales its product, technology and business functions, we are strengthening our Talent Acquisition function to build a predictable, high\-quality and scalable hiring capability.

**Role Overview**

The Head of Talent Acquisition will own the complete Talent Acquisition function, from workforce and hiring planning through recruitment strategy, team management, sourcing, execution, funnel performance and hiring outcomes.

This is a hands\-on functional leadership role. The successful candidate will partner with leadership and functional heads to translate business and workforce requirements into executable hiring plans, establish TA goals and processes, build and manage the TA team, personally support critical hiring, and ensure recruitment performance meets agreed quality, timeline and cost expectations.

The role is expected to establish a TA function that operates with clear ownership, measurable performance, reliable forecasting and limited dependency on continuous senior leadership intervention.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Workforce and Hiring Planning**

* Partner with leadership, HR and functional heads to translate annual and quarterly business plans into workforce and hiring requirements.
* Validate requirements based on business priority, role necessity, skill availability, compensation and market conditions.
* Develop quarterly and monthly hiring plans with priorities, timelines, recruiter capacity, sourcing approach, dependencies and risks.
* Forecast TA capacity required to deliver approved hiring plans.
* Maintain forward\-looking talent pipelines for anticipated and difficult\-to\-fill requirements.
* Provide realistic hiring forecasts and proactively escalate risks with corrective actions.

**TA Strategy and Functional Ownership**

* Own the Talent Acquisition strategy, operating model and performance of the function.
* Translate organizational hiring goals into departmental goals and individual recruiter KRAs/KPIs.
* Establish recruitment processes, playbooks, SLAs, interview frameworks and governance.
* Build an appropriate TA team structure and develop internal recruitment capability.
* Evaluate TA tools, sourcing channels, agencies and external partners based on performance and business requirements.
* Continuously identify and resolve structural recruitment issues.

**Hiring Delivery**

* Own delivery of the approved hiring plan across Technology, Product, Design, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Operations, Finance, HR and leadership positions.
* Personally lead or support critical, niche, senior and difficult\-to\-fill positions.
* Maintain strong hands\-on capability in sourcing, talent mapping, screening, assessment, candidate engagement and offer negotiation.
* Ensure recruitment delivery meets agreed quality, timeline and cost expectations.
* Build proactive pipelines for recurring and strategically important talent requirements.

**TA Team Leadership and Performance**

* Lead, coach and develop the TA team.
* Allocate requisitions based on priority, complexity, capacity and recruiter capability.
* Establish individual and team goals, KPIs and performance expectations.
* Conduct structured weekly pipeline and performance reviews.
* Identify capability and performance gaps and implement appropriate development or corrective actions.
* Build team capability to reduce dependency on individual recruiters or external agencies.

**Recruitment Funnel Management**

* Own performance across the complete recruitment funnel from sourcing through joining.
* Establish appropriate funnel benchmarks by role category.
* Monitor conversion, aging, candidate withdrawals, interview no\-shows, offer declines and joining drop\-offs.
* Diagnose whether underperformance originates from sourcing, screening, requirement calibration, assessments, interviewer quality, compensation, candidate engagement or other factors.
* Implement corrective actions when funnel performance falls below expectations.
* Prevent repeated poor\-quality submissions from consuming unnecessary hiring\-manager and leadership bandwidth.

**Hiring Manager Governance**

* Establish structured requisition intake and role\-calibration processes.
* Ensure role requirements, competencies, assessment methods, compensation and timelines are aligned before sourcing begins.
* Establish appropriate SLAs for profile review, interviews, feedback and hiring decisions.
* Use market evidence and recruitment data to challenge unrealistic or inconsistent requirements.
* Conduct recalibration where repeated candidate rejection indicates misalignment.
* Support hiring managers in structured interviewing and objective candidate evaluation.

**Analytics, Forecasting and Reporting**

* Establish and maintain TA dashboards covering hiring plan versus actual, requisition aging, forecasted closures, funnel conversions, offer acceptance, offer\-to\-join, source effectiveness, recruiter productivity, agency performance and critical hiring risks.
* Provide leadership with clear weekly and monthly hiring\-health reporting.
* Distinguish positions that are on track, at risk or critical and provide corrective actions and expected resolution timelines.
* Maintain ATS discipline and ensure reliable recruitment data and reporting.

**Vendor and Agency Management**

* Determine where external recruitment support is appropriate.
* Manage recruitment agencies, executive search firms and specialist sourcing partners.
* Establish candidate\-quality expectations, SLAs and commercial terms.
* Track vendor performance based on quality, conversion, closures, TAT and cost.
* Optimize agency usage and reduce unnecessary external dependency.

**Employer Branding and Talent Market**

* Own TA requirements and strategy relating to employer positioning and candidate experience.
* Partner with HR, Marketing and Creative on careers content, employee stories and recruitment campaigns.
* Develop employee referral and relevant talent\-community initiatives.
* Monitor candidate experience and recruitment\-related employer reputation.
* Represent the organization at relevant hiring and talent events where appropriate.

**Role Boundaries**

The Head of Talent Acquisition is not the primary owner of:

* HR operations, payroll or general HR administration.
* Employee relations or organization\-wide performance management.
* Learning and Development or Compensation and Benefits.
* Marketing or employer\-brand content production.
* Routine onboarding administration following recruitment handover.
* Final technical evaluation of specialist candidates.
* Business headcount decisions or justification of workforce requirements on behalf of functional leaders.

Functional leaders remain accountable for identifying and justifying business capability and headcount requirements. The Head of TA is responsible for validating, translating and executing approved workforce requirements through an effective recruitment strategy.

**First 90 Days: Expected Outcomes**

**First 30 Days**

* Complete current\-state assessment of TA processes, people, tools and vendors.
* Validate open requisitions, priorities and hiring requirements with functional heads.
* Establish baseline hiring plan and recruitment funnel metrics.
* Assess recruiter capacity and capability.
* Review ATS discipline, agency performance and existing sourcing channels.
* Identify critical hiring risks and implement immediate interventions.
* Present recommended TA operating model and priority improvement plan.

**Days 31–60**

* Implement quarterly/monthly hiring plan and requisition prioritization.
* Establish recruiter allocation and capacity planning.
* Cascade TA goals into individual recruiter KRAs/KPIs.
* Establish weekly TA operating and performance reviews.
* Implement hiring\-manager intake, calibration and SLA processes.
* Operationalize TA dashboard and hiring forecasts.
* Implement agency/vendor scorecards.
* Establish structured interview and evaluation frameworks.
* Begin proactive talent mapping for critical positions.

**Days 61–90**

* Establish reliable hiring plan versus actual reporting and monthly closure forecasting.
* Demonstrate measurable recruiter productivity and accountability.
* Establish visibility and intervention mechanisms for critical\-role pipelines.
* Demonstrate active management of recruitment funnel bottlenecks.
* Establish measurable hiring\-manager and agency performance.
* Improve ATS and recruitment\-data discipline.
* Present TA team capacity and capability recommendations.
* Present a six\-month TA improvement and hiring roadmap.

**Key Result Areas**

**KRA \- Weight**

Workforce and Hiring Planning \-15%

Hiring Delivery and Critical Role Closure \- 25%

TA Team Performance and Capability \- 15%

Sourcing Strategy and Pipeline Health \- 10%

Recruitment Funnel Performance \- 15%

Hiring Manager Governance \- 10%

Analytics, Forecasting and Process Governance \- 5%

Vendor, Employer Brand and Talent Ecosystem \- 5%

**Total \- 100%**

**Experience and Qualifications**

* 10–15 years of Talent Acquisition experience, preferably with significant exposure to SaaS, product or technology organizations.
* Minimum 4–5 years of experience directly managing TA professionals.
* Demonstrated experience owning a TA function or substantial recruitment portfolio.
* Proven ability to translate workforce requirements into structured hiring plans and execution.
* Strong experience establishing recruiter goals, KPIs, processes and operating cadences.
* Proven track record of technology, product and business\-function recruitment.
* Strong hands\-on sourcing, talent mapping and passive candidate engagement capability.
* Experience personally closing difficult mid\-to\-senior and leadership positions.
* Demonstrated recruitment funnel analysis, hiring forecasting and problem\-solving capability.
* Experience building or significantly improving recruitment processes and assessment frameworks.
* Strong hiring\-manager and senior stakeholder management.
* Experience managing recruitment agencies and external search partners.
* Strong understanding of ATS, recruitment analytics and data\-driven TA management.

**Preferred:** Executive search, startup/scale\-up, employer branding, high\-volume recruitment or experience building a TA function from an early or less mature stage.

**Overall Accountability**

The Head of Talent Acquisition is accountable for delivering the approved workforce hiring plan within agreed quality, timeline and cost parameters while building a capable TA team, maintaining healthy recruitment funnels and providing leadership with reliable hiring forecasts and clear accountability.

description:
**Location:**

Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
**Job ID:**

R0138436
**Date Posted:**

2026\-09\-08
**Company Name:**

HITACHI ENERGY TECHNOLOGY SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED
**Profession (Job Category):**

Human Resources

Full time

No
**Job Description:**

**The Opportunity**

At Hitachi Energy, we are committed to creating a sustainable energy future through innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence. We are looking for a Compensation \& Benefits Analyst to join our Global HR Services team and play a critical role in delivering compensation and benefits support across multiple geographies.


In this role, you will partner with HR teams, business leaders, employees, and external vendors to ensure the efficient administration of compensation programs and employee benefits. You will be responsible for supporting key annual compensation processes, maintaining data accuracy within Workday, providing insightful reporting and analytics, and ensuring a high level of service delivery to stakeholders worldwide.


This position offers an excellent opportunity to gain global exposure while working on complex compensation programs, incentive plans, salary reviews, and benefits administration. You will collaborate with colleagues across regions, contribute to process improvements, and help drive operational excellence within a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.


As part of a high\-performing HR Services organization, you will leverage analytical thinking, digital tools, and process expertise to enhance employee experience, ensure compliance, and support strategic business objectives. If you are detail\-oriented, customer\-focused, and passionate about compensation and benefits, this role provides an exciting platform for professional growth and impact.


**How You'll Make an Impact**

* Support the execution of global compensation processes, including Annual Salary Reviews (ASR), Short\-Term Incentive (STI) programs, Long\-Term Incentive (LTI) programs, scorecards, and other compensation initiatives, ensuring accuracy and timely delivery.
* Administer compensation programs across multiple countries and regulatory environments while maintaining compliance with company policies and local requirements.
* Maintain, validate, and monitor compensation\-related employee data in Workday, ensuring data integrity and accuracy across HR systems.
* Generate standard and ad hoc compensation reports, analytics, and insights to support global and regional stakeholders in decision\-making.
* Coordinate and support regional and global employee benefits programs, including vendor management and service delivery activities.
* Manage end\-to\-end compensation transactions, including data validation, calculations, approvals, and payout readiness through established workflows and systems such as ServiceNow.
* Ensure delivery of compensation services in accordance with defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs), maintaining high standards of quality, turnaround time, and customer satisfaction.
* Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Work Instructions (WIs) to ensure process consistency and compliance.
* Identify process improvement opportunities, perform root cause analysis, and contribute to initiatives that enhance operational efficiency and service excellence.
* Collaborate effectively with cross\-functional and global teams while leveraging digital and analytical tools to improve productivity and decision\-making.

**Your Background**

* Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related discipline.
* 3 to 5 years of experience in HR Shared Services, Compensation Operations, or Compensation \& Benefits Administration within a global organization.
* Hands\-on experience supporting compensation programs, including Annual Salary Reviews (ASR), Short\-Term Incentives (STI), Long\-Term Incentives (LTI), salary administration, and compensation reporting.
* Experience working with HR systems, preferably Workday, including compensation data management, reporting, and process administration.
* Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Microsoft Excel and working knowledge of PowerPoint, Power BI, and other digital reporting tools.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively manage stakeholders across different functions and geographies.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment.
* Experience supporting employee benefits administration and vendor coordination is preferred.

**More About Us**

At Hitachi Energy, we are advancing the world's energy system to be more sustainable, flexible, and secure. We foster an inclusive and collaborative culture where diverse perspectives are valued, innovation is encouraged, and continuous learning is supported.


Joining our team means working alongside talented professionals across the globe while contributing to meaningful work that supports employees and business success. We offer opportunities for career growth, global exposure, and professional development in an environment built on integrity, safety, and respect.


**Demonstrates effective use of AI and digital tools to enhance problem\-solving, decision\-making, and productivity, while applying sound judgment, ensuring accuracy and compliance, and maintaining accountability for outcomes.**

**Qualified individuals with a disability may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Hitachi Energy career site as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by completing a** **general inquiry form** **on our website. Please include your contact information and specific details about your required accommodation to support you during the job application process.**

  

**This is solely for job seekers with disabilities requiring accessibility assistance or an accommodation in the job application process. Messages left for other purposes will not receive a response.**

  

**Use of Al and automated tools in recruitment**

**As part of our recruitment process, Hitachi Energy uses digital and automated tools, including Al\-supported solutions, to assist with activities such as application screening, job matching, and interview scheduling. These tools are designed to support our recruiters and do not replace human decision\-making. Candidate data is processed in accordance with applicable data protection and employment laws as well as** **Hitachi's Global Data Privacy Notice.**  

  

**Background Screening and Security Checks**

**As part of the hiring process, Hitachi Energy conducts pre\-employment background checks that may include verification of employment history, education, criminal records, and other relevant information, in accordance with applicable laws.**

**For certain roles—particularly those involving access to sensitive information, financial responsibilities, client data, regulated environments, or security\-sensitive functions—additional or more comprehensive background or security screenings may be required. **The scope and depth of any background or security review will be determined based on the nature of the role and business necessity, and will always be conducted in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Candidates will be notified and, where required, asked to provide consent prior to the initiation of any such checks.**

description:
**Customer Support Intern**

**Location:** Pune**Employment Type:** Internship**Experience:** Fresher / 0–1 year**Company:** Celoxis

**About Celoxis**

Celoxis is a global Project Portfolio Management (PPM) platform used by organizations to plan projects, manage resources, track financials, collaborate, and make better business decisions.

We are looking for curious, customer\-focused graduates who enjoy solving problems and want to build a career in SaaS, customer support, and technology.

**Role Overview**

As a **Customer Support Intern**, you will be part of the team responsible for helping Celoxis customers successfully use and troubleshoot the product.

This is not just a ticket\-handling role. You will learn how a B2B SaaS product works, understand real customer business problems, investigate technical issues, and communicate solutions clearly.

You will work closely with Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and other internal teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Respond to customer questions through support tickets, email, chat, and calls.
* Understand customer issues and identify the actual problem before suggesting a solution.
* Learn the Celoxis product in depth, including projects, tasks, resources, timesheets, reports, workflows, and administration.
* Reproduce customer\-reported issues and document clear reproduction steps.
* Troubleshoot functional and basic technical issues using application settings, logs, browser developer tools, APIs, and other available diagnostic information.
* Guide customers through product configuration and recommended approaches.
* Escalate product defects and complex technical issues with complete supporting information.
* Work with Product and Engineering teams to follow issues through to resolution.
* Keep customers updated on the progress of their queries.
* Create and improve internal troubleshooting documentation and knowledge\-base content.
* Identify recurring customer problems and share feedback that can help improve the product and customer experience.
* Participate in product testing and validation of fixes or new releases when required.

**What We Are Looking For**

We care more about your ability to **learn, think, communicate, and solve problems** than prior work experience.

You should have:

* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, BCA, BSc Computer Science, or a related field.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Good analytical and logical reasoning skills.
* Curiosity to understand how software works instead of simply following predefined steps.
* Ability to break a problem into smaller parts and troubleshoot systematically.
* Patience and professionalism while communicating with customers.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and business concepts.
* Good attention to detail and documentation skills.
* Ability to take ownership of a problem and follow it through to resolution.

**Good to Have**

Prior knowledge is not mandatory, but exposure to any of the following will be helpful:

* SQL and relational databases
* REST APIs, JSON, HTTP, and web applications
* Browser Developer Tools
* Basic networking concepts
* Linux / Windows command line
* Java or general programming concepts
* SaaS applications
* Project management concepts
* Tools such as Postman, Zendesk, Jira, or similar platforms

**What You Will Learn**

During the internship, you will gain hands\-on exposure to:

* Enterprise SaaS customer support
* Project and Portfolio Management concepts
* Technical troubleshooting
* APIs and integrations
* Database and application fundamentals
* Customer communication and expectation management
* Product testing and defect reporting
* Working with Product and Engineering teams
* Handling real\-world enterprise customer scenarios

**What Success Looks Like**

A successful Customer Support Intern at Celoxis will gradually be able to:

* Understand customer requirements without relying heavily on others.
* Troubleshoot issues methodically.
* Provide accurate and easy\-to\-understand responses.
* Distinguish between configuration issues, product limitations, and potential defects.
* Write high\-quality escalation notes that help Engineering investigate quickly.
* Take ownership of customer queries from initial investigation through resolution.
* Build strong product knowledge and become a dependable member of the Customer Support team.

**Who Would Enjoy This Role?**

You may be a strong fit if you enjoy questions such as:

**“Why is this happening?”**

**“Can I reproduce this?”**

**“What changed?”**

**“Is this configuration, expected behaviour, or a bug?”**

**“How can I explain the solution clearly to the customer?”**

If you enjoy solving puzzles, learning software, interacting with people, and understanding both the technical and business side of a problem, this role can be a strong starting point for your career in SaaS.

* Deliver and continuously improve organizational orientation, foundational Finance Operations learning and new\-hire assimilation activities.
* Coordinate with SDLs, GPOs, tower leaders, managers, subject\-matter experts, HR and global stakeholders to provide a consistent and relevant experience.
* Act as an accessible point of contact for new hires during onboarding and early assimilation, directing questions and escalating concerns to the appropriate owner.
* Coordinate transportation\-account creation and updates as part of onboarding, working with Transport, Facilities, vendors or administrative teams and maintaining accurate status tracking.
* Maintain onboarding trackers, attendance, completion records, assessment outcomes, stakeholder inputs and participant feedback during Onboarding.
* Develop reusable, blended and self\-paced assets that improve continuity and reduce dependency on individual facilitators.

**2\. Global hub integration, Bogotá Specific**

* Support the integration of the Bogotá hub into the broader Finance Operations learning and competency ecosystem, ensuring alignment with global standards while recognizing local needs.
* Partner with Bogotá leaders, trainers, subject\-matter experts and HR contacts to understand capability priorities, onboarding requirements, stakeholder expectations and cultural or language considerations.
* Coordinate cross\-hub learning calendars, knowledge\-sharing sessions, facilitator support and reusable assets across Pune, Bogotá and other Finance centres.
* Promote consistency in foundational learning, competency expectations and employee experience while allowing appropriate local adaptation.
* Track hub\-integration actions, dependencies, risks and feedback, and provide clear progress updates to Competency and Finance leadership.
* Enable transfer of good practices between hubs and maintain shared documentation so learning solutions can be reused and scaled globally.

**3\. Learning needs analysis and solution design**

* Construct structured discussions with leaders, managers and process owners to identify learning needs, capability gaps and desired business outcomes.
* Design and deliver classroom, virtual, self\-paced, e\-learning and micro\-learning solutions.
* Create/convert existing learning content such as DTP’s into e\-learnings.
* Translate complex Finance, organizational and behavioral concepts into clear and practical learning experiences.
* Create and maintain courses, facilitator guides, participant materials, videos, quizzes, scenarios, simulations, checklists, job aids, playbooks and toolkits.
* Develop rapid learning solutions such as communication templates and quick\-reference guides when the business requires timely support.
* Support Finance transformation, transition and knowledge\-transfer initiatives from a learning and capability perspective.

**4\. Competency framework and extended capability requirements**

* Partner with Finance leaders, process owners and HR to define and maintain relevant competency expectations for Finance Operations roles and career stages.
* Help translate role requirements into clear knowledge, skill and behavioural competency statements that can guide learning, development and career conversations.
* Support competency mapping, gap identification and prioritization across towers, teams, locations and employee segments.
* Connect identified competency gaps to appropriate curriculum, development pathways, learning assets, assessments or manager\-led interventions.
* Maintain competency\-related documentation, learning matrices and supporting resources, ensuring they remain current as roles, processes and technologies evolve.
* Provide data and qualitative insights on recurring capability needs to inform extended Competency priorities and future learning investments.
* Support communication and adoption of the competency framework so employees and managers understand how it can be used for development.

**5\. My Academy and digital learning enablement**

* Use My Academy as a central channel to support the extended learning and competency needs of Finance Operations.
* Coordinate the creation, curation, publication and maintenance of Finance Operations learning content, pathways, curriculum and supporting resources in My Academy.
* Partner with content owners and subject\-matter experts to validate course relevance, accuracy, ownership, review dates and intended learner audiences.
* Maintain content governance, naming conventions, version control and review cycles so learning resources remain current and easy to find.
* Support learner enrolment, assignment, campaign communication, completion follow\-up and reporting in collaboration with the relevant platform or LMS owners.
* Use available platform insights(Workday, Menti\-meter, Canva, MS\-Forms) to understand participation, completion, content usage and learning gaps, and recommend improvements to curriculum and learner journeys.
* Promote awareness and adoption of My Academy through onboarding, learning campaigns, manager communication and self\-directed development guidance.
* Identify opportunities to retire outdated or duplicate materials and improve the overall learner experience.

**6\. AI integration and learning innovation**

* Identify and pilot responsible AI use cases that improve learning design, content creation, knowledge access, communication, reporting and administrative efficiency.
* Use approved AI tools to support first drafts, summaries, quizzes, scenarios, learning aids and content repurposing, with appropriate subject\-matter review before publication.
* Explore AI\-enabled approaches for personalized learning recommendations, recurring\-question analysis, knowledge discovery and identification of content gaps.
* Partner with relevant technology, HR and governance stakeholders to ensure AI use complies with confidentiality, data\-protection, intellectual\-property and responsible\-use requirements.
* Document AI\-enabled workflows, quality checks, limitations and human\-review responsibilities to enable safe and repeatable adoption.
* Share practical AI guidance and good practices with trainers, content owners and the wider Competency community.

**7\. Personal excellence, soft skills and people development**

* Design and facilitate interventions in professional communication, stakeholder management, collaboration, problem solving, workplace effectiveness, business etiquette and personal excellence.
* Manage and publish the relevant learning calendar in partnership with Finance, Delivery, site leadership and HR.
* Facilitate programs for associates, interns, managers and other employee groups based on business priorities.
* Coach internal trainers and subject\-matter experts through facilitator guidance, preparation, observation and feedback.
* Promote a learning culture through practice, reflection, feedback, knowledge sharing and manager involvement.

**8\. Internship and early\-career development**

* Coordinate the development components of Finance Operations internship and early\-career programs from orientation through completion.
* Design and deliver classroom\-to\-corporate transition journeys, personal\-excellence learning, engagement activities, assessments and development checkpoints.
* Coordinate assessments and consolidate results and stakeholder inputs to support deployment and development discussions.
* Partner with managers, HR and Talent Acquisition on team allocation, progress monitoring, learning interventions and conversion\-readiness inputs.
* Maintain regular communication with interns and Intern Champions (Functional Managers), identify development or engagement risks and coordinate appropriate support.
* Ensure final hiring, rating, deployment and conversion decisions remain with authorized business and HR owners.

**9\. Knowledge management, Knowledge Nugget and communications**

* Prepare, curate and publish the recurring Knowledge Nugget, converting Finance, workplace, process or capability insights into concise and engaging communication.
* Coordinate topics and inputs with leaders and process experts, validate content before publication and maintain a forward content calendar and repository.
* Maintain learning manuals, playbooks, templates, knowledge\-transfer documents and reusable resources in accessible locations.
* Create clear communications for onboarding, learning programs, assessments, campaigns and development initiatives.
* Support learning\-related town halls, engagement events, videos, newsletters and wider Finance communications as agreed with stakeholders.
* Build participation through timely communication, purposeful branding and audience\-appropriate messaging.
* Manage the Procurement of Goodies for participants of any competency led engagement initiatives

**10\. Measurement, governance and stakeholder coordination**

* Define and track indicators such as volume, participation, completion, assessment results, feedback, content usage, recurring questions, competency gaps and agreed business measures.
* Prepare concise updates for senior stakeholders, highlighting outcomes, trends, risks, dependencies and recommended actions.
* Use quantitative and qualitative insights to improve content, delivery methods, learner journeys and program processes.
* Maintain accurate records, dashboards, content inventories, standard operating procedures and version control.
* Build trusted partnerships with Finance leaders, SDLs, GPOs, tower managers, Bogotá and other hub stakeholders, HR, Talent Acquisition, Transport, Facilities and platform owners.
* Clarify scope, ownership, timelines and dependencies for each initiative and communicate risks early.
* Coordinate internal contributors, facilitators and external vendors where required and manage competing priorities to agreed timelines.

Learning Program Design

Global Hub Integration

* Well\-governed, accessible and actively used Finance Operations content and pathways in My Academy.
* Responsible AI pilots that demonstrate practical efficiency or learner\-experience benefits with documented controls.
* Reliable learning calendars, internship activities, Knowledge Nugget publications and stakeholder updates.

description:
**Position:** Head – Development (Pressing \& Stamping)

* **Industry:** Pressing, Stamping \& Sheet Metal Components
* **Department:** Product \& Process Development / Engineering
* **Reports To:** Plant Head / Business Head / Director
* **Experience:** 6–10\+ years in sheet\-metal pressing, stamping, press tools, die design, and NPD.
* **Salary:** ₹8\.00 – ₹10\.00 LPA
* **Location:**Chakan, Pune

**Role Summary**

Drive the end\-to\-end Product \& Process Development function for new and existing pressing/stamping components. You will lead projects from customer enquiry, RFQ, and DFM feasibility through tool design, trials, APQP/PPAP validation, to flawless mass production transfer.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **NPD \& Feasibility:** Lead RFQ\-to\-SOP development, drawing/GD\&T reviews, DFM studies, timelines, and customer technical resolution.
* **Tool \& Die Development:** Oversee progressive, tandem, transfer, and compound die designs, strip layouts, tool room coordination, and tryout approvals.
* **Process \& Simulation:** Define press tonnage, SPM, blank sizes, and process flows; use engineering simulation to eliminate rejection, springback, and cracks.
* **APQP \& PPAP Management:** Drive complete documentation (Process Flow, PFMEA, Control Plan, Work Instructions, MSA, Capability Studies, and customer PPAP approvals).
* **Cost Engineering \& VAVE:** Optimize material utilization, blank layouts, cycle times, and tool life to hit targeted product costs.
* **Production \& Problem Solving:** Provide shop\-floor technical support, resolve recurring dimension/forming issues using 8D, 5\-Why, and Fishbone root\-cause analysis.
* **Team Leadership:** Manage and mentor design, development, and tool room engineers to build a high\-performing technical culture.

**Required Qualifications \& Skills**

* **Education:** B.E. / B.Tech / Diploma in Mechanical, Production, Automobile, or Tool \& Die Engineering.
* **OEM Exposure:** Hands\-on experience in managing **Tata Motors** as a primary customer (APQP/PPAP protocols, quality norms, and technical interactions) is highly preferred.
* **Technical Mastery:** Deep knowledge of die design, DFM/DFA, GD\&T, forming simulation, tonnage calculation, and CAD (AutoCAD, CATIA, SolidWorks, NX).
* **Quality Standards:** Strong expertise in APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, Control Plans, and MSA.
* **Soft Skills:** Hands\-on problem solver, excellent customer\-facing communication, and team management ability.

**Key Deliverables \& KPIs**

* NPD On\-Time Delivery \& First\-Time\-Right Development
* On\-Time PPAP Approval (including OEM/Tata Motors milestones) \& Smooth SOP Handover
* Tool Tryout / Modification Cycle Reduction
* Material Yield Optimization \& Cost Reduction (VA/VE)
* Reduction in Launch Rejections \& Customer Complaints

title: Payroll Manager
description:
We are seeking an experienced and detail\-oriented **Payroll Manager** to manage end\-to\-end payroll operations for a group of companies under a leading Stock Broking and Financial Services organization. The role will be responsible for ensuring accurate and timely salary processing, statutory compliances, payroll audits, employee reimbursements, taxation, and payroll governance across multiple legal entities.

The ideal candidate should possess strong knowledge of payroll laws, labor compliance, taxation, and payroll software systems, with the ability to manage large employee populations across different business units.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Payroll Operations Management**

* Manage end\-to\-end monthly payroll processing for multiple group companies.
* Ensure timely and accurate salary disbursement, full and final settlements, incentives, bonus, variable pay, and arrears processing.
* Validate payroll inputs including attendance, leaves, overtime, incentives, reimbursements, deductions, and employee master data.
* Process payroll for new joiners, transfers, promotions, resignations, and terminations.
* Ensure payroll accuracy and maintain confidentiality of employee compensation data.

**Statutory Compliance \& Taxation**

* Ensure compliance with all statutory requirements including:
* Provident Fund (PF)
* Employee State Insurance (ESIC)
* Professional Tax (PT)
* Labour Welfare Fund (LWF)
* TDS on Salaries
* Gratuity and Bonus regulations
* Manage payroll\-related audits and statutory inspections.
* Ensure timely filing of statutory returns and payment of dues.
* Handle Form 16 generation and annual tax computations.

**Payroll Accounting \& Reconciliation**

* Coordinate with Finance department for payroll accounting entries.
* Reconcile payroll reports, statutory deductions, and salary payouts.
* Monitor payroll costs and provide management reports.
* Maintain payroll records and support internal and external audits.

**HRMS \& Payroll System Management**

* Manage payroll software and HRMS database.
* Ensure data accuracy, system updates, and payroll process improvements.
* Coordinate with payroll vendors and software service providers when required.
* Implement automation initiatives to enhance payroll efficiency.

**Employee Query Management**

* Resolve employee payroll\-related queries regarding salary, taxation, reimbursements, and deductions.
* Provide guidance on tax declarations and investment proofs.
* Maintain high service standards and employee satisfaction.

**Reporting \& MIS**

* Generate monthly payroll reports, cost analysis, and headcount reports.
* Prepare management dashboards related to payroll expenses and compliance.
* Provide payroll analytics and recommendations to leadership.

**Team Management**

* Lead and mentor payroll executives and payroll operations team.
* Establish payroll controls, SOPs, and compliance frameworks.
* Drive process improvements and best practices across group companies.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* 100% accurate and timely payroll processing.
* Zero payroll compliance penalties.
* Timely statutory filings and payments.
* Payroll closure within defined timelines.
* Employee query resolution within TAT.
* Successful completion of payroll audits.
* Payroll process automation and efficiency improvements.
* Employee satisfaction on payroll services.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Commerce, Finance, HR, or related field.
* MBA/PGDM in HR or Finance preferred.
* Payroll certification will be an added advantage.

**Experience**

* 8\-12 years of payroll experience.
* Minimum 3\-5 years in managerial role.
* Experience handling payroll for multiple legal entities/group companies.
* Experience in Financial Services, Stock Broking, NBFC, Banking, Wealth Management, or BFSI sector preferred.

**Required Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Indian Payroll Laws and Labor Compliance.
* Expertise in Income Tax, TDS, PF, ESIC, PT, and payroll accounting.
* Hands\-on experience with HRMS and Payroll Software (SAP, Oracle, ZOHO, Darwin box, GreytHR, Keka, etc.).
* Strong analytical and reconciliation skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* High degree of accuracy, confidentiality, and attention to detail.
* Advanced Excel and MIS reporting capabilities.

title: Manager, Product Design
description:
**Company Description**  

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.


Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description** **What you get to do in this role:**

* Directly manage, mentor and develop 3–5 designers
* Drive the UX vision and execution of a platform that produces a product line to revolutionize workplace productivity and analytics solutions for some of the largest companies in the world
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with product management, user research, engineering and content from strategic definition, planning, architecture, through tactical execution of the product roadmaps
* Distill complex problems into clear goals and requirements for the design and research team
* Understand the company's Design Systems, encourage their application, and contribute to their further development and maintenance.
* Drive the growth of user\-centric, collaborative culture across the Business Unit
* Evangelize design strategy and product vision across the global, distributed design teams
* Assist in conducting user needs assessment, task analysis and develop user profiles; identify key tasks for user research, competitive analysis and user testing, develop usability plans.
* Develop high level task flow content and then use storyboards and other design documents to communicate concepts and vision to others.
* Lead your team through rapid iterations of theoretical task scenarios, navigation map, flow, and state\-transition diagrams to document design decisions.
* Oversee your team's work: detailed mockups and prototypes and behavior specifications.
* Oversee UI layouts including controls, labels and graphical elements for software on both mobile and desktop platforms with an eye towards experience unification.
* Participate in documentation development process such as user experience specifications, testing and evaluation.
* Work closely with product management in UX ideation and innovation.
* Travel up to 20% of the year

  

**Qualifications** **To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision\-making, or problem\-solving. This may include using AI\-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI\-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* Minimum 3 years of experience managing people and/or leading design teams
* Minimum 10\+ years of experience in UX Design and/or Interaction Design field
* Passion to grow and mentor people
* Strong skills in Information Architecture
* A portfolio of work samples representing your work and approach
* Expertise in one or more of the following enterprise product spaces: IT Security Management, IT Operations Management, Security Operations, HR Service Delivery, Customer Service Management (CSM), or Finance \& Legal
* Expert with Sketch, Invision, Photoshop, or other design tools
* Ability to do rapid prototyping in Axure, Keynote, Framer, Principle or similar tools
* Ability to understand and distill complex problems into clean solutions
* Must have strong written and verbal English communication skills
* Must have excellent teamwork, communication, and technical problem\-solving skills to contribute within a multi\-functional and multi\-disciplined team
* Obsessed with the relentless pursuit of UX perfection working inside an iterative and agile development environment
* Must be able to work with minimal supervision in a fluid, fast\-paced and truly agile environment
* Expected to demonstrate a high level of initiative, good sense of humor, and a “make it work” ethos
* Experience in creating content and/or designing with compliance to WCAG 2\.0/2\.1 AA guidelines is a plus

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Knowledge of web design technologies (HTML, CSS)
* Experience working in an agile or incremental manner
* Experience working with tools such as ServiceNow, Miro, or Abstract

title: Placement & Project Coordinator
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a proactive, organised and result\-oriented **Placement \& Project Coordinator** to manage placement activities, employer coordination, candidate engagement and day\-to\-day project operations.

The person will act as a key coordination point between **companies, candidates, training teams, educational institutions and internal management**, ensuring that placement drives and assigned projects are executed smoothly and within timelines.

Key Responsibilities1\. Placement \& Employer Coordination

* Identify and coordinate with companies for recruitment, internship and placement opportunities.
* Communicate with HR teams and hiring managers regarding job requirements, eligibility criteria, salaries and recruitment processes.
* Coordinate job descriptions, candidate requirements and interview schedules.
* Share suitable candidate profiles with participating companies.
* Maintain and develop relationships with existing and new employer partners.
* Coordinate campus/off\-campus recruitment drives, interviews and selection processes.
* Follow up with companies regarding interview results, selections, offer letters and joining status.

2\. Candidate \& Student Coordination

* Coordinate with candidates regarding job openings, interviews, assessments and joining formalities.
* Maintain candidate databases and placement trackers.
* Conduct candidate briefings and pre\-placement sessions whenever required.
* Ensure candidates are properly informed about company requirements, interview schedules and documentation.
* Track candidate selection, offer and joining status.
* Address routine candidate queries and escalate issues where required.

3\. Project Coordination

* Coordinate assigned projects from initiation to completion.
* Prepare project plans, timelines, task trackers and MIS reports.
* Monitor project milestones, deliverables and pending activities.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure timely completion of tasks.
* Conduct regular follow\-ups and maintain action\-point trackers.
* Identify delays, risks or operational issues and escalate them to management.
* Prepare daily/weekly/monthly project status reports.

4\. Institutional / College Coordination

* Coordinate with colleges, universities, training institutes and other institutional partners.
* Understand institutional requirements and coordinate placement/recruitment activities accordingly.
* Plan and execute recruitment drives, career sessions, workshops and related activities.
* Coordinate logistics, candidate participation, company schedules and event requirements.
* Maintain professional relationships with placement officers, faculty members and institutional management.

5\. MIS \& Documentation

* Maintain accurate placement and project databases.
* Prepare Excel trackers, MIS reports, dashboards and management updates.
* Maintain records of companies, candidates, interviews, selections, offers and joining status.
* Prepare meeting minutes and follow up on action items.
* Ensure all project and placement documentation is updated and properly maintained.

6\. Internal Coordination

* Work closely with Business Development, Recruitment, Training, Operations and Management teams.
* Ensure timely flow of information between internal and external stakeholders.
* Coordinate multiple activities simultaneously and ensure deadlines are met.
* Support management in preparing presentations, reports and business updates.

Required Skills

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Good knowledge of **MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint**.
* Strong organisational and multitasking abilities.
* Good email drafting and professional communication skills.
* Ability to communicate confidently with HR professionals, colleges and senior stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned projects.
* Result\-oriented and proactive approach.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment.

Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in any of the following areas will be preferred:

* Placement / Career Services
* Recruitment / HR
* EdTech / Training / Education
* Campus Recruitment
* Business Operations
* Project Coordination
* Institutional Relations
* Corporate Relations

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of new companies onboarded.
* Number of active employer relationships maintained.
* Placement/interview opportunities generated.
* Candidate interview and selection conversion.
* Joining conversion rate.
* Timely execution of recruitment drives and projects.
* Accuracy and timely submission of MIS/reporting.
* Employer and institutional satisfaction.
* Completion of assigned projects within defined timelines.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate should be a **strong communicator and excellent coordinator** who can confidently interact with companies, HR teams, colleges, candidates and internal teams. The role requires someone who can take ownership, follow up consistently and ensure that things actually get completed on time.

Pay: ₹350,000\.00 \- ₹700,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

title: Manager, HR Operations
description:
**Job Description** **Who will you be working with?**

The HR Operations Regional Leader is part of the HR Shared Services Team. The role leads an organization of professionals and vendors to deliver regional HR transactional and process support for the employee lifecycle and payroll.


Additionally, the HR Operations Regional Leader leads and delivers enhancements to employee experience through process and system enhancements, transformation, and implementations. The Regional Leader manages team delivery of operational and system support to the Region and works collaboratively with other Centers of Expertise (Talent Acquisition, HRIS, Comp \& Benefits, Legal) to design and deliver HR business processes.

**How will you make a difference?**


As the HR Operations Regional Leader, you will play a key role in shaping an exceptional employee experience by driving efficient, scalable, and compliant HR and payroll operations across the region. Through strong leadership, process optimization, and collaboration with HR Centers of Expertise and business stakeholders, you will enhance service delivery, lead transformative initiatives, and leverage technology to simplify and improve the employee lifecycle. Your ability to balance operational excellence with continuous improvement will help build a high\-performing HR function that supports both business growth and employee success.


In this role you will:

* Lead and manage people and processes essential to the employee lifecycle and payroll for Indonesia, China, Australia, and New Zealand.
* Manage, develop, and engage a high\-performing regional team; build functional and leadership capability within the team and bench\-strength for future needs; deploy resources to fit business needs.
* Develop strategic partnerships with local HR to evaluate and evolve relationship in the region and ensure performance in accordance with SLAs. Lead quarterly service reviews.
* Partner with regional stakeholders to identify regional projects and process improvements; prioritize, plan, scope out projects and work with team to implement.
* Serve as a point of escalation for service issue themes, identifying root cause and path to resolution to ensure continued service improvement.
* Lead team projects regionally and/or globally to evolve HR processes that span across the employee life cycle; drive process improvements and standardization in partnership with Continuous Improvement Team.
* Provide support to cross\-functional workstreams in the region, such as Acquisitions, Reorganizations, Legal Entity Changes.
* Ensure local processes are documented thoroughly and team understands processes fully. Communicate and provide change management to team and HR community when changes are implemented.
* Monitor best practices, industry standards, local requirements; implement changes to internal processes as needed.

* **What We Want to Know About You**
* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business, Information Systems, or relevant field. Equivalent work experience in a similar position may be substituted for education requirements.
* 10\-15 years of experience in Human Resources, preferably in a Shared Services environment and should have experience managing APAC countries.
* Experience with HR administration, payroll, and systems within a large, complex enterprise, ideally across a range of geographies and businesses.
* Experience identifying areas for continuous improvement
* Strong experience working within HR systems, preferably Workday. Experience with a ticketing system such as ServiceNow.
* 3\+ years of team management and development.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite with intermediate Excel skills (pivot tables \& charts, vlookups).

 **Key Competencies**

  

* Excellent communication skills, with ability to motivate and influence without direct authority.
* Strong customer\-focus; ability to build and maintain effective relationships with stakeholders.
* Ability to operate autonomously and make quality decisions within ambiguous situations.
* Continuous\-improvement mindset and enthusiasm for problem\-solving and improving customer experience.
* Ability to create focus for self and team through rigorous prioritization of activities.
* Comfortable presenting to stakeholders, business leaders, and HR community. Able to analyse data, draw business insights, and present to stakeholders in a meaningful way.
* Ability to set direction, align operational priorities with business goals, and drive regional HR service excellence.
* Proven capability to lead, coach, and develop high\-performing teams, build bench strength, and foster employee engagement.
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end employee lifecycle processes, payroll operations, compliance requirements, and shared services delivery models.
* Ability to identify inefficiencies, standardize processes, implement best practices, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience leading organizational change, system implementations, process transformation, and adoption of new ways of working.
* Act as a key partner to the HR Operations Director in driving regional priorities and operational excellence.
* Ability to build trusted partnerships, collaborate across HR Centers of Excellence and business functions, and influence outcomes at multiple levels.
* Strong capability in managing third\-party providers, monitoring SLAs, conducting service reviews, and ensuring high\-quality service delivery.
* Ability to analyse complex issues, identify root causes, make sound decisions, and effectively resolve escalations.
* Skilled in leading regional and global projects, managing competing priorities, and delivering results within timelines.
* Experience leveraging HR systems such as Workday, ServiceNow, and payroll platforms to improve efficiency, reporting, and employee experience.
* Strong understanding of regional employment, payroll, and data privacy requirements, with a focus on maintaining compliance and mitigating risk.

 **What will your typical day look like?**

* Lead and support the regional HR Operations team, ensuring efficient delivery of employee lifecycle and payroll services across Indonesia, China, Australia, and New Zealand and Global Contingent worker process.
* Partner closely with the HR Operations Director to execute regional priorities, drive operational excellence, and support strategic initiatives.
* Monitor service delivery performance, address escalations, and ensure adherence to service level agreements (SLAs) and compliance requirements.
* Collaborate with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, HRIS, Compensation \& Benefits, Legal, and Payroll teams to deliver seamless HR processes and employee experiences.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and improve HR processes, leveraging technology and best practices to enhance efficiency.
* Lead regional and global projects, including system implementations, business transformations, acquisitions, reorganizations, and process redesign initiatives.
* Oversee relationships with payroll and HR service vendors, conduct service reviews, and drive continuous improvements in service quality and performance.
* Analyze operational metrics and trends to identify risks, opportunities, and areas for improvement, providing recommendations to leadership.
* Ensure HR policies, procedures, and operational documentation are maintained, up to date, and aligned with local regulatory requirements.
* Drive change management activities and communications to support successful adoption of new processes, systems, and ways of working.
* Coach, mentor, and develop team members, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.

 **Additional Information** **What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?**

title: Product Lead, Benefits Marketplace & PEO
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.


Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.


Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.85B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------


Every year, employers and employees spend more than $5 trillion on benefits globally. These products—from health insurance and retirement to fertility, mental health, telemedicine, and financial wellness—shape some of the most important decisions families make. Yet discovering, purchasing, and managing them remains fragmented, expensive, and confusing.


Rippling is building the first modern benefits marketplace that connects brokers, employers, employees, and benefit providers in one platform. Our benefits vertical includes the Rippling Benefits Platform, a rapidly growing marketplace of more than 100 partners, Rippling\-native benefits products, and Rippling PEO.


We are looking for a Growth Product Lead, Benefits Marketplace \& PEO to turn these product assets into a scaled growth engine. You will own the strategy and product roadmap to unlock growth by expanding the customers and benefit categories Rippling can serve. This role will play a central role increasing marketplace adoption and revenue.


This is a highly cross\-functional, zero\-to\-one role at the intersection of product, growth and go\-to\-market. You will work with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, Benefits Advisors, Business Development and Operations,. Success will be measured in business outcomes—including qualified demand, funnel conversion and revenue and not only in features shipped.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own the growth strategy and corresponding product roadmap for the Benefits Marketplace and PEO, with a clear mandate to expand the addressable market.
* Execute product led growth plan across benefit categories, geographies, employer profiles, and distribution channels.
* Expand the marketplace's addressable market by identifying and prioritizing new customer segments based on unmet demand, revenue potential, strategic deal unlocks, and Rippling's right to win.
* Expand awareness and consideration for the Benefits Marketplace by improving how employers discover, understand, compare, and evaluate relevant benefits.
* Accelerate PEO top\-of\-funnel growth by increasing awareness, improving education and discovery, and creating high\-intent entry points that generate and qualify demand across organic, in\-product, partner, broker, and sales\-led channels.
* Expand PEO's TAM by identifying customer profiles and market opportunities Rippling does not serve well today, then shaping the positioning, packaging, product entry points, and cross\-functional investments needed to reach them.
* Translate the growth strategy into clear product requirements, prioritized bets, channel plans, and measurable top\-of\-funnel experiments—while partnering closely with downstream owners on clean handoffs and shared learning.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 8\+ years of product management experience, including meaningful ownership of growth in B2B products.
* A track record of delivering measurable business outcomes—such as revenue, conversion, retention, attach, adoption, supply growth — through a combination of product and go\-to\-market levers.
* Strong product judgment and commercial instincts: You can connect customer problems, market dynamics and growth strategy into coherent product capabilities.
* Excellent analytical skills: You can define a funnel, build a business case, segment customers and partners, evaluate experiments, and turn ambiguous data into clear decisions.
* Customer obsession: You are equally comfortable speaking with employers, employees, brokers, partners, sales teams, and operations —and translating their needs into scalable products.
* Strong technical fluency and systems thinking. You can work effectively with engineers on data models, integrations, AI\-powered workflows, operational tooling, and platform capabilities without losing sight of the customer or business outcome.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to align executives and cross\-functional teams around a strategy, metrics, priorities, and tradeoffs.
* A self\-starter with a bias toward action who thrives in a fast\-moving environment, creates clarity from ambiguity, and can shift between long\-range strategy and detailed execution.
* Experience in benefits, insurance, PEO, payroll, marketplaces, partner ecosystems, or B2B2C products is a strong plus.
* Founder or hypergrowth startup experience is a strong plus.
* Strong alignment with Rippling's leadership principles, especially Go and See and Are Right, a Lot.

* Support identification of gaps, observations, OFIs, and nonconformities with clear references.
* Draft sections of audit deliverables: checklists, working papers, meeting minutes, and summary notes.
* Assist with corrective action follow\-ups: tracking CAPA status and closure evidence.

**Tools \& Coordination**

* Update audit trackers, risk registers, SoA/controls mapping sheets, and project documentation repositories.
* Coordinate with internal teams for scheduling, logistics, and documentation completeness.
* Maintain confidentiality and follow internal information security policies at all times.

**Standards / Framework Exposure (During Internship)**

You may work across one or more of the following (based on project allocation):

* **ISO/IEC 27001:2022** – Information Security Management Systems
* **ISO/IEC 42001:2023** – AI Management Systems (AIMS)
* **ISO/IEC 27701:2019** – Privacy Information Management Systems (PIMS)
* **SOC 2** – Trust Services Criteria (Security, Availability, Confidentiality, Processing Integrity, Privacy)

* **GDPR** – Privacy compliance assessment support

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**

* Basic understanding of cybersecurity audit concepts and frameworks.

**Preferred (Nice\-to\-Have)**

* Familiarity with any of: ISO 27001 controls, SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, DPDP, risk assessment, privacy principles.
* Interest in AI governance/AI risk and model lifecycle basics (helpful for ISO 42001 projects).

**Internship Outcomes / Learning**

* Understanding how certification/assurance audits are conducted and how evidence is evaluated.
* Improved professional writing: working papers, checklists, summaries, and CAPA tracking.
* Exposure to multi\-framework compliance expectations across security, privacy, and AI governance.

* Be punctual and dependable for onsite schedules and client meetings.
* Demonstrate attention to detail and a willingness to learn.

**Job Title:** Program Tester

**Focus Areas:** Software Quality Assurance, Manual \& Functional Testing, Test Planning \& Documentation, Release Coordination

**Location:** Kannur, Kerala (On\-site)

**Experience:** Fresher to 2 years

**Nature of Work:** Full\-time, on\-site. The role involves testing web and mobile applications across live client projects, owning test documentation and bug tracking end\-to\-end, and coordinating closely with designers, developers, and clients to keep releases on schedule and to quality.

**About Urbanhub Innovations**

Urbanhub Innovations is a design\-led digital solutions company based in Kannur, building innovative and scalable web and mobile applications for modern businesses across India, the GCC, the UK, and Canada. With expertise in technologies such as Flutter, React, Next.js, and the MERN stack, we deliver user\-centric products that combine functionality, performance, and seamless user experience. We work closely with clients to transform ideas into impactful digital solutions that meet real\-world needs.

At Urbanhub Innovations, we believe technology is driven by people. The organization promotes a collaborative and supportive work culture where creativity, learning, and innovation are encouraged at every level. Team members work on live client projects with real ownership, gain hands\-on exposure across industries and markets, and continuously sharpen their skills in a fast\-evolving digital environment.

We are committed to creating a positive and growth\-oriented workplace where employees feel valued, empowered, and motivated to contribute their best.

**Role and Responsibilities**  
1\. Functional \& Manual Testing

* Test web applications (React, Next.js, Laravel) and mobile applications (Flutter, Android and iOS) across devices, browsers, and screen sizes
* Perform functional, UI/UX, regression, smoke, and cross\-browser/cross\-device testing before every release
* Verify that delivered features match the approved design (Figma) and the agreed requirements or SRS
* Test multilingual and RTL (Arabic) layouts, payment flows, forms, and e\-commerce journeys where applicable

2\. Test Planning \& Documentation

* Read requirement documents, user stories, and designs to prepare test scenarios and test cases before development is complete
* Maintain structured test case sheets, test execution logs, and release checklists for every project
* Write clear, reproducible bug reports with steps, expected vs actual results, screenshots or screen recordings, and severity/priority
* Track defects from logging to closure and re\-verify fixes before sign\-off

3\. Release Coordination \& Sign\-off

* Own the pre\-release quality gate: confirm what is tested, what is open, and whether a build is ready to ship
* Coordinate UAT with clients, collect and consolidate their feedback, and convert it into actionable tickets for the team
* Prepare concise QA status summaries for internal stand\-ups and client updates

4\. Task Tracking \& Follow\-ups

* Maintain project trackers, task boards, and milestone timelines for the projects being tested
* Follow up with designers and developers on pending fixes, blockers, and deadlines
* Keep meeting notes, action items, and decision logs updated and circulated
* Flag scope changes, timeline risks, and dependency issues early to the project lead

5\. Client \& Team Communication

* Communicate clearly and professionally with clients across India and international markets over email, WhatsApp, and calls
* Translate client feedback into precise technical requirements for the team, and technical constraints into plain language for clients
* Work closely with UI/UX designers, developers, and content teams to keep deliverables on schedule

6\. Process \& Continuous Improvement

* Suggest improvements to QA checklists, bug\-tracking workflows, and release processes
* Stay current with testing tools, mobile/web platform updates, and QA best practices
* Contribute to internal documentation, onboarding material, and reusable test templates

**Essential Requirements**

* Fresher to 2 years of experience in software testing, QA, or a related technical role (academic projects, internships, or freelance work count)
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Solid understanding of the software development life cycle and the testing life cycle (STLC)
* Ability to write structured test cases and clear, reproducible bug reports
* Strong attention to detail with the discipline to test thoroughly rather than quickly
* Strong written and spoken communication skills in English, with the confidence to speak with clients and lead follow\-ups
* Naturally organised: comfortable maintaining trackers, checklists, and timelines, and chasing pending items without being reminded
* A sense of ownership — takes responsibility for the quality and timely delivery of the projects assigned, not just the tickets
* Ability to handle multiple client projects and shifting priorities simultaneously

**Good to Have**

* Exposure to bug\-tracking or project tools such as Jira, ClickUp, Trello, Notion, or Google Sheets\-based trackers
* Basic familiarity with Figma for comparing builds against designs
* Basic understanding of APIs and tools such as Postman
* Exposure to automation basics (Selenium, Playwright, or similar) or interest in learning them
* Understanding of Agile/Scrum practices
* Experience testing e\-commerce, booking, or dashboard\-style applications

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month
