Create Connections. Deliver Exceptional Experiences.

We are opening a new i'Deli Cafe outlet in Kakkanad, Kochi, and are looking for a warm, confident, and customer\-focused Guest Relation Executive to be part of our front\-of\-house team.

The Guest Relation Executive will be responsible for creating a welcoming guest experience, maintaining high service standards, handling guest interactions professionally, and supporting the smooth day\-to\-day operations of the outlet while consistently representing i'Deli Cafe's standards.

Guest Experience

* Welcome and greet guests warmly upon arrival.
* Create a friendly, professional, and positive first impression.
* Understand guest preferences and provide attentive, personalised service.
* Assist guests with seating, menu information, and general enquiries.
* Ensure guests feel comfortable and well cared for throughout their visit.
* Maintain a high standard of hospitality from guest arrival to departure.
* Engage with guests in a polite, confident, and professional manner.
* Thank guests and encourage them to return.

Guest Relations

* Build positive relationships with regular and new guests.
* Understand and respond appropriately to guest needs and expectations.
* Handle guest feedback, requests, and concerns professionally.
* Resolve service\-related issues promptly or escalate them to the appropriate supervisor when required.
* Follow up on guest concerns to ensure satisfactory resolution.
* Maintain a calm and positive attitude when dealing with difficult or demanding situations.
* Collect guest feedback and communicate relevant insights to the Outlet Manager or Supervisor.
* Support initiatives aimed at improving guest satisfaction and retention.

Service Support

* Coordinate closely with service staff, kitchen team, cashiers, and supervisors.
* Assist the service team during busy operating periods.
* Ensure smooth communication between guests and the restaurant team.
* Monitor guest tables and identify when assistance is required.
* Support the team in maintaining smooth guest flow during peak hours.
* Assist with reservations, table allocation, waiting lists, and guest enquiries when required.
* Ensure special requests and guest preferences are communicated accurately to the relevant team members.
* Support efficient service while maintaining hospitality standards.

Menu \& Product Knowledge

* Develop a strong understanding of the i'Deli Cafe menu.
* Be familiar with ingredients, preparation styles, portion options, and key product information.
* Understand basic allergen and dietary information and communicate it accurately.
* Answer guest questions about menu items confidently and professionally.
* Recommend suitable food and beverage options based on guest preferences.
* Stay updated on new menu items, promotions, seasonal offerings, and special products.
* Never provide inaccurate information regarding ingredients or allergens; clarify with the kitchen or supervisor when necessary.

Guest Feedback \& Complaint Handling

* Listen carefully to guest feedback without interrupting.
* Acknowledge concerns with empathy and professionalism.
* Take appropriate action within the scope of responsibility.
* Inform the Outlet Manager or Supervisor of significant complaints or recurring issues.
* Record or communicate important guest feedback accurately.
* Follow up where required to ensure the guest's concern has been addressed.
* Identify recurring service issues and communicate them to management.
* Maintain confidentiality and professionalism when handling sensitive guest matters.

Customer Service Standards

* Maintain i'Deli Cafe's standards of courtesy, grooming, communication, and hospitality.
* Use professional and positive language when interacting with guests.
* Maintain appropriate body language and a welcoming presence.
* Avoid arguments, confrontations, or negative interactions with guests.
* Remain attentive and approachable throughout the shift.
* Ensure every guest interaction reflects the brand's values and service standards.
* Maintain consistency in guest service during both busy and quiet periods.

Outlet Operations

* Support opening and closing procedures as assigned.

 Glencore’s customers are principally industrial consumers, such as those in the automotive, steel, power generation, battery manufacturing and oil sectors. We also provide financing, logistics and other services to producers and consumers of commodities.

title: Talent Acquisition | Intern
description:
Fynd is a frontier technology company. We started at the intersection of technology and retail because that is where technology was the least available. Over the years, we became one of India’s largest retail technology platforms. But retail was the entry point, not the boundary.
   

  

 Today, Fynd builds intelligent software that runs business operations. Not tools that help people work faster, but systems that absorb entire functions: manufacturing, marketing, logistics, commerce, quality control. We sit inside our customers’ businesses, harvest deep domain context, and build AI systems that operate autonomously. We are expanding from retail into manufacturing, generative media, physical AI, and healthcare.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented
 **Talent Acquisition Intern** 
 to join our HR team. This is a hands\-on internship ideal for someone looking to build a strong foundation in recruitment operations — from sourcing candidates to coordinating and managing the entire interview lifecycle. You'll work closely with recruiters and hiring managers, gaining direct exposure to how a fast\-paced tech/retail company hires talent
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Candidate Sourcing \& Screening**
* Source potential candidates through job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, etc.), internal databases, and referrals
* Conduct initial resume screening against role requirements shared by hiring managers
* Perform basic telephonic screening to assess candidate fit, availability, and interest
* Maintain and update the candidate pipeline/tracker regularly


**Interview Scheduling \& Coordination**
* Coordinate with candidates and interviewers to schedule interviews (telephonic, virtual, and in\-person)
* Send timely interview confirmations, reminders, and rescheduling communications
* Manage interviewer calendars and resolve scheduling conflicts proactively
* Ensure minimal drop\-off by maintaining consistent candidate follow\-up


**In\-Person Interview Management**
* Welcome and coordinate with candidates visiting the office for interviews
* Ensure interview rooms, panel availability, and required documents are in place
* Collect feedback from interviewers promptly after each round
* Communicate interview outcomes/next steps to candidates in a timely manner


**Reporting \& Documentation**
* Maintain accurate recruitment trackers (candidate status, feedback, TAT)
* Assist in generating basic hiring reports/dashboards for the TA team
* Support offer rollout coordination and documentation as needed


**Some Specific Requirements**
* Pursuing or recently completed a graduate/postgraduate degree (HR specialization preferred)
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong interpersonal skills with a candidate\-first, professional approach
* Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple schedules/priorities simultaneously
* Proficiency in MS Excel/Google Sheets; familiarity with ATS or job portals is a plus
* Ability to work on\-site full\-time for the internship duration


**What You'll Gain**
* End\-to\-end exposure to the recruitment lifecycle at a fast\-growing company
* Direct mentorship from experienced TA professionals
* Certificate of internship and potential for full\-time conversion based on performance
* Real ownership of tasks from day one — not just observation


**Work Environment**
 We thrive on collaboration and creativity. Our teams work from the office five days a week to encourage open communication, teamwork, and innovation.
   

  

 Join us to be part of a dynamic environment where your ideas make an impact!

title: Production Supervisor
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.


This Position reports to:


Production Manager **What we believe in**


At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration \- combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities \- are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions. That's our story. Make it your story.


Your role and responsibilities


In this role, you Lead a team within a production unit in the execution of processes to transform parts and raw materials into ABB products in a timely, cost\-effective manner. Ensure continues and efficient operation in accordance with volumes, schedules, procedures, drawings and quality and safety


The work model for the role is: \#Li\-Onsite


This role is contributing to the ABB India, Smart Power, Electrification, Business, for Production Operation function for Bangalore Nelamangala Location.

**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Resource Planning \& Production Execution: Organize and allocate resources efficiently to meet monthly production targets, ensuring capacity planning and adherence to demand plans for on\-time delivery.
* Material, Equipment \& Facility Management: Ensure material availability through regular coordination with planning and buyer teams and identify technical equipment and facility improvements as needed.
* Quality \& Process Improvement: Ensure customer PPM targets and zero\-line stoppages by implementing preventive actions, identifying process deficiencies, and advancing improvement initiatives.
* KPI \& Safety Management: Regularly review KPIs for assigned product lines, ensuring safety compliance and maintaining 6S standards across production areas.
* People Leadership \& Development: Guide, motivate, and develop direct and indirect team members, ensuring teams are well\-organized, staffed, skilled, and aligned with HR policies.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Experience: 10–15 years of relevant experience in a similar manufacturing role with a focus on planning and operational improvement.
* Qualification: Full\-time Diploma/Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Production Engineering.
* Ensure effective production planning and scheduling to meet volume requirements per demand plans while managing inventory levels efficiently.
* Implement continuous improvement initiatives, focusing on process optimization and productivity enhancements.
* Implement lean manufacturing practices, line balancing, and 5S concepts to ensure operational excellence on the shop floor.
* Plan and manage resources effectively, covering men, machines, materials, and methods to support smooth production operations.
* Comfortable working in rotational shifts (A, B, C), ensuring support for continuous production and operational flexibility.

**More about us**


ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low\-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy\-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy\-to\-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

  

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.


Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.


Recruitment Fraud Warning


ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.


View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home


For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how\-to\-apply/fraud\-warning

title: HR & People Operations Executive – Zoho People, Recruit & Payroll
description:
HR \& People Operations Executive – Zoho People, Recruit \& Payroll

**Location:** Madurai, Tamil Nadu  
**Work Arrangement:** Hybrid — Madurai\-based candidates only  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time \| Permanent  
**Working Days:** Monday – Saturday  
**Working Hours:** 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM  
**Salary:** ₹25,000 – ₹30,000 per month  
**Experience:** 3\+ years of relevant professional experience  
**Joining:** Immediate / Short Notice Preferred

About Chess Gaja

Chess Gaja is a global online chess academy founded by GrandMaster Priyadharshan Kannappan, serving students across 50\+ countries through a distributed network of chess coaches and business operations employees.

We are looking for an experienced **HR \& People Operations Executive** who can take ownership of our HR operations end\-to\-end.

This is an execution\-oriented role for someone who already has practical experience managing HR processes, payroll and HR technology.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on experience with **Zoho People, Zoho Recruit and Zoho Payroll**, along with basic accounting knowledge and the ability to coordinate routine finance and accounting matters with our auditor.

**This is not a fresher or training position. Prior professional experience is required.**

IMPORTANT — MADURAI LOCATION REQUIREMENT

**This position is open ONLY to candidates who currently live in Madurai, Tamil Nadu.**

You must be **currently residing in Madurai** and able to regularly work from our Madurai location when required.

The role is **hybrid**, meaning there will be a combination of office\-based and work\-from\-home work depending on business requirements and the nature of the work.

**Candidates currently living outside Madurai should NOT apply.**

We are specifically building this position around a **Madurai\-based team member**, so relocation from another city is not the hiring model for this position.

What You Will Own

You will be responsible for running the company's day\-to\-day **HR and People Operations**, including:

**Recruitment → Onboarding → Employee Records → Attendance \& Leave → Payroll → HR Documentation → Employee Support → HR Reporting → Exits**

You will also handle basic finance/accounting coordination and work with our auditor when required.

1\. HR \& People Operations

* Maintain accurate employee records in **Zoho People**.
* Manage employee onboarding and documentation.
* Manage attendance, leave and other employee records.
* Manage probation and confirmation processes.
* Prepare offer letters, appointment letters, confirmation letters and other HR documentation.
* Maintain HR policies and employee documentation.
* Handle employee queries relating to HR processes, attendance, leave and payroll.
* Coordinate employee exits and maintain appropriate documentation.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee and payroll information.
* Identify gaps in HR processes and implement practical improvements.

Zoho People

You should have genuine hands\-on experience with **Zoho People**, including:

* Employee setup and management
* Attendance configuration and management
* Leave policies and workflows
* Employee information management
* HR workflows
* Reports
* Basic system configuration
* Troubleshooting and process improvement

We are looking for someone who can **operate and improve Zoho People**, not simply enter employee information into the system.

2\. Recruitment Operations – Zoho Recruit

You will manage the operational side of recruitment.

Responsibilities include:

* Creating and managing job openings.
* Managing candidate pipelines.
* Maintaining candidate records.
* Coordinating interviews and assessments.
* Managing recruitment stages and workflows.
* Maintaining recruitment data and reports.
* Coordinating with hiring managers.
* Ensuring candidates move efficiently through the recruitment process.
* Maintaining an organized talent database.

3\. Payroll – Zoho Payroll

**This is a critical responsibility of the role.**

You must have prior practical experience using **Zoho Payroll**.

You will be responsible for:

* Preparing and processing monthly payroll.
* Verifying attendance, leave and payroll inputs.
* Checking salary calculations.
* Managing deductions and other payroll components.
* Reviewing payroll before processing.
* Identifying and resolving discrepancies.
* Maintaining payroll records.
* Preparing payroll\-related reports and documentation.
* Coordinating salary revisions, incentives, bonuses and other payroll inputs.

The person hired should be capable of **independently running the monthly payroll process** after understanding Chess Gaja's internal structure and policies.

4\. Basic Accounts \& Finance Coordination

This is **not a full\-fledged accountant position**.

However, you must have sufficient accounting knowledge to understand basic financial information, perform routine number crunching and coordinate effectively with our auditor.

Responsibilities include:

* Maintaining basic financial records in **Zoho Books**.
* Performing basic reconciliation and checking financial data.
* Organizing invoices, bills and supporting documents.
* Tracking basic receivables and payables information.
* Cross\-checking operational numbers and identifying discrepancies.
* Preparing information and documentation requested by the auditor.
* Coordinating routine queries with our auditor/accounting office.
* Supporting basic GST/TDS\-related documentation and data collection.
* Performing basic calculations and financial checks using Excel/Google Sheets.

You do **not** need to be a qualified accountant or CA.

However, you should be comfortable working with numbers and understanding basic accounting concepts.

5\. HR Reporting \& Administration

* Prepare regular HR reports.
* Maintain accurate employee and payroll databases.
* Track attendance, leave and employee\-related information.
* Maintain recruitment and HR reports.
* Ensure important HR deadlines are not missed.
* Maintain organized digital documentation.
* Support management with HR\-related information and reports.
* Continuously improve recurring HR processes.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for an experienced professional who:

* Has prior professional experience in HR / HR Operations / People Operations.
* Has **hands\-on experience with Zoho People**.
* Has **hands\-on experience with Zoho Recruit**.
* Has **hands\-on experience running payroll using Zoho Payroll**.
* Has basic practical knowledge of **Zoho Books**.
* Understands basic accounting principles.
* Is comfortable working with numbers and reconciliations.
* Has strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.
* Is highly organized and detail\-oriented.
* Can handle confidential employee and payroll information.
* Communicates clearly and professionally.
* Can coordinate effectively with an external auditor/accounting office.
* Can work independently with limited supervision.
* Takes ownership of completing recurring processes accurately and on time.

Required ExperienceMandatory

* Prior professional HR / HR Operations experience.
* Hands\-on experience with **Zoho People**.
* Hands\-on experience with **Zoho Recruit**.
* Hands\-on experience with **Zoho Payroll**.
* Basic accounting knowledge.
* Good Excel/Google Sheets skills.
* **Currently residing in Madurai, Tamil Nadu.**

Preferred

* Experience with Zoho Books.
* Experience working in a startup, SME or growing organization.
* Experience independently managing HR operations.
* Experience coordinating with auditors, CAs or accounting firms.
* Experience setting up or improving HR systems and workflows.

Technology \& Work Requirements

You must have your own:

* Reliable laptop/computer suitable for daily professional work.
* Smartphone.
* Reliable high\-speed internet connection.
* A suitable work environment for occasional work from home.

You will be expected to be comfortable working with cloud\-based systems and communicating digitally with employees, management and external stakeholders.

Compensation

**₹25,000 – ₹30,000 per month**

The exact salary offered will depend on your relevant experience, demonstrated Zoho expertise and overall suitability for the role.

Candidates with stronger hands\-on experience and the ability to independently manage HR, payroll and Zoho systems will be considered toward the higher end of the range.

Why Join Chess Gaja?

* Work with a growing international organization serving students across 50\+ countries.
* Take meaningful ownership of HR and People Operations.
* Work extensively with the Zoho ecosystem.
* Gain exposure to international business operations.
* Work closely with the management team.
* Opportunity to build and improve HR systems and processes rather than simply following existing procedures.

Important

**Please apply only if you currently live in Madurai and have genuine professional experience in HR operations.**

Hands\-on experience with **Zoho People, Zoho Recruit and Zoho Payroll is strongly preferred and will be assessed during the selection process.**

This is an experienced execution role. Candidates whose experience is limited to academic projects, courses, tutorials or brief exposure to these systems will not be considered suitable.

description:

 At Kapture CX, we are looking for an
 **Analyst – Platform Operations** 
 in our

 team.
   

  

**Who are we?**
 Kapture CX is a leading SaaS platform that helps enterprises automate and elevate customer experience through intelligent, AI\-powered solutions. We partner with enterprises across industries to bring scalable automation and insight\-driven efficiencies to their CX operations.
   

  

 Over a thousand clients across 18 countries have used Kapture’s products to enhance their customer experience, including Unilever, Reliance, Coca\-Cola, Bigbasket, Meesho, Airtel Payments Bank and Cathay Pacific. Kapture delivers industry\-specific solutions powered by AI, tailored workflows, and seamless automation.
   

  

 Kapture CX is headquartered in Bangalore and we have offices in Mumbai and Delhi/NCR in India, in addition to offices in the USA, UAE, Singapore, Philippines and Indonesia.
   

  

**What is this role all about?**
 We are looking for an Analyst to ensure high availability, reliability, and performance of our SaaS platform. Beyond day\-to\-day ticket resolution and incident management, this role will contribute to building dashboards, internal utilities, and automated workflows that reduce toil and drive operational excellence. The ideal candidate bridges development and operations, using technical skills to not just resolve issues, but help identify and eliminate recurring problems.
   

  

**Sounds interesting?**
**Here’s a more detailed description of what you will do in this role:**
* You will resolve production incidents and customer\-reported issues end\-to\-end, including triage, resolution, and post\-incident review.
* You will build and maintain observability dashboards (Grafana, centralized logging) that give engineering and product teams real\-time visibility into platform health and failure patterns.
* You will develop internal scripts and utilities to handle bulk or recurring issues at scale — reducing ticket volume and manual effort over time.
* You will support RCA for major incidents, identify systemic root causes, and work with Product and Engineering teams to ensure preventive actions are implemented.
* You will analyze ticket trends and platform telemetry to surface patterns and translate them into actionable inputs for the right team.
* You will validate API behavior across client → gateway → backend chains; clearly distinguish client\-side failures (payload, auth, headers) from server\-side issues (latency, errors, downtime).
* You will support deployment validation and production release monitoring and automate repeatable checks wherever possible.


 This is a
 **Bangalore\-based role** 
 . We work five days a week from the office, as we believe in\-person interactions fuel innovation and agility.
   

  

**What does success look like in this role?**
**Success In This Role Means**
* Reduced MTTR for critical and high\-priority issues.
* SLA adherence for issue response and resolution.
* Volume of recurring tickets eliminated through tooling, automation, or permanent fixes.
* Dashboard adoption — stakeholders actively using operational views built by this role.
* Reduction in manual, repetitive operational tasks over time.


**What would make you a good fit for this role?**
**Here Are The Basic Requirements**
* You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* You have 1–3 years of experience in a technical analyst, application support, or platform operations role.
* You have proficiency in observability tooling — Grafana, centralized log management, or equivalent.
* You have strong knowledge of APIs, REST services, and HTTP semantics (status codes, retries, timeouts, throttling).
* You have experience writing scripts or utilities (Python, SQL, or equivalent) to automate analysis or bulk remediation.
* You have hands\-on experience with ticketing systems (Jira, ServiceNow, or Zendesk) and API testing tools (Postman or equivalent).


**What are the most critical skills for this role?**
* You have experience with Observability \& Dashboarding — designing monitoring views that surface the right signal for engineering and business stakeholders.
* You have experience with Utility Development — writing tools that solve operational problems at scale, not just one ticket at a time.
* You have experience with API \& Integration Tracing — tracing end\-to\-end flows and isolating failure ownership across client, gateway, and backend layers.
* You have experience with Pattern Recognition — moving from individual incidents to systemic insight; knowing when a ticket is a symptom, not the cause.
* You have strong Cross\-functional Communication skills — translating technical findings into precise, timestamped artifacts that engineering teams can act on immediately.


**You Will Have An Advantage If You**
* You have experience working in SaaS platform environments.
* You have exposure to production release monitoring and deployment validation.
* You have experience building operational tooling and automation workflows.
* You have experience identifying recurring issue patterns and driving preventive fixes.


**Why should you be interested?**
**Here’s What You Will Gain From This Role**
* Opportunity to work on large\-scale SaaS systems.
* Exposure to cross\-functional collaboration with Engineering, Product, and Customer teams.
* Opportunity to build tools and automation that directly influence platform efficiency and reliability.
* Opportunity to solve operational challenges with measurable business impact.


**Does this sound like you?**
 Click the Apply button to let us know!

description:
**We’re Hiring: AI/ML Engineer (GenAI \& LLM Focus)** 




  





 A leading global telecom analytics company is seeking a highly skilled
 **AI/ML Engineer (GenAI/LLM)** 
 to design, fine\-tune, and operationalize Large Language Models (LLMs) for complex telecom business applications. In this role, you will build domain\-specific GenAI solutions, transforming telecom operational processes, customer interactions, and internal decision\-making workflows.
 



  





**📍 Role Overview** 



* **Role:** 
 AI/ML Engineer – Engineering
* **Industry:** 
 Telecommunications \& Data Analytics
* **Experience:** 
 4\+ years in AI/ML (with 2\+ years in LLMs or GenAI deployments)
* **Education:** 
 B.E. / B.Tech, M.E. / M.Tech, or M.Sc. in Computer Science or a related field
* **Location:** 
 Bangalore.



  





**🎯 Key Responsibilities** 



* **Domain\-Specific LLMs:** 
 Curate domain\-relevant datasets to train and fine\-tune LLMs (e.g., GPT, Llama, Mistral) tailored to telecom use cases.
* **RAG \& Agent Workflows:** 
 Develop Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines integrated with vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone). Build multi\-agent LLM pipelines using orchestration tools like LangChain and LlamaIndex.
* **Prompt Engineering:** 
 Design prompt engineering frameworks and optimize context strategies for complex telco\-specific queries.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** 
 Partner with data engineers, product teams, and domain experts to translate telecom business logic into active GenAI workflows.
* **Model Evaluation \& Quality:** 
 Conduct systematic model evaluations to minimize hallucinations, enhance domain\-specific accuracy, and track business KPIs.
* **Best Practices:** 
 Build reusable internal GenAI modules, maintain coding standards, and document best practices.



  





**🛠️ Technical Qualifications \& Skills** 



* **Core Tech Stack:** 
 Proficiency in Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, and NLP libraries.
* **LLM Architecture \& Fine\-Tuning:** 
 Deep understanding of transformer architectures and fine\-tuning techniques (LoRA, PEFT, adapters).
* **Frameworks \& Tools:** 
 Hands\-on expertise with prompt engineering, RAG architecture, and orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex).
* **Bonus Exposure:** 
 Experience with multi\-modal LLMs (text \+ tabular/time\-series), OpenAI function calling, LangGraph, low\-latency inference optimization (quantization, distillation), and telecom datasets (call records, network logs, customer tickets).

title: SaaS Growth Manager
description:

About Calcyntra Technologies

**Calcyntra Technologies** is a technology company focused on building innovative digital solutions that help businesses improve their operations, customer experience, and growth.

We work across areas including custom software development, websites and web applications, mobile applications, SaaS solutions, AI, automation, CRM/ERP solutions, and digital transformation.

As part of our product ecosystem, **LayoutLeap** is an ecommerce and autonomous business platform designed to help businesses establish and grow their online presence with modern website, ecommerce, automation, analytics, and business\-management capabilities.

About the Role

Calcyntra Technologies is looking for an energetic, self\-motivated, and results\-oriented **SaaS Growth Manager** to drive the growth of **LayoutLeap**.

The primary responsibility of this role is to identify potential customers, generate qualified leads, introduce businesses to LayoutLeap, conduct product demonstrations, build relationships, and convert prospects into paying customers.

The role combines **SaaS sales, customer acquisition, business development, lead generation, partnerships, and revenue growth**.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working with businesses, communicating with decision\-makers, selling digital products, networking, and contributing directly to the growth of a technology product.

Key ResponsibilitiesSaaS Growth \& Customer Acquisition

* Develop and execute strategies to grow LayoutLeap's customer base and revenue.
* Identify businesses that can benefit from LayoutLeap.
* Target entrepreneurs, startups, small businesses, online sellers, retailers, agencies, and growing brands.
* Research new customer segments and potential markets.
* Develop new customer acquisition channels.

Lead Generation \& Prospecting

Generate qualified leads through:

* Cold calling

Product Demonstrations \& Customer Communication

* Explain technical and SaaS concepts in simple business terms.

Sales \& Conversion

* Convert prospects into paying customers.

Partnerships \& Business Development

Develop partnerships with:

* Digital agencies
* Web developers
* Freelancers
* Digital marketers
* Ecommerce consultants
* Business consultants
* Technology partners
* Other businesses and professionals who can refer customers

Build long\-term relationships with partners and develop referral opportunities for LayoutLeap.

CRM \& Sales Operations

* Maintain accurate records of leads, prospects, meetings, demonstrations, follow\-ups, and conversions.
* Keep CRM information updated.
* Maintain a structured sales pipeline.
* Track prospect activity and follow\-ups.
* Prepare proposals and quotations when required.
* Provide regular reports covering leads, opportunities, conversions, and revenue.

Market \& Competitor Research

* Monitor competitors in SaaS, ecommerce, website\-building, and digital business platforms.
* Research emerging market trends.
* Identify new customer opportunities.
* Understand customer needs and common business challenges.
* Share market and customer insights with the product and marketing teams.

Collaboration

* Work closely with the product team to understand LayoutLeap's capabilities.
* Collaborate with marketing on lead\-generation and customer\-acquisition campaigns.
* Share customer feedback and objections with internal teams.
* Suggest improvements to the sales and customer\-acquisition process.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:

* Passionate about SaaS, technology, ecommerce, and business growth.
* Confident speaking with business owners and decision\-makers.
* Comfortable initiating conversations with new prospects.
* Strong in verbal and written communication.
* Proactive in finding new business opportunities.
* Self\-motivated and target\-oriented.
* Strong at relationship building and follow\-up.
* Able to explain software products in simple language.
* Comfortable conducting online product demonstrations.
* Interested in learning about SaaS and ecommerce.
* Able to work independently and take ownership of growth activities.
* Willing to experiment with new approaches to customer acquisition.

Experience \& Qualifications

* 0–2 years of experience in sales, business development, SaaS, digital products, ecommerce, digital marketing, customer acquisition, or a related field.
* Freshers with strong communication skills and an interest in SaaS sales and business growth may also apply.
* Experience with CRM tools is an advantage.
* Experience with LinkedIn prospecting, email outreach, cold calling, or sales platforms is an advantage.
* Basic understanding of websites, ecommerce, SaaS, or digital marketing is preferred.

Key Performance Areas

Performance will be evaluated based on measurable growth activities, including:

* Qualified leads generated
* Sales opportunities created
* Client meetings conducted
* Product demonstrations completed
* New customers acquired
* Lead\-to\-customer conversion
* Monthly sales/revenue generated
* Paid subscriptions generated
* Follow\-up consistency
* CRM activity
* Sales pipeline development
* Partnerships developed
* Referral customers generated

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work with a growing technology company.
* Hands\-on experience in SaaS, ecommerce, sales, and customer acquisition.
* Opportunity to work directly on a technology product.
* Performance\-based career growth.
* Competitive compensation with performance incentives.
* Supportive and collaborative working environment.
* Opportunity to take ownership of growth initiatives.

Initial Two\-Month Performance Period

The first **two months** will be an initial performance\-based period.

During this period, compensation will be based on **performance incentives linked to successful sales and business development results**.

Performance will be evaluated based on mutually agreed targets, including:

* Qualified leads generated
* Client meetings

At Calcyntra Technologies, you will have the opportunity to work at the intersection of **technology and business growth** while helping businesses adopt modern digital solutions.

title: Product Manager / Product Owner — Ecommerce Automation & SaaS
description:
**Company Description** 
 Healthy18 is an ecommerce enablement company that helps brands, manufacturers, and sellers scale their online business. The organization focuses on providing best\-in\-class warehousing, supply chain, and digital marketing services to improve performance on ecommerce platforms. By combining operational excellence with data\-driven strategies, Healthy18 supports partners in increasing sales, optimizing costs, and enhancing customer experience. Team members join a growing environment that values innovation, collaboration, and practical problem\-solving in the ecommerce space.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Product Manager / Product Owner — Ecommerce Automation \& SaaS is a full\-time, on\-site role based in West Delhi. This role is responsible for defining product vision and roadmap for ecommerce automation and SaaS solutions, translating business needs into clear product requirements and user stories. Day\-to\-day tasks include collaborating with cross\-functional teams (operations, marketing, engineering, and sales), prioritizing the product backlog, and overseeing end\-to\-end implementation of new features and improvements. The role involves analyzing user behavior and product performance data, coordinating with stakeholders to refine requirements, and ensuring timely delivery of high\-quality releases. The Product Manager / Product Owner will also support go\-to\-market activities, gather feedback from users and clients, and continuously optimize the product for scalability and efficiency.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Own the product vision and roadmap for internal automation tools and customer\-facing ecommerce SaaS products.
* Identify manual, repetitive workflows across the business and scope automation opportunities that save time or reduce error.
* Translate business requirements into a prioritized backlog: user stories, acceptance criteria, and edge cases.
* Run sprint ceremonies (planning, grooming, review) and act as the primary point of contact for the engineering team during execution.
* Work closely with engineering on technical feasibility, architecture tradeoffs, and build\-vs\-buy decisions.
* Define and track success metrics for shipped features (adoption, time saved, error reduction, revenue impact).
* Conduct market and competitor research to inform ecommerce SaaS feature decisions.
* Coordinate with design, sales, and operations to ensure products solve real, validated problems.



  





**Qualifications** 



* 3\-5 years of experience in product management, product ownership, or a hybrid role, ideally in SaaS, ecommerce, or automation platforms — including defining roadmaps, managing product backlogs, and taking a product from idea to shipped feature.
* Strong skills in requirements gathering, user story writing, and process documentation, with the ability to translate business needs into clear specifications and acceptance criteria.
* Experience running Agile/Scrum ceremonies (planning, grooming, review) and acting as the primary point of contact for an engineering team during execution.
* Comfortable working directly with engineers on technical feasibility, architecture tradeoffs, and build\-vs\-buy decisions, even without a coding background.
* Strong analytical skills — able to interpret data, metrics, and user feedback to define success criteria and make prioritization calls.
* Excellent written, verbal, and stakeholder\-management skills, with the ability to represent both business and user perspective to a technical team and build consensus.
* Proven ability to work on\-site in a fast\-paced environment, manage multiple priorities, and drive initiatives from concept to launch.
* Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, computer science, or a related field; advanced certifications in product management or agile methodologies are a plus.
* Based in or willing to relocate to Delhi NCR; this is an on\-site role in West Delhi.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Prior experience in an ecommerce company or building ecommerce\-adjacent tools (inventory, order management, logistics, catalog, payments).
* Familiarity with tools like Jira, Notion, Zapier/Make, or low\-code automation platforms.
* Startup or small\-team experience where you owned a product area end\-to\-end.

title: Delivery Manager, SEO & GEO
description:
About Geology
 
 Geology is a marketing lab, not an agency. We build AI agents that do the work agencies still do by hand, and we point them at SEO and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization: getting a brand cited inside ChatGPT and Google's AI Overviews, which is where a fast\-growing share of buying research now happens).
 



 Both founders are from IIT Bombay and have built companies before. This is the newest one, the team is small, and whoever joins now will be one of the first few people in it.
   




 About the role
 
 You run delivery for our client accounts: the analysis, the deliverables, the reporting, and the client relationship at working level.
 



 Most of the heavy lifting is done by agents we build and maintain. Your job is to run them well, judge whether what comes out is any good, and turn it into work the client acts on. That judgement is the part no agent does yet, and it is the job.
 



 You will work directly with the founders.
   




 Key responsibilities
 * Own delivery for a few client accounts: what ships, at what standard, and when
* Use our AI agents to produce the client work, across technical audits, content, reporting, AI\-visibility tracking and off\-site execution
* Review what the agents produce, decide what actually matters to the client, and take it the last stretch yourself
* Present the work on client calls, agree next steps, and follow up until they ship
* Keep delivery on track: track what is open, and chase access, approvals and blockers to closure
* Help improve the agents you work with


 What we are looking for
 * 1 to 3 years delivering work to clients or stakeholders and owning the relationship at working level. Agency, consulting or programme management all count, and it does not have to be marketing
* Clear written English, good enough for documents that go to a client
* Comfortable presenting work and taking questions on it live
* Consistent follow\-through. What gets committed to on a call actually happens
* Strong with data: spreadsheets, reading a data set accurately, and checking a number before you present it
* Experience with tools like GitHub and Claude Code, or the ability to work out how. You should be comfortable setting a tool up from its documentation and working out why something is not running, since a good deal of what you will use here does not exist yet


 Good to have
 * SEO or GEO experience. Useful, and genuinely not required: we will teach it
* Having used Claude Code, Cursor or similar agentic tools
* Basic Python or scripting
* Agency experience


 What we offer
 * ₹10,00,000 to ₹18,00,000 per annum, depending on experience and skill
* Based in Jaipur, working in the same room as the founders
* Direct work with repeat founders, early in building this company, with no layer in between
* The chance to learn how custom AI agents are actually built and run in production work, rather than reading about it


 How to apply
 
 Send your LinkedIn and a two to three minute video. The video brief is short, and it is worth reading before you record.
 



 Apply: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe8mPZ3YneU37xnLB2\_lj\-An2Vhz\-\_P5BOv6ve3OA9HRuW7kQ/viewform
 



 We look at every submission, and we will reply to you either way about next steps.

**About UnivEdge Consulting** 




 UnivEdge Consulting is an IT staffing and recruitment company supporting clients across the United States, Canada, and India. We recruit technology professionals across data engineering, AI/ML, cloud, cybersecurity, software development, and other IT disciplines.
 



 Our India team operates during US business hours from our office in Greater Noida West.
 



 About the Role
 



 We are looking for an enthusiastic and responsible
 **HR Associate** 
 to support our HR and internal recruitment activities.
 



 This is an entry\-level opportunity for fresh graduates who want to build a career in Human Resources. The selected candidate will receive practical exposure to recruitment, employee onboarding, attendance management, HR documentation, engagement activities, payroll coordination, and employee record management.
 



 You do not need prior HR experience. However, you must have good communication skills, attention to detail, basic knowledge of Microsoft Office, and a genuine interest in developing a career in HR.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Internal Recruitment** 



* Source candidates for internal positions through LinkedIn, Naukri, job portals, referrals, and social media
* Review resumes and conduct initial candidate screening
* Schedule interviews and coordinate between candidates and interviewers
* Maintain recruitment trackers and update candidate statuses
* Follow up with shortlisted candidates regarding interviews, documentation, and joining
* Assist with offer\-letter preparation and pre\-joining engagement



  





**Onboarding and Employee Records** 



* Collect and verify joining documents from new employees
* Assist with joining formalities and employee orientation
* Create and maintain employee files and HR records
* Update employee information, emergency contacts, and other employment details
* Track probation and confirmation dates
* Ensure employee records remain complete, accurate, and confidential



  





**Attendance and Payroll Support** 



* Maintain daily attendance and leave records
* Track late arrivals, absences, and approved leave
* Help prepare monthly attendance and payroll inputs
* Coordinate with employees to resolve attendance discrepancies
* Maintain incentive, reimbursement, and payroll\-related trackers
* Support full\-and\-final settlement documentation during employee exits



  





**HR Documentation** 



* Assist in preparing offer letters, appointment letters, confirmation letters, warning letters, relieving letters, and experience certificates
* Maintain organized digital and physical employee records
* Use approved templates and ensure documents are reviewed before being issued
* Support the implementation and communication of company policies



  





**Employee Engagement and HR Support** 



* Help organize employee engagement activities and office events
* Respond to routine employee questions regarding attendance, leave, policies, and documentation
* Coordinate birthday, work\-anniversary, and employee\-recognition activities
* Support performance\-review and employee\-feedback processes
* Assist with exit formalities and exit interviews
* Escalate sensitive employee matters to management



  





**Reporting and Coordination** 



* Maintain HR trackers and prepare basic reports in Microsoft Excel
* Support access coordination for Ceipal ATS, LinkedIn Recruiter, Monster, Microsoft 365, and other tools
* Coordinate with finance, recruitment, administration, and management teams
* Complete assigned HR activities within agreed timelines



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce, Management, Psychology, or a related discipline
* Fresh graduates and candidates with up to one year of experience may apply
* Good verbal and written English communication skills
* Basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint
* Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn
* Ability to maintain confidentiality when handling employee information
* Comfortable speaking with candidates and employees
* Organized, dependable, and able to follow up consistently



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* MBA or PGDM in Human Resources completed or currently pursuing through distance learning
* Internship experience in HR, recruitment, administration, or employee engagement
* Familiarity with LinkedIn, Naukri, or other job portals
* Basic understanding of recruitment and employee lifecycle processes
* Candidates residing in or near Greater Noida West, Noida, Ghaziabad, or nearby locations



  





**What You Will Learn** 



* End\-to\-end internal recruitment
* Employee onboarding and offboarding
* Attendance, leave, and payroll coordination
* HR documentation and employee record management
* Employee engagement and performance coordination
* Fundamentals of US staffing operations
* Practical use of HR trackers, job portals, and applicant tracking systems



  





**Mandatory Work Requirements** 



* **This is a full\-time, on\-site position in Greater Noida West**
* **The working hours are 6:30 PM to 4:00 AM IST, Monday to Friday**
* **Candidates must be comfortable working permanently during the US/night shift**
* **This is not a remote, hybrid, rotational\-shift, or day\-shift position**
* **Candidates should consider their commute and transportation arrangements before applying**



  





**How to Apply** 




 Interested candidates may apply with their updated resume and the following information:
 


* Current location
* Educational qualification
* Any HR or recruitment internship experience
* Notice period or earliest joining date
* Expected compensation
* Confirmation of willingness to work on\-site during the permanent night shift

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.

We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

 Advisor to People Managers, their teams, and employees. You will primarily be the HR Advisor to
   

  

 assigned Business(s) / Function(s) in India region and will be part of a broader HR Advisory team
   

  

 supporting 1600\+ Global Services employees in the region.

 Operating as a key business advisor and subject matter expert with assigned business/ function(s) through business knowledge, relationship management and proactive interventions, this role is critical for creating a culture where our employees are valued members of BCG in the region and can manage their careers to meet their personal aspirations and drive outcomes in line with BCGs business objectives. This role requires extensive collaboration across the HR Business Partner, Talent partners, Core HR Delivery, Regional Partners, and Operational CoEs.
   

  

 What You'll Bring

Developing and maintaining effective business relationships with functionally aligned client groups, the HR team and broader HR community

description:
**HR Consultant** 




**Location:** 
 New Delhi, India
 



  





**About SFI Impact Foundation** 




 SFI Impact Foundation is a TCF partner organisation, driving systems\-level change through mission\-driven initiatives focused on overseas employment, tourism, and skilling and employability.
 



 We anchor and support three key initiatives:
 



 1\. GATI Foundation – Global Access to Talent from India, enabling safe, legal, and equitable overseas employment.
 



 2\. ATITHI Foundation – transforming India's tourism sector into a driver of inclusive growth and sustainability.
 



 3\. STEP Foundation – advancing India's skilling ecosystem through systems thinking and industry collaboration.
 



 4\. SEP\- transforming secondary education in India.
 



 Together, we aim to catalyze impact across livelihoods, mobility, and employability.
 



  





**Position Summary** 




 This position, in the People and Processes team, will be anchored in a few portfolio organisations. The HR Consultant will be responsible for creating and executing people processes, talent retention, and employee experience for SFI Impact Foundation.
 



 Our work is focused on employee satisfaction and building a culture of high achievement where employees can work to their full potential. The role requires supporting portfolio organisations across organisation development, talent management, performance reviews, goal\-setting, learning and development, and other areas.
 



 This is a great opportunity for those who enjoy working in a start\-up environment, enjoy building and scaling organisations, and care deeply about culture in the impact sector. Whether it involves aiding in the hiring for key roles, strategy planning to enable organisations to unlock scale, or supporting performance management for all employees, the People and Processes team works on some of the most exciting and challenging projects in the sector.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Implement HR Processes** 



* Implement HR processes that are conducive to driving a high\-performance work culture across all portfolio organisations.
* Handle the performance management cycle from start to end, and monitor timely and accurate completion of appraisals.
* Provide support to employees in applying policies that align with organisational values.



**Build High\-Performing Institutions** 



* Assist teams to plan, organise, and execute retreats, cultural activities, and engagement plans.
* Execute and coordinate learning and development programs.
* Assist and advise teams to streamline processes and empower employees to perform to their maximum potential.
* Execute cross\-learning spaces.



**Talent Management** 



* Handle the talent management cycle for portfolio organisations.
* Engage prospective candidates to keep them excited about joining.
* Ensure a smooth onboarding experience for all new employees, including consistent check\-ins and completion of all compliance and formalities.
* Resolve employee grievances and manage expectations wherever needed.
* Ensure updated data collection and timely reporting/communication wherever needed.



**Desired Qualifications, Skills and Abilities** 



* A Bachelor's or Master's degree from a top\-tier institution in human resources or a related field.
* Excellent networking and relationship\-building skills, with the ability to recognise, inspire, and connect with best\-in\-class talent.
* Excellent presentation and Excel skills, with the ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, with external audiences.
* Strong executional skills and the ability to deliver within timelines and meet deadlines.
* Ability to be effective in a fast\-paced, consensus\-based work environment.

**Building Relationships** 




 Thrives on building strong networks and nurturing relationships with high\-quality talent in the corporate and social sectors, and wants to work with top leaders in system\-change organisations to help build them from the ground up.

 Highly motivated and able to work independently toward agreed goals and targets, taking ownership of the overall HR strategy and process of the portfolio.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Food Galery is a food and grocery delivery platform connecting customers, restaurants, stores, and delivery partners through a single digital ecosystem. We are looking for a Business Analyst to help us improve business operations, understand customer and restaurant behavior, and support data\-driven decision\-making.
   

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 1\. Business \& Operations Analysis
   

  

 \- Analyze Food Galery’s daily business operations and identify areas for improvement.
   

 \- Study orders, revenue, cancellations, refunds, delivery performance, and customer activity.
   

 \- Identify operational gaps and recommend practical solutions.
   

 \- Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly business performance reports.
   

 \- Monitor important business KPIs and highlight deviations.
   

  

 2\. Restaurant \& Merchant Analysis
   

  

 \- Analyze restaurant onboarding, order volume, revenue, ratings, cancellations, and performance.
   

 \- Identify high\-performing and underperforming restaurants.
   

 \- Track restaurant activation and retention.
   

 \- Provide insights to the restaurant onboarding and sales teams.
   

 \- Help identify opportunities to increase restaurant orders and revenue.
   

  

 3\. Customer Analysis
   

  

 \- Analyze customer acquisition, orders, repeat purchases, cancellations, and retention.
   

 \- Identify customer behavior and purchasing patterns.
   

 \- Analyze customer complaints and support data.
   

 \- Recommend strategies to improve customer satisfaction and retention.
   

  

 4\. Delivery \& Operations Analysis
   

  

 \- Monitor delivery times, order allocation, cancellations, failed deliveries, and delivery partner performance.
   

 \- Identify reasons for delivery delays and operational failures.
   

 \- Work with the operations team to improve delivery efficiency.
   

 \- Analyze performance by city, area, restaurant, and delivery partner.
   

  

 5\. Product \& App Analysis
   

  

 \- Work with the Product and Technology teams to identify business requirements.
   

 \- Understand problems faced by customers, restaurants, and delivery partners.
   

 \- Convert business requirements into clear functional requirements.
   

 \- Assist in developing and improving Food Galery app and website features.
   

 \- Participate in requirement gathering, testing, and feature validation.
   

 \- Identify opportunities to improve user experience.
   

  

 6\. Data \& Reporting
   

  

 \- Create dashboards and reports for management.
   

 \- Analyze business data using Excel, SQL, Power BI/Tableau or similar tools.
   

 \- Maintain accurate business reports and datasets.
   

 \- Track trends and provide actionable insights.
   

 \- Present findings to management and relevant departments.
   

  

 7\. Cross\-Functional Coordination
   

  

 \- Work closely with Sales, Restaurant Onboarding, KYC, Operations, Customer Support, Finance, Marketing, Product, and Technology teams.
   

 \- Coordinate with different teams to understand business problems.
   

 \- Follow up on improvement initiatives and measure their results.
   

 \- Communicate analytical findings clearly to both technical and non\-technical teams.
   

  

**Key KPIs to Monitor**
 \- Total Orders
   

 \- Gross Order Value / GMV
   

 \- Revenue
   

 \- Average Order Value (AOV)
   

 \- Customer Acquisition
   

 \- Customer Retention
   

 \- Repeat Order Rate
   

 \- Cancellation Rate
   

 \- Refund Rate
   

 \- Restaurant Activation Rate
   

 \- Restaurant Retention
   

 \- Delivery Time
   

 \- Order Success Rate
   

 \- Customer Complaints
   

 \- Delivery Partner Performance
   

 \- Marketing ROI
   

 \- Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
   

  

**Requirements**
 \- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field.
   

  

 \- Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
   

  

 \- Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
   

  

 \- Basic to intermediate knowledge of SQL is preferred.
   

  

 \- Knowledge of Power BI, Tableau, or other BI tools is an advantage.
   

  

 \- Understanding of KPIs, dashboards, business reporting, and data analysis.
   

  

 \- Good communication and presentation skills.
   

  

 \- Ability to work with multiple departments and manage priorities.
   

  

 \- Experience in food delivery, e\-commerce, logistics, fintech, or marketplace platforms is an advantage.
   

  

**Preferred Skills**
**Technical** 
 :
   

  

 \- Advanced Excel
   

 \- SQL
   

 \- Power BI / Tableau
   

 \- Data visualization
   

 \- Reporting \& dashboards
   

 \- Basic statistical analysis
   

  

  

  

 What You'll Do at Food Galery
   

  

 As a Business Analyst, you will play an important role in helping Food Galery understand what is happening in the business, why it is happening, and what we should do next.
   

  

 You will turn business and operational data into actionable insights that help Food Galery increase orders, improve restaurant performance, reduce cancellations, improve delivery efficiency, and create a better customer experience.

title: Product Analyst
description:
**Position Summary**
 The Product Analyst supports the Product Team and their client business processes and operations by maintaining and enhancing existing products and creating new ones. This role requires a strong analytical mindset and technical expertise to work with large datasets, derive insights, and deliver value to stakeholders as well as product management and development experience. The Product Analyst combines operational, technical, and analytic skills with problem\-solving and communication abilities. You will collaborate with and work closely with Senior Data Analyst and/or Product Owner(s) to ensure successful project execution.
   

  

**Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:**
* Operational Execution:
+ Understand and communicate client business needs and issues, operating rules, data structures, and standard operating procedures.
+ Execute and suggest improvements to pre\-defined operational procedures.
+ Implement process improvement in operational workflows, working with Senior Data Analysts and Product Owners.
+ Assist Product Owners to streamline the ideas to development processes, and the technical requirements processes.

* Product Development:
+ Enhance and maintain data products by understanding the data, product(s)/offering(s), client needs, and business goals.
+ Collaborate with stakeholders regarding business objectives.
+ Support product management with product development, and execution.
+ Partner with Product management to create, maintain and update roadmap documentation
+ Assist teams towards common objectives and document the solutions/decisions made.
+ Create technical requirements, user stories and test plans as part of an Agile methodological approach.


* Data Analysis:
+ Compare datasets / various inputs to ensure data quality and derive actionable insights.
+ Apply quality checks and validations to the product delivery, reporting results and elaborative summary for internal team and important stakeholders.

* Stakeholder collaboration:
+ Coordinate with stakeholders across different time zones to ensure smooth working within timelines.
+ Assist engineering teams with knowledge transfer and testing of new operational procedures and enhancements.
+ Facilitate knowledge transfer and overall product knowledge for engineering, Engagement and other teams.
+ Partner with stakeholders e.g. Engagement and Product Owners to understand client business needs and pain points with the intention to write user stories that address those needs.
+ Work closely with product team: Owners, developers and testers to ensure that written requirements are clearly stated, and comprehensive.

* Knowledge development:
+ Build subject matter expertise in operational processes, data tools, content, and necessary technology, and Scrum / Agile methodologies
+ Remain updated on tools, techniques, and working models to enhance processes.
+ Develop functional understanding of the product offering via the technology and deployment stack, to facilitate writing effective user stories, requirements and user acceptance criteria.


* Project Management:
+ Work on multiple client tasks simultaneously, strengthening analytical, task management, and communication skills.
+ Keep track of unplanned internal and clients’ tasks arising from any developments to existing or new products.
+ Maximize time management skills to balance workload in order to complete multiple deadline driven projects with a minimum of supervisory input.

* Coordinate meetings and prepare status update documentation / meetings for ongoing projects Research and Problem\-Solving
+ Conduct secondary research e.g. marketplace conditions, competitive environment, best practices to keep the product quality best\-in class while being able to address clients’ questions related to the same.
+ Coordinate and co lead design sessions to document feature requirements and guide stakeholders towards decision\-making.
+ Investigate issues and recommend solutions to improve processes.


**Qualifications**
**Minimum Required** 
 \-
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Electronics/Communication, Electrical Engineering, or related fields.
* 1 – 2 years of experience using data mining languages/tools like SQL (for analysts), Excel. Exposure to stored procedures is a plus.
* Detail orientation with a strong focus on quality, analytics, and operations.
* Experience in Pharmaceuticals, Managed Markets Consulting or Analytics Consulting with broad based experience in, managed care, and/or analytics will be an advantage.
* Proven ability to work with global teams across different time\-zones.


**Preferred**
* Masters in these disciplines OR MBA/PGDM/Equivalent
* Experience in product development, management, or operations.
* Strong knowledge of US Healthcare, payer/provider datasets, and managed care analytics.
* Familiarity with tools like Retool, Power BI and Power Query.


**Competencies**
* Operational Outlook:
+ Translate macro tasks into actionable steps and document, execute, and track them efficiently.
+ Seek opportunities for automation and process improvements while transferring knowledge to team members.

* Analytical Skills:
+ Thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment with excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
+ Strong problem\-solving and critical\-thinking capabilities.

* Communication Skills: Written, Verbal, and Presentation.
+ Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills.
+ Ability to simplify complex processes for diverse audiences and respond promptly to inquiries.

* Collaboration and Teamwork:
+ Work effectively across teams and cultures, sharing constructive feedback to achieve team goals.
+ Demonstrate sound judgement, task management, and conflict resolution skills.

title: Business Analyst/POPM
description:
**IT BUSINESS ANALYST**
**ENTERPRISE DATA \& ANALYTICS**
**CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER** 
 . It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire, entertain and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.
   

  

**The Team**
 As part of the Global Technology Organization, the aim of Enterprise Data and Analytics (ED\&A) team is to enable Mattel as a data\-driven organization, by
   

  

* Delivering high quality data for self\-service analytics and data science via a modern data infrastructure that supports our business partners and aligns with business strategy.
* Ensuring data quality through governance and data management processes.
* Maximizing the availability of data.
* Providing the infrastructure, tools, and knowledge to add value to data.
* Promoting enterprise\-wide adoption through sustainable education and training programs on our tools and data.


**The Opportunity**
 Mattel is seeking a Business Analyst, based out of our Technology \& Innovation Center in Hyderabad, India, reporting to the IT Director for Enterprise Data and Analytics. The person filling this role will act as an interface between business and technical groups \- eliciting requirements from the business, designing analytics solutions and/or data models from a business user perspective, and working with our development teams to implement them – taking the role of a Product Manager in a SAFe Agile working model. This person will also lead and participate in data governance processes, and as a subject matter expert, will be able to provide training, support and assistance to business users on our data and tools.
   

  

**What Your Impact Will Be**
* Act as a Product Manager in a SAFe Agile working model on Enterprise Data and Analytics projects, primarily to deliver business\-ready data sets for end users to utilize for reporting and analytics.
* Work collaboratively within IT and across global teams, ensuring timely delivery of projects and enhancements while adhering to budgets.
* Gather and analyze requirements, documenting acceptance criteria for product features and translating business problems into clear, actionable tasks.
* Independently design and deliver analytics and reporting solutions from a business user perspective, coordinating closely with development teams to implement initiatives.
* Partner with business stakeholders to document processes and identify improvement opportunities, actively providing suggestions for enhanced efficiency and effectiveness.
* Create and execute test plans while coordinating testing and implementation efforts with business users to ensure smooth project delivery.
* Participate in data governance initiatives by contributing to the maintenance of business glossaries, data transformation rules, and data categorization practices.
* Identify data quality issues and take ownership of implementing exception reporting to address gaps.
* Maintain and share updated documentation with the user community to ensure proper understanding and adoption of implemented solutions.
* Act as a point of contact and trusted “Face of IT” for business partners, independently addressing challenges and articulating business needs effectively.
* Support the design and successful implementation of analytics or reporting solutions in collaboration with business partners.
* Manage analytical troubleshooting and work with production support teams on resolving issues for project deliverables or production systems.
* Provide training to business users on our data and reporting/visualization tools (ThoughtSpot, Tableau, IBM Cognos Analytics, Google BigQuery, Collibra).
* Actively contribute to adding value to business partners’ organizations by proactively identifying opportunities for improvement.


**What It’s Like To Work Here**
 We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower the next generation to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors
   

  

* We collaborate Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
* We innovate At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
* We execute We are a performance driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best in class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.


**What We’re Looking For**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business or related field. MBA is a plus.
* 2\+ years of experience as a business analyst, data product manager or in a similar position.
* Professional level understanding of general business processes and functions, with capability to analyze and document proposals for data products aligned with organizational goals and reference architecture.
* Demonstrable experience in working with data and databases required – Google Cloud Platform/BigQuery would be a significant advantage.
* Demonstrable experience in reporting/visualization tools required \- ThoughtSpot, Tableau and/or IBM Cognos Analytics would be a significant advantage.
* Knowledge of data governance practices and data management tools, particularly Collibra, would be a significant advantage.
* Familiarity with SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) principles and practices, including an understanding of Agile methodologies, ceremonies, and tools. Certification would be a significant advantage.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
* Energy, integrity, tenacity, and passion in your daily work life.
* Good interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills.
* Self\-motivated and able to work with minimal supervision.
* Effective analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to multitask and prioritize appropriately.
* Ability to work in a global environment.
* Ability to effectively interact and communicate with stakeholders.
* Willingness to roll up your sleeves and do what it takes to get the job done.
* Fluent business English required, both written and verbal.


**Who We Are**
 Mattel is a leading global toy company and owner of one of the strongest catalogs of children’s and family entertainment franchises in the world. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire, entertain and develop children through play. We engage consumers through our portfolio of iconic brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher\-Price, American Girl, Thomas \& Friends, UNO and MEGA, as well as other popular intellectual properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include film and television content, gaming, music and live events. We operate in 35 locations and our products are available in more than 150 countries in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering children to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.
   

  

 Visit us at https //jobs.mattel.com/ and www.instagram.com/MattelCareers .
   

  

 Mattel is an Equal Opportunity Employer where we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day. We welcome all job seekers including minorities, females, individuals with disabilities, and those of all sexual orientations and gender identities.
