More than 150 clients across the globe trust NeoXam to run their most critical workflows.
   

  

 As part of our expanding NeoXam as a Service (NXaaS) operating model, we are looking for a motivated and technically strong
 **Technical Support \& Cloud Consultant** 
 to join our Indian team. This is a hands\-on role that blends client\-facing support with cloud infrastructure ownership, making it ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of financial software and modern cloud operations. As we continue to grow our global SaaS footprint, this role will evolve alongside increasing monitoring, observability, and operational responsibilities. NXaaS operates a follow\-the\-sun support model across APAC, EMEA, and the Americas \- this role covers Indian business hours.
   

  

 You will support NeoXam's core product suite, including:
   

  

* NeoXam DataHub – a centralized data management platform purpose\-built for financial institutions, serving as a hub for all data consumed or produced across the enterprise.
* NeoXam IBOR – a uniquely independent and flexible Investment Book of Record, providing asset managers with a single, continuously updated source for positions, valuations, and forecasts across multiple views.
* NeoXam Aro – an intelligent, low\-code reconciliation and data lifecycle platform that transforms fragmented, manual processes into a unified, AI\-powered solution.
* NeoXam Impress – an end\-to\-end solution for client, digital, and regulatory reporting, covering data integration, performance calculations, production workflows, and data visualization.


**Your Missions**
 Serve as the first technical point of contact for NeoXam's global clients, covering Australian business hours within NeoXam's follow\-the\-sun support model and ensuring seamless handoff with APAC and EMEA counterparts.
   

  

* Triage, analyze, and own support tickets end\-to\-end \- from anomaly identification and root cause investigation through to resolution, including software\-level fixes in Java and escalation to R\&D when required.
* Review and respond to monitoring alerts and operational dashboards, identifying and acting on anomalies before they impact clients; monitor and manage cloud resources (primarily AWS) to ensure performance and availability against production SLAs.
* Troubleshoot and enhance cloud\-based deployments; implement patches and configuration fixes; support data migration and cloud onboarding initiatives in collaboration with clients and internal teams.
* Manage technical installations, upgrades, and environment refreshes for client\-facing deployments; maintain internal environment replicas for issue reproduction and testing.
* Collaborate with the Paris R\&D team and global support counterparts to resolve complex issues and contribute to the NXaaS knowledge base.
* Support pre\-sales and implementation teams on technical matters; participate in client calls, project updates, and cross\-team coordination.


**Your Profile**
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
   

  

* 5\-8 years of experience in technical support, implementation, or infrastructure roles within financial software or the banking/financial services industry.
* Solid working knowledge of AWS (EC2, RDS, ALB, S3, CloudWatch, VPC, IAM); AWS certification is a plus.
* Proficient in Java application troubleshooting \- log analysis, memory management, thread dumps, and configuration.
* Ability to diagnose and interpret common database performance issues \- including slow queries, missing indexes, lock contention, and execution plan analysis. Experience with Oracle and/or PostgreSQL query tuning is strongly preferred.
* Experience with relational databases \- Oracle, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server.
* Scripting ability (Shell, Python, or equivalent) for automation and diagnostics.
* Familiarity with web application servers (Tomcat, JBoss, or WebSphere) and messaging systems (IBM MQ, Kafka, or equivalent).
* Working knowledge of XML, REST/SOAP web services, and API integrations.
* EKS (Elastic Kubernetes Service): Strong understanding of Kubernetes fundamentals and practical experience with Amazon EKS for container orchestration from support perspective.
* Monitoring \& Observability Tools: Hands\-on experience with solutions such as Datadog, Grafana, CloudWatch or similar platforms for system monitoring, logging, and performance visualization.
* Familiarity with Git and standard version control workflows.
* Hands\-on experience with Linux/Unix environments and command\-line operations.
* Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodology and ITIL support practices.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to manage client relationships professionally and independently.
* Self\-motivated, proactive, and collaborative — comfortable working across time zones with global teams.


**Why NeoXam**
 At NeoXam, we love people who are curious, involved, and self\-driven. We encourage creativity and strive to promote an environment and culture based on personal growth and development. We want you to express your full potential and become a major contributor to our continued growth across India and beyond.

Soon, self\-driving cars will reduce congestion and improve road safety. AI travel agents will know your preferences and arrange every detail of your family vacation. And medical instruments will read and understand patient DNA to detect and treat early signs of cancer. Where engines made us stronger and powered the first industrial revolution, AI will make us smarter and power the next. What will make this intelligent industrial revolution possible? A new computing model — GPU deep learning — that enables computers to learn from data and write software that is too complex for people to code.

title: GenAI Engineer
description:
Job Description
 



 We are looking for an experienced
 **GenAI Engineer** 
 with strong hands\-on expertise in designing, developing, and deploying
 **end\-to\-end Generative AI solutions** 
 . The candidate will be responsible for taking GenAI use cases from
 **problem understanding and solution design through development, integration, testing, deployment, and production support** 
 .
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Design and develop end\-to\-end
 **Generative AI and LLM\-based applications** 
 .
* Understand business requirements and translate them into practical GenAI solutions.
* Build and implement
 **RAG pipelines** 
 , knowledge\-based applications, and semantic search solutions.
* Develop
 **AI agents and agentic workflows** 
 using LLMs, tools, APIs, and enterprise systems.
* Implement prompt engineering, function/tool calling, structured outputs, memory, and context management.
* Integrate GenAI applications with
 **REST APIs, databases, third\-party services, and enterprise applications** 
 .
* Work with structured and unstructured data, documents, and enterprise knowledge bases.
* Evaluate and improve LLM applications for
 **accuracy, relevance, latency, reliability, and hallucination** 
 .
* Optimize prompts, retrieval pipelines, model selection, and overall application performance.
* Develop scalable and production\-ready GenAI applications.
* Deploy, monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain GenAI solutions in production.
* Collaborate with business, product, and engineering teams to identify and implement new GenAI use cases.



 Required Technical Skills
 


* Strong hands\-on experience with
 **Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs)** 
 .
* Experience with OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or similar LLM platforms.
* Strong knowledge of
 **RAG, embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and retrieval pipelines** 
 .
* Experience building
 **AI agents / Agentic AI applications** 
 .
* Experience with
 **LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent frameworks** 
 .
* Strong
 **Python** 
 programming skills.
* Experience with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, SQL, and database integrations.
* Knowledge of prompt engineering, function calling, tool calling, and structured outputs.
* Experience with LLM evaluation and optimization.
* Strong software engineering, debugging, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience with Git/GitHub and production development practices.



 Cloud \& Deployment
 


* Experience with
 **AWS, Azure, or GCP** 
 .
* Docker and containerization.
* API/application deployment.
* CI/CD fundamentals.
* Monitoring and observability for production applications.



 Preferred Skills
 


* Multi\-agent systems
* MCP and tool\-based AI systems
* AI\-powered business process automation
* Document AI / OCR
* Conversational AI / Voice AI
* Fine\-tuning or model adaptation
* Enterprise GenAI implementations
* SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, CRM, or other enterprise integrations
* Kubernetes / cloud\-native deployments



 Candidate Profile
 


* **3–5 years of relevant software, AI, or GenAI engineering experience** 
 .
* Strong hands\-on experience building
 **real\-world GenAI applications** 
 , not just POCs or prompt\-based solutions.
* Ability to independently own the
 **complete GenAI lifecycle:**



**Business Problem → Solution Architecture → LLM/RAG/Agent Design → Development → Integration → Evaluation → Deployment → Production** 



* Strong ability to learn and work with rapidly evolving GenAI technologies.
* Candidates with demonstrated experience in
 **building and deploying production GenAI solutions** 
 will be preferred.

title: Low Latency Developer
description:
Tower is home to some of the world’s best systematic trading and engineering talent. We empower portfolio managers to build their teams and strategies independently while providing the economies of scale that come from a large, global organization.
   

  

 Engineers thrive at Tower while developing electronic trading infrastructure at a world class level. Our engineers solve challenging problems in the realms of low\-latency programming, FPGA technology, hardware acceleration and machine learning. Our ongoing investment in top engineering talent and technology ensures our platform remains unmatched in terms of functionality, scalability and performance.
   

  

 At Tower, every employee plays a role in our success. Our Business Support teams are essential to building and maintaining the platform that powers everything we do — combining market access, data, compute, and research infrastructure with risk management, compliance, and a full suite of business services. Our Business Support teams enable our trading and engineering teams to perform at their best.
   

  

 At Tower, employees will find a stimulating, results\-oriented environment where highly intelligent and motivated colleagues inspire each other to reach their greatest potential.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
 The Low Latency Software Developer's responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Designing, developing and implementing efficient code for various components of the team's low latency, high throughput production trading and research systems
* Developing systems that provide easy, highly efficient access to historical market data and trading simulations
* Developing, augmenting and calibrating exchange simulators
* Coordinating with traders and senior developers globally to understand trading problems and develop scalable software solutions
* Building risk\-management and performance\-tracking tools
* Staying up to date on state\-of\-the\-art technologies in high performance computing industry


**Qualifications:**
 The ideal candidate will have at least 3\-5 years of experience in the finance industry along with:
   

  

* Software development experience as demonstrated through course work, research projects, or open source activities, preferably in C\+\+
* A bachelor's degree or equivalent in computer science or a related field
* Knowledge of Linux
* Strong background in C/C\+\+ and Python
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving abilities
* The ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast\-paced environment
* The willingness to take on tasks both big and small
* Excellent communication skills and fluency in English


**Benefits :**
 Tower’s headquarters are in the historic Equitable Building, right in the heart of NYC’s Financial District and our impact is global, with over a dozen offices around the world.
   

  

 At Tower, we believe work should be both challenging and enjoyable. That is why we foster a culture where smart, driven people thrive – without the egos. Our open concept workplace, casual dress code, and well\-stocked kitchens reflect the value we place on a friendly, collaborative environment where everyone is respected, and great ideas win.
   

  

 Our benefits include:
   

  

* Generous paid time off policies
* Savings plans and other financial wellness tools available in each region
* Hybrid working opportunities
* Free breakfast, lunch, and snacks daily
* In\-office wellness experiences and reimbursement for select wellness expenses (e.g., gym, personal training and more)
* Company\-sponsored sports teams and fitness events (JPM Corporate Challenge, Cycle for Survival, Wall Street Rides FAR and more)
* Volunteer opportunities and charitable giving
* Social events, happy hours, treats, and celebrations throughout the year
* Workshops and continuous learning opportunities


 At Tower, you’ll find a collaborative and welcoming culture, a diverse team and a workplace that values both performance and enjoyment. No unnecessary hierarchy. No ego. Just great people doing great work – together.
   

  

 Tower Research Capital is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Software Development Engineer III - Content Hub (Mobile Flutter)
description:
**About HighLevel**
 HighLevel is an AI\-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150\+ countries, fueling community\-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
   

  

 To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
   

  

 Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2\.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250\+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long\-term scalability.
   

  

**Our People**
 With over 2,000 team members across 10\+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote\-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.
   

  

**Our Impact**
 Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1\.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
   

  

 Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts
   

  

**About The Role**
 We’re looking for a Software Engineer with 3\+ years of experience to join our Client Portal Mobile Team, which enables creators and businesses to deliver rich, branded experiences through our mobile app. The Content Hub connects millions of users across courses, communities, bookings, and payments—helping creators manage their entire business in one seamless platform.
   

  

 As a Mobile Engineer, you’ll focus on developing new features, optimising performance, and enhancing the overall reliability of the Mobile App to strengthen its reputation among users. You’ll work closely with product, design, and backend teams to improve app stability, deliver delightful user experiences, and build features that scale across thousands of businesses and millions of users. This role is ideal for engineers passionate about mobile excellence and performance\-driven product development.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Contribute to the design and development of high\-performance, scalable mobile software, ensuring long\-term stability and maintainability.
* Build and ship production\-grade Flutter features used daily by millions of users across diverse industries and use cases.
* Collaborate with product, design, and backend teams to deliver end\-to\-end, customer\-facing features that improve the app’s performance, usability, and reputation.
* Develop and maintain shared tooling, frameworks, and libraries that streamline mobile development and improve developer velocity.
* Measure and improve app performance, responsiveness, and reliability through modern observability, profiling, and debugging practices.
* Write clean, testable, and maintainable code, leveraging AI\-assisted tools to accelerate development and testing while maintaining code quality.
* Stay current with Flutter best practices, mobile architecture patterns, and performance optimisation techniques to continuously improve user experience.
* Stay on the bleeding edge of AI/LLM advances, Flutter best practices, and scalable mobile architecture patterns — and share insights with the team.


**Requirements**
* 4\+ years of professional experience in software engineering, including 2\+ years of Flutter and Dart in production environments.
* Strong understanding of mobile app architecture, widget lifecycle, rendering, and advanced state management techniques (e.g., Provider, Bloc, Riverpod, MobX).
* Experience integrating and optimizing RESTful APIs and managing app communication with scalable backend systems.
* Proven ability to identify and fix performance bottlenecks, memory issues, and frame drops across iOS and Android.
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, build automation, and testing frameworks for mobile applications.
* Familiarity with cross\-platform optimisations, native integrations (iOS/Android), and reducing app size.
* Strong fundamentals in debugging, profiling, and improving core app metrics such as startup time, crash rate, and responsiveness.
* Effective collaboration and communication skills — able to work closely with cross\-functional teams in a distributed environment.
* Passion for building polished, performant, and reliable mobile experiences that delight users at scale.


**EEO Statement:**
 At HighLevel, we value diversity. In fact, we understand it makes our organisation stronger. We are committed to inclusive hiring/promotion practices that evaluate skill sets, abilities, and qualifications without regard to any characteristic unrelated to performing the job at the highest level. Our objective is to foster an environment where really talented employees from all walks of life can be their true and whole selves, cherished and welcomed for their differences while providing excellent service to our clients and learning from one another along the way! Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.
   

  

 We encourage you to review our Privacy Polic y before submitting your application.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Software Engineer (Java and React)

 Let’s be \#BrilliantTogether.

title: Business R&D Senior Professional
description:
**The Opportunity**
**Hitachi Energy India Development Centre (IDC)** 
 is a research and development facility with around 500 R\&D engineers, specialists, and experts, who focus on creating and sustaining digital solutions, new products and technology. This includes product integration, testing, cybersecurity, and certification.  The
 **India Development Centre** 
 is situated in Chennai and Bangalore.
 **IDC** 
 collaborates with the R\&D and Research centres of Hitachi Energy, which are spread across more than 15 locations throughout 12 countries. In the past 20 years,
 **IDC** 
 has secured more than 200 international papers and 150\+ patents.
   

  

 Hitachi Energy is the world leader in Power Quality Solutions (PQS). Hitachi Energy was the first to introduce Flexible AC Transmission System (FACTS) technology to the power industry and has delivered solutions for more than 50 years now. Hitachi energy has several solutions that enhance the security, capacity, and flexibility of power transmission systems. These solutions enable power grid owners to increase existing transmission network capacity while maintaining or improving the operating margins necessary for grid stability.  Hitachi Energy has the full FACTS portfolio and in\-house manufacturing of key components. Our PQS R\&D group in Chennai is focusing on developing and evaluating functionalities for STATCOM, STATIC VAR Compensator (SVC), Series Compensator and Synchronous Condensers for utilities and industries. Hitachi Energy uses a very high\-end system for its control, protection and monitoring of FACTS solution called MACH (Modular Advanced Control for HVDC and FACTS). This is a system of computers built with state\-of\-the\-art electronics, microprocessors and digital signal processors.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* To research and develop the control philosophy for new and evolving technologies / to improve the control performance of any existing technologies in power quality domain.
* To implement, verify \& validate the developed control and protection logic in MACH control system thereby creating a rigorously tested, stable baseline solution which later can be tailored to meet specific customers’ requirements.
* To perform simulation of control logics and verification on control logics in software in loop environment (with the help of tools including but not limited to MATLAB scripts, MATLAB Simulink and PSCAD)
* To perform validation testing of the whole FACTS system in a hardware in loop environment with real time digital simulator setup. (ex: RTDS interfaced with MACH system)
* Traveling sites to support various R\&D activities or troubleshooting ongoing FACTS projects.
* To be responsible for the deliverables assigned in terms of quality, on time delivery and proactive communication of progress to the R\&D project management, work\-stream lead and other stakeholders.
* Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Living with Hitachi Energy’s core values safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.


**Your Background**
* Required ME Power Systems / ME Power Electronics with 0\-3 years of Experience.
* Any experience or expertise in understanding / modelling of voltage sourced converters (VSC) for HVDC, FACTS is an added advantage or in simulation tools such as EMTDC / PSCAD, PSS/E, RTDS and MATLAB are an added advantage.
* Must have strong understanding of various power system concepts including knowledge of performing power system studies like load flow, short circuit, transient stability and switching transients for utility / industrial systems.
* Must have good understanding of control design concepts of various controllers and power electronics application in power system (HV/EHV levels).
* Good knowledge of Power Systems equipment and their purpose. Example, Power Transformers, Capacitors, Reactors, Instrument Transformer and measuring equipment, Circuit Breakers, Disconnectors and Surge Arrestors.


**More About Us**
 Excited about a new opportunity? If this sounds like you, we’d like to see your application! Our selection process is ongoing, so don’t wait—apply today!

title: Product Manager : Consumer Experience
description:
**Product Manager : Consumer Experience** 




  





**We’re looking for a Product Manager who turns customer understanding into shipped outcomes.** 




 MyYogaTeacher helps people across the world improve their health and well being through live, personalized yoga. We connect students with experienced yoga teachers in India for 1\-on\-1 sessions designed around their goals, lifestyle, health conditions, and preferences.
 



 Our platform has served 200K\+ customers and supports thousands of live sessions across time zones, devices, payment systems, and customer journeys.
 



 We are now entering a phase where speed, clarity, and execution matter more than ever.
 



 We are looking for a hands\-on Product Manager who can speak with students, understand their real motivations, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and work closely with design, engineering, analytics, sales, and operations to ship meaningful improvements quickly.
 



 This is not a role for someone who only writes requirements, manages Jira, or waits for complete data before making a decision.
 



 You will be expected to understand the customer, form a point of view, bring teams together, and drive the product from problem discovery through execution and measurable impact.
 



  





**What You’ll Own** 




**Customer and Persona Understanding** 



* Develop a deep understanding of our students—their goals, anxieties, motivations, objections, habits, and reasons for choosing personalized yoga.
* Regularly speak with prospective students, active customers, churned customers, teachers, sales teams, and customer support teams.
* Convert customer conversations, behavioral data, support tickets, sales calls, and session feedback into clear product insights.
* Build and continuously refine customer personas and journey maps based on evidence rather than assumptions.
* Understand the underlying job the customer is hiring MyYogaTeacher to do—not merely the feature they are requesting.
* Ensure that product decisions remain connected to why MyYogaTeacher exists: helping people build healthier, happier, and more sustainable lives and identify ambivalence.



  





**Product Discovery and Decision Making** 



* Identify high impact opportunities across acquisition, trial, conversion, onboarding, engagement, retention, referrals, and reactivation.
* Clearly define the customer problem, target persona, expected behavior change, and desired business outcome before proposing a solution.
* Form strong product hypotheses using qualitative insights, product analytics, market understanding, and business context.
* Make thoughtful decisions even when information is incomplete or circumstances are changing.
* Distinguish between decisions that require deeper research and decisions that can be made quickly and reversed later.
* Maintain a clear product decision log so teams understand what was decided, why it was decided, and what assumptions are being tested.
* Challenge weak assumptions, unnecessary complexity, and solutions that do not address the underlying customer problem.



  





**Execution and Delivery** 



* Take end to end ownership of product initiatives from problem discovery to launch, adoption, measurement, and iteration.
* Translate product opportunities into clear requirements, user journeys, success metrics, edge cases, and acceptance criteria.
* Work closely with design and engineering to reduce ambiguity and unblock decisions quickly.
* Break large initiatives into smaller releases that allow the team to learn and deliver customer value sooner.
* Participate actively throughout development instead of handing over requirements and waiting for completion.
* Review product builds continuously, identify gaps early, and ensure that the final experience solves the intended problem.
* Drive weekly execution across multiple product initiatives while maintaining clarity on priorities and outcomes.
* Follow through after launch to measure adoption, identify friction, and improve the product based on actual customer behavior.



  





**Product Analytics and Business Impact** 



* Define measurable outcomes for every major product initiative.
* Use funnel analysis, cohort analysis, customer segmentation, experiment results, and qualitative feedback to understand product performance.
* Monitor key metrics across trial completion, trial\-to\-paid conversion, onboarding, session attendance, engagement, retention, referrals, and customer satisfaction.
* Investigate unexpected changes in customer behavior instead of relying only on dashboard\-level reporting.
* Partner with analytics and engineering teams to improve the quality and usefulness of product data.
* Communicate whether a product initiative worked, what was learned, and what should happen next.



  





**Cross\-Functional Leadership** 



* Bring together engineering, design, analytics, sales, marketing, teacher operations, and customer support around a shared understanding of the customer problem.
* Communicate product decisions clearly and directly across technical and non\-technical teams.
* Resolve ambiguity and disagreements by returning the discussion to customer evidence, strategic priorities, and expected outcomes.
* Conduct product demonstrations and training for teams responsible for launching, selling, supporting, or operating new experiences.
* Ensure that teams understand not only what is being built, but why it matters.
* Take accountability for the outcome without blaming dependencies, processes, or other functions when execution becomes difficult.



  





**AI\-First Product Management** 



* Use AI tools as part of your daily product workflow—not as an occasional experiment.
* Apply AI to accelerate customer research synthesis, product analysis, competitive research, requirement development, prototyping, test\-case thinking, and documentation.
* Use AI to explore more alternatives and move faster while continuing to apply strong product judgment.
* Help improve how the broader product and engineering organization uses AI to increase execution speed and decision quality.



  





**What You Bring** 



* 3–6 years of hands\-on product management experience, preferably in a consumer internet, marketplace, subscription, health, wellness, education, or engagement\-driven product.
* Demonstrated experience owning meaningful product initiatives from discovery through launch and iteration.
* Strong understanding of customer personas, user behavior, funnels, lifecycle journeys, and consumer decision making.
* Experience using qualitative research and quantitative data together to make product decisions.
* Ability to write clear product requirements while avoiding excessive documentation and process.
* Strong product judgment and the confidence to make decisions without waiting for perfect information.
* Experience working closely with engineering, design, analytics, operations, sales, or customer facing teams.
* Comfort reviewing interfaces, customer journeys, data, workflows, and edge cases in detail.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* A bachelor’s degree in engineering, technology, design, business, or a related discipline. Exceptional product experience is more important than the specific degree.



  





**What Makes You Stand Out** 



* You regularly speak with customers instead of relying only on dashboards, second hand feedback, or market reports.
* You can explain the customer persona, the problem, the business impact, and the product decision in simple language.
* You have examples of making a difficult product decision quickly and taking responsibility for the outcome.
* You know when to research further and when to stop discussing and start executing.
* You can identify the smallest useful version of an idea and get it into customers’ hands quickly.
* You have improved conversion, activation, engagement, retention, or customer satisfaction through products you personally own.
* You are comfortable going deep into product details without losing sight of the larger customer and business outcome.
* You question assumptions respectfully and do not allow unresolved ambiguity to slow the team indefinitely.
* You proactively follow up, close loops, and move work forward without requiring repeated reminders.
* You adapt quickly when customer behavior, technology, business conditions, or company priorities change.
* You use AI tools meaningfully to improve the speed and quality of your work.
* You care deeply about health, behavior change, yoga, wellness, or helping people build sustainable habits.



  





**This Role May Not Be Right for You If** 



* You prefer strategy and presentations over direct involvement in execution.
* You consider writing requirements to be the end of product ownership.
* You wait for complete data, perfect alignment, or detailed instructions before making decisions.
* You rarely speak directly with customers.
* You need a large team or extensive processes to move an initiative forward.
* You measure success by the number of features launched rather than changes in customer or business outcomes.
* You avoid difficult conversations or allow important decisions to remain unresolved.
* You believe product management is primarily about managing backlogs, meetings, and timelines.



  





**How We Work** 



* Small, high output teams with low bureaucracy and high ownership.
* Product, design, engineering, analytics, and operations work closely from discovery through launch.
* We ship frequently, learn from customer behavior, and improve continuously.
* We expect clear thinking, direct communication, and fast follow\-through.
* Customer conversations are part of the job, not a separate research activity.
* AI tooling is embedded into how we research, decide, document, build, test, and learn.
* Titles matter less than ownership, judgment, and measurable impact.



  





 Learn more at myyogateacher.com

description:

 is hiring a
 **Lead Product Manager**
* Are you passionate about building products that solve real customer problems?
* Do you thrive at the intersection of business, technology, and customer experience?
* Are you excited about driving product strategy and delivering measurable business outcomes?


**Well, this may be the role for you. Ready to make your mark?**
 In this role, you will own and drive the strategy, roadmap, and execution of marketplace for one of ADP’s HCM offerings. You will work cross\-functionally with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, and Operations teams to identify opportunities, validate solutions, and deliver products that create value for our clients and business.
   

  

 No two days are the same. You may spend one day analyzing customer insights and market trends, another prioritizing features with engineering teams, and the next aligning stakeholders on product direction. From product discovery through launch and optimization, you'll play a key role in creating solutions that improve customer outcomes and support business growth.
   

  

 To thrive in this role, you'll need a strong foundation in product management, customer\-centric thinking, and data\-driven decision\-making. You'll bring experience defining product strategies, managing roadmaps, and influencing cross\-functional teams. Our most successful Product Managers are curious, adaptable, analytical, and passionate about solving customer challenges through technology.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Product Strategy \& Vision**
* Define and execute product strategy aligned with business goals and customer needs.
* Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and customer discovery activities.
* Identify opportunities for innovation and business growth.
* Build and maintain a product roadmap based on customer value and business priorities.


**Product Development \& Execution**
* Gather, analyze, and prioritize product requirements; create specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Collaborate with Engineering and Design throughout the development lifecycle
* Leverage available tools to drive AI adoption into the product development lifecycle


**Customer \& Market Focus**
* Engage with customers to understand their pain points and requirements.
* Analyze customer feedback, usage metrics, and industry trends.
* Translate customer insights into impactful product features and enhancements.
* Ensure product decisions are data\-driven and aligned with market needs.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Partner with Engineering, Operations, and go\-to\-market teams
* Communicate product vision, priorities, and progress to stakeholders
* Influence and drive alignment across teams


**Product Performance Management**
* Define and track key product metrics (adoption, engagement, satisfaction, business outcomes)
* Conduct post\-launch analysis and recommend improvements
* Drive continuous optimization based on performance insights


**To Succeed In This Role**
* You'll have a bachelor's degree OR equivalent.
* 7\-10 years of experience in Product Management or related roles with a proven track record of delivering successful products.
* Experience and understanding of marketplace platforms, APIs and integrations.
* Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, product lifecycle management, and roadmap planning.
* Experience translating customer needs and business goals into scalable product solutions.
* Excellent analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills.
* Preferred: Experience in SaaS, cloud\-based platforms, enterprise software, FinTech, or HCM technology solutions.
* Preferred: Certifications such as CSPO, SAFe Product Manager/Product Owner, or Pragmatic Product Management.


**You'll Love Working Here Because You Can**
* Collaborate. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and respect one another's ideas to find the best solution.
* Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
* Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
* Act like an owner \& doer. Mission\-driven and committed to navigating change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems.
* Give back to others. Support our associates, clients, and communities through meaningful philanthropic initiatives.
* Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.


**What are you waiting for? Apply today!**
**A little about ADP:** 
 We are a comprehensive global provider of cloud\-based human capital management (HCM) solutions that unite HR, payroll, talent, time, tax and benefits administration and a leader in business outsourcing services, analytics, and compliance expertise. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating a down\-to\-earth culture that embraces our core values, welcomes ideas, encourages innovation, and values belonging. We've received recognition for our work by many esteemed organizations, learn more at ADP Awards and Recognition.

 ADP is committed to an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace, and is further committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of any protected characteristic including: race, color, genetic information, creed, national origin, religion, sex, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, lawful alien status, ancestry, age, marital status, protected veteran status or disability. Hiring decisions are based upon ADP’s operating needs, and applicant merit including, but not limited to, qualifications, experience, ability, availability, cooperation, and job performance.

We also expect our people to uphold our values with the highest level of integrity and behave in a manner that fosters an honest and respectful workplace. title: Head of Projects
description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONHead / Senior Manager – Projects

**Department:** Projects  
**Designation:** Head / Senior Manager – Projects  
**Industry:** Mechanical / Engineering / EPC Projects  
**Reporting To:** Director / Managing Director / Business Head  
**Location:** Head Office / Project Sites

1\. Job Purpose

To lead and manage the complete lifecycle of mechanical EPC projects from project award through engineering, procurement, construction, installation, commissioning and final handover, ensuring timely completion, cost control, quality, safety and customer satisfaction.

The position will provide strategic and operational leadership to project teams and ensure effective coordination between Engineering, Procurement, Planning, Construction, QA/QC, HSE, Finance, HR and client/consultant teams.

2\. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Project Planning \& Execution

* Take overall responsibility for successful execution of assigned mechanical EPC projects.
* Review project scope, contract conditions, specifications, drawings, BOQ, timelines and deliverables.
* Develop and implement detailed project execution plans and project schedules.
* Establish project milestones, manpower requirements, resource plans and execution strategies.
* Monitor project progress against approved schedule and take corrective actions for delays.
* Ensure effective mobilisation and deployment of manpower, equipment, materials and other resources.
* Drive timely completion of engineering, procurement, fabrication, erection, installation, testing and commissioning activities.
* Identify project risks and implement mitigation plans.

B. Project Management \& Control

* Monitor project cost, budget, cash flow, productivity and profitability.
* Ensure projects are executed within approved budgets and contractual timelines.
* Review project MIS, DPR/WPR/MPR, progress reports and management dashboards.
* Track planned vs. actual progress, productivity, manpower utilisation and project costs.
* Identify deviations and initiate appropriate corrective and preventive actions.
* Conduct periodic project review meetings with internal teams and clients.

C. EPC \& Contract Management

* Review and understand EPC contracts, work orders, scope of work, technical specifications and commercial terms.
* Ensure contractual obligations are clearly communicated to the project team.
* Identify variations, additional works, claims and potential commercial risks.
* Coordinate with the commercial/contracts team for submission and recovery of variation claims.
* Manage client/consultant communications relating to scope, schedule, resources, variations and project issues.
* Ensure proper documentation and records are maintained for contractual and commercial matters.

D. Engineering \& Technical Coordination

* Coordinate with Engineering teams for timely release of drawings, technical documents and specifications.
* Review constructability and ensure engineering deliverables are aligned with site requirements.
* Coordinate technical clarifications with clients, consultants and vendors.
* Ensure proper integration between mechanical, piping, structural, electrical and instrumentation activities wherever applicable.
* Support technical resolution of site execution issues.

E. Procurement \& Material Management

* Coordinate with Procurement and Stores teams to ensure timely availability of project materials.
* Monitor procurement schedules against project requirements.
* Review critical material and equipment procurement status.
* Ensure proper coordination with suppliers, subcontractors and vendors.
* Minimise project delays arising from material shortages and procurement issues.

F. Construction \& Site Management

* Provide leadership to project/site managers and construction teams.
* Ensure efficient execution of fabrication, erection, installation, testing and commissioning activities.
* Monitor manpower productivity and equipment utilisation.
* Drive productivity improvement and minimise idle manpower and equipment costs.
* Ensure proper coordination between various site functions and subcontractors.
* Conduct regular site visits and project performance reviews.

G. Quality \& HSE

* Ensure strict compliance with approved QA/QC procedures, ITPs, inspection requirements and project specifications.
* Ensure adherence to company and client HSE standards.
* Promote a strong safety culture across all project sites.
* Review quality and safety performance and ensure corrective actions are implemented.
* Ensure project documentation and final handover dossiers are completed as per contractual requirements.

H. Team Leadership \& People Management

* Lead, mentor and develop Project Managers, Project Engineers, Site Managers and other project personnel.
* Define responsibilities, targets and KPIs for project teams.
* Assess manpower requirements and coordinate with HR for recruitment and deployment.
* Build a high\-performance project management team.
* Conduct periodic performance reviews and provide guidance for capability development.

I. Client \& Stakeholder Management

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients, consultants and other stakeholders.
* Act as the senior point of contact for major project\-related matters.
* Participate in project kick\-off meetings, progress reviews and senior management discussions.
* Resolve escalated project issues in coordination with the client and internal management.
* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and successful project closure.

J. Project Closure

* Ensure completion of punch points, testing, commissioning and final handover.
* Coordinate preparation and submission of as\-built drawings, O\&M manuals, test certificates and completion dossiers.
* Ensure commercial closure, reconciliation and final billing are completed.
* Conduct project close\-out reviews and document lessons learned.

3\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Project completion within approved schedule.
* Project profitability and cost control.
* Planned vs. actual project progress.
* Manpower productivity and utilisation.
* Reduction in project delays and idle manpower costs.
* Material availability and procurement performance.
* Quality performance and reduction in rework.
* Safety performance and accident prevention.
* Timely billing and cash\-flow realisation.
* Variation/claim identification and recovery.
* Client satisfaction.
* Successful project handover and closure.

4\. Qualification

**Essential:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering / Diploma in Mechanical Engineering.
* **PMP / Project Management certification is mandatory or highly preferred.**
* Additional certification in Project Management, Construction Management or Contract Management will be an advantage.

5\. Experience

* **15–20\+ years of relevant experience** in mechanical project execution, preferably in EPC / Engineering / Construction organisations.
* Proven experience in handling **large\-scale mechanical EPC projects** from project initiation to completion.
* Experience in managing multidisciplinary project teams and multiple projects/sites.
* Strong exposure to engineering, procurement, fabrication, erection, installation, testing and commissioning.
* Experience in project planning, cost control, contracts, client management and commercial coordination.
* Experience in handling project teams, subcontractors, vendors and consultants.

6\. Desired Industry Exposure

Experience in one or more of the following sectors will be preferred:

* Oil \& Gas
* Petrochemical / Refinery
* Chemical / Process Plants
* Semiconductor / Advanced Manufacturing
* Power / Utilities
* Piping \& Mechanical EPC
* Industrial Projects
* Structural \& Mechanical Projects
* Fabrication, Erection \& Commissioning

7\. Required Skills \& Competencies

* Strong project planning and execution capability.
* Excellent leadership and team management skills.
* Strong knowledge of EPC project methodologies.
* Good understanding of project contracts and commercial aspects.
* Strong cost and schedule management skills.
* Knowledge of Primavera P6 / MS Project and project management tools.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.
* Strong client and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet critical project deadlines.
* Willingness to travel and work at project sites across India.

8\. Personal Attributes

* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Result\-oriented approach.
* Strategic and analytical thinking.
* High level of integrity and professionalism.
* Strong decision\-making capability.
* Ability to lead teams independently.
* Proactive approach to identifying and resolving project issues.
* Customer\-focused mindset.

9\. Role Expectations

The incumbent is expected to function as the **overall project leader**, ensuring that projects are delivered safely, within the approved budget and schedule, in accordance with technical and quality requirements, while maintaining profitability and customer satisfaction.

The position will also contribute to strengthening the organisation's project management systems, standardising project execution practices, improving productivity and developing a strong project management team.

HyreSpot is looking for a proactive and energetic Field Recruiter to expand our candidate network and support our growing recruitment operations.

This is a field\-oriented recruitment position for someone who enjoys meeting people, developing contacts, identifying potential candidates, and converting hiring opportunities into successful joins.

The person in this role will work closely with the HR and Talent Acquisition team while independently exploring candidate sources such as local communities, colleges, training institutes, job fairs, referrals, job portals, and social media.

title: Learning & Development Manager
description:
**Company Description**  

Raffles Udaipur opened in 2021, its ornamental gardens, tumbling fountains and stately Indo\-Saracenic architecture describing a love story between India and the West. Set on a 21\-acre private island rich with birdlife and exotic flora and fauna, this contemporary reimagining of a country mansion is the first Raffles hotel in India.


Just 20 minutes from the airport, Raffles Udaipur spans a private island and serene lakeshore. Begin your journey with a graceful boat ride, guided by migratory birds. Discover 137 rooms and suites, 10 dining experiences, two pools, wellness rituals, and the timeless care of the Raffles Butler.

 **Job Description**  

We are seeking an enthusiastic and detail\-oriented Learning \& Development Manager to join our team in Udaipur, India. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing comprehensive training and development programs that drive organizational excellence and foster employee growth. Reporting to the Director of People \& Culture, you will collaborate with leadership teams across the organization to create a culture of continuous learning and professional development. This is an excellent opportunity for an innovative and empathetic professional to make a meaningful impact on our workforce's skills, engagement, and career progression.

* Design, develop, and facilitate a variety of training programs including onboarding, leadership development, skills enhancement, and specialized workshops to support organizational goals and employee development
* Execute a comprehensive onboarding experience for new employees, ensuring a smooth transition and strong foundation for success; continuously update and improve onboarding processes based on feedback and organizational needs
* Conduct thorough needs assessments in collaboration with department leaders to identify skill gaps and training requirements; translate findings into actionable learning strategies
* Manage and maintain accurate records of all training activities, participant information, and completion rates; analyze training data and metrics to measure program effectiveness and ROI
* Support the development and coaching of departmental trainers, ensuring consistency, compliance, and quality across all training initiatives throughout the organization
* Oversee the administration of online learning management systems, including course assignments, progress monitoring, and completion tracking for mandatory and elective programs
* Partner with operational leaders to review job task checklists and training tools, ensuring they support effective departmental onboarding and skill development
* Collaborate with regional Learning \& Development counterparts to align strategic direction, share best practices, and maintain consistency across the organization
* Support apprenticeship programs and educational assistance initiatives, fostering a culture of lifelong learning and professional growth
* Oversee the performance review program to ensure timely and thorough completion of probationary and annual reviews for all employees
* Contribute to broader People \& Culture operations and organizational initiatives as assigned; demonstrate flexibility and willingness to adapt to evolving business needs

  

**Qualifications**  

\*\*Required Qualifications:\*\*

* Minimum 2 years of professional experience in a leadership role, preferably within the hospitality, service, or corporate environment
* Proven experience in designing and facilitating training programs that drive measurable results and service excellence
* Demonstrated expertise in conducting needs assessments and translating organizational requirements into effective learning solutions
* Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Teams, PowerPoint, Publisher, Excel, and Word)
* Proficiency with online learning management systems and training administration platforms
* Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and develop data\-driven improvement strategies
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present information clearly to diverse audiences
* Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously
* Ability to build and maintain strong interpersonal relationships with colleagues at all organizational levels


\*\*Preferred Qualifications:\*\*

* Previous experience in Learning \& Development, talent management, or human resources functions
* University degree in Hotel/Restaurant Management, Human Resources, Business Administration, or related discipline
* Knowledge of adult learning principles and instructional design methodologies
* Experience with budget management and financial planning for training programs
* Familiarity with change management practices and organizational development
* Coaching and mentoring experience
* Experience developing and delivering leadership development programs


\*\*Key Competencies:\*\*

* Enthusiastic, positive, and motivational approach to employee development
* Detail\-oriented with strong attention to accuracy and quality
* Innovative and creative mindset with willingness to explore new training methodologies
* Collaborative approach to working with cross\-functional teams
* Flexible and adaptable with the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment
* Results\-oriented with a commitment to achieving organizational goals
* Empathetic and supportive in fostering employee growth and engagement
* Inclusive mindset that values diverse perspectives and backgrounds
* Efficient and organized in managing time and resources effectively
* Visionary thinking with the ability to anticipate future organizational learning needs

  

**Additional Information**  

* An opportunity to be with world’s preferred hospitality company
* Captivating and rewarding experience working alongside passionate professionals
* Range of exclusive Heartist Benefits
* Develop your talent through learning programs by Academy Accor.

title: Head HR & Administration
description:
Job Description

The Head – HR \& Administration will be responsible for leading the organisation's **human resources strategy and administrative operations**, ensuring alignment with business goals. This role requires a senior HR professional with strong expertise in **HR operations, compliance, talent management, and administration**, preferably within the real estate or construction sector.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Human Resources Leadership**
* Design and implement HR strategies aligned with organizational growth plans.
* Oversee end\-to\-end HR operations including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, learning \& development, and employee engagement.
* Lead manpower planning for projects, site offices, and corporate functions.
* Establish and drive performance appraisal systems and career progression frameworks.
* Act as a strategic HR partner to senior management and department heads.
* **Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning**
* Lead hiring for corporate, site, and project\-based roles.
* Build strong recruitment pipelines for engineering, sales, finance, and support functions.
* Manage external consultants and vendors for staffing needs.
* **Employee Relations \& Compliance**
* Ensure compliance with all applicable **labour laws** (Factories Act, CLRA, Shops \& Establishment, PF, ESI, Gratuity, etc.).
* Handle employee relations, grievance management, disciplinary actions, and exit processes.
* Maintain HR policies, SOPs, and statutory documentation.
* **Compensation, Payroll \& Benefits**
* Oversee payroll processing, compensation structuring, incentives, and statutory benefits.
* Conduct periodic salary benchmarking and support annual appraisal cycles.
* **Administration \& Facilities**
* Head all administrative functions including office management, facilities, transport, security, and vendor management.
* Ensure smooth functioning of corporate and site offices.
* Manage administrative budgets and optimize operational costs.

**Required Qualifications \& Experience**

* MBA / PGDM in **Human Resources** or equivalent qualification.
* **12–18\+ years** of progressive HR experience, with at least **5 years in a leadership role**.
* Strong exposure to **real estate, construction, or infrastructure sectors** preferred.
* In\-depth knowledge of Indian labor laws and HR compliance.
* Proven ability to work closely with promoters and senior leadership.

**Key Skills \& Competencies**

* Strategic HR Leadership
* Strong Employee Relations \& Compliance Expertise
* Excellent Communication \& Stakeholder Management
* Decision\-making and problem\-solving skills
* High integrity, confidentiality, and professionalism
* Ability to manage both **HR and administrative operations**

**What Success Looks Like**

* Stable and engaged workforce
* Strong compliance and risk management
* Efficient HR processes and administrative systems
* Positive organizational culture supporting business growth

Pay: ₹1,800,000\.00 \- ₹2,000,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Valuation Analyst
description:
Position Title

Valuation Analyst

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and detail\-oriented Vehicle and Machinery Valuator to assess the value and condition of vehicles, heavy equipment, industrial machinery, and other mechanical assets. The successful candidate will conduct physical inspections, analyze market data, determine fair market values, and prepare accurate valuation reports for clients, financial institutions, insurance companies, or internal business purposes.

Key Responsibilities

* Inspect and evaluate vehicles, heavy machinery, construction equipment, and industrial machines.
* Assess the age, condition, specifications, usage, maintenance history, and remaining useful life of assets.
* Determine market value, fair value, replacement value, and/or liquidation value as required.
* Research current market prices, comparable sales, auction results, and industry trends.
* Verify vehicle and machinery identification, model, serial numbers, registration details, and specifications.
* Identify damage, defects, depreciation, modifications, and other factors affecting asset value.
* Prepare detailed and professional valuation reports with photographs and supporting evidence.
* Maintain accurate records of inspections, calculations, market research, and valuation conclusions.
* Communicate valuation findings clearly to clients and other stakeholders.
* Conduct site visits to workshops, yards, construction sites, factories, dealerships, and other locations when required.
* Keep up to date with changes in vehicle, machinery, and equipment markets.
* Ensure valuations are conducted in accordance with applicable company procedures and professional standards.

Required Qualifications

* Minimum 10th Pass
* Relevant experience in vehicle appraisal, machinery valuation, equipment inspection, automotive, engineering, insurance, banking, or asset management.
* Good knowledge of different types of vehicles, construction equipment, agricultural machinery, and industrial machinery.
* Strong understanding of depreciation and factors affecting the value of mechanical assets.
* Ability to conduct market research and analyze comparable assets.
* Good numerical, analytical, and report\-writing skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word.
* Willingness to travel for physical inspections.

Preferred Skills

* Experience valuing cars, commercial vehicles, trucks, buses, earthmoving equipment, cranes, generators, industrial machinery, and production equipment.
* Knowledge of auction and resale markets.
* Familiarity with insurance, finance, banking, or asset\-recovery valuation requirements.
* Strong attention to detail and professional judgment.
* Good communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
* Valid driving license is an advantage.
* Key Performance Indicators
* Accuracy and consistency of valuation reports.
* Quality and completeness of physical inspections.
* Reliability of market research and valuation calculations.
* Timely completion of assignments.
* Compliance with professional and company valuation standards.
* Client satisfaction and quality of communication.

Working Conditions

The role may involve both office\-based valuation analysis and field inspections. The Valuator may be required to travel to client premises, workshops, dealerships, warehouses, construction sites, auction yards, and industrial facilities.

Employment Type

Full\-time

Fresher \-Experience

Reporting To

Valuation Manager / Head of Valuation

Contact\- 8144303866

Pay: ₹12,500\.00 \- ₹16,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bhadrakh, Odisha 756100

**Work Location:** Bhosari, Pune

**Department:** Tool Room / Tool Engineering

**Reports to:** Business Head

**Essential Qualifications**

* **B.E./B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering**.
* Minimum **10 years of relevant experience** in Tool Room / Press Tool Manufacturing / Tool Engineering.
* Strong practical experience in **press tool manufacturing and maintenance**.
* Experience in machining, grinding, Wire Cut/EDM, milling, fitting and tool assembly.
* Good understanding of tool manufacturing processes, tool proving and tool corrections.
* Experience in managing Tool Room manpower and machines.
* Strong knowledge of tool manufacturing cost calculation and cost control.

**Preferred Experience**

Candidates with experience in an **automotive / auto\-component manufacturing environment** will be preferred.

Experience in managing a Tool Room as a **cost centre/profit centre**, including budgeting, costing, manpower and productivity management, will be highly desirable.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Tool Room Operations \& Profit Centre Management

· New Tool Manufacturing

· Tool Maintenance

· Coordination with Design \& Development

· Tool Manufacturing Cost Control

· Consumable Cost Control

· Machine \& Equipment Management

· Systems, Discipline \& Process Improvement

· Manpower Management

· Productivity \& Continuous Improvement

· Management Review \& MIS

· Team Leadership \& Development

**Required Technical \& Managerial Skills**

* Strong knowledge of **Press Tool Design \& Manufacturing**
* Tool Maintenance \& Troubleshooting
* Tool Manufacturing Planning
* Machining \& Tool Room Processes
* VMC / CNC / Wire Cut / EDM / Grinding
* Tool Costing and Cost Control
* Make\-or\-Buy Analysis
* Machine Utilization \& Capacity Planning
* Manpower Planning
* Production Planning \& Monitoring
* Preventive Maintenance
* Root Cause Analysis \& Problem Solving

* Team Leadership and People Management
* Cross\-functional coordination

* **Ownership\-oriented approach**
* Strong commercial and cost consciousness
* Data\-driven decision making
* Ability to take quick and practical decisions

* Planning and execution capability
* Problem\-solving mindset
* Team\-building and leadership skills

title: Human Resources Assistant Intern
description:
**Location** 
 : Noida (On\-site)
 



**Company** 
 : Zynence Labs Pvt. Ltd.
 



**Duration** 
 : 2–6 months (flexible, based on your academic commitments)
 



**Employment Type** 
 : Internship
 



  





**About Zynence** 




 Zynence is building an AI\-native, full\-lifecycle hardware engineering platform. A connected workspace that takes a hardware product from requirements and system architecture through BOM/cost, firmware, schematic/PCB, simulation, validation, and manufacturing. We're a small, early\-stage team growing quickly, which means the person in this role won't be handling a narrow slice of HR, you'll help build the HR function itself, alongside the founders.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We're looking for an HR Intern to plan and execute recruitment, onboarding, and day\-to\-day HR coordination as we grow the team. You'll own real parts of the hiring pipeline, not just admin support for someone else's process, from sourcing and screening candidates through to getting new hires set up and settled in. This is a hands\-on role at a startup where things are still being figured out: you'll help build the processes as much as run them.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition
 


* Draft and post job openings across LinkedIn, Naukri, and other relevant platforms.
* Source and screen candidates for open roles, using both inbound applications and proactive outreach.
* Schedule and coordinate interviews between candidates and the hiring team.
* Maintain a candidate pipeline tracker and keep applicants informed at each stage of the process.
* Support salary/offer discussions and documentation in coordination with the founders.



 Onboarding \& Employee Lifecycle
 


* Plan and run onboarding for new hires — documentation, systems access, introductions, and first\-week schedules.
* Maintain employee records and HR documentation (offer letters, contracts, ID/verification paperwork).
* Act as a point of contact for new joiners during their first few weeks.
* Support offboarding processes when needed, ensuring a clean handover and exit documentation.



 HR Coordination \& Operations
 


* Maintain HR trackers — headcount, open positions, interview pipelines, onboarding status.
* Help coordinate internal communication, team announcements, and basic HR policies.
* Support attendance, leave tracking, and other day\-to\-day HR administration.
* Assist with organizing team events, check\-ins, or culture\-building activities as the team grows.



  





**Qualifications** 




 Required
 


* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills \- you'll be the first point of contact for many candidates and new hires.
* Comfortable with spreadsheets (Google Sheets/Excel) for tracking pipelines, records, and schedules.
* Organized and detail\-oriented \- able to juggle multiple candidates, timelines, and documents without letting things slip.
* Trustworthy with confidential information \- HR work involves sensitive personal and compensation data.



 Preferred
 


* Prior internship or hands\-on experience in HR, recruitment, or people operations.
* Familiarity with recruitment platforms (LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, Instahyre, or similar) and applicant tracking approaches.
* Comfort using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) to speed up screening, scheduling, and documentation work \- we use AI heavily across the company and like people who do too.
* Genuine interest in startup environments and building processes from scratch rather than following an existing playbook.



  





**What We Look For** 



* Ownership \- you follow a candidate or a new hire through to the end, not just to the next step in your task list.
* Judgment and discretion \- you handle sensitive information (compensation, personal details, performance conversations) with care.
* People\-oriented \- you enjoy talking to candidates and helping new hires feel welcome, not just processing paperwork.
* Comfort with ambiguity \- this is an early\-stage company; processes will be incomplete and priorities will shift.
* Clear communication \- with candidates, new hires, and founders alike.



  





**Duration \& Logistics** 




 This is a 2–6 month internship; the exact duration is flexible and can be structured around your academic schedule (semester breaks, part\-time alongside coursework, or a dedicated full\-time block). On\-site at our Noida office.
 



  





**Why Join Zynence?** 



* Build the HR function at an early\-stage company from the ground up — your work will shape how we hire and onboard people, not just execute someone else's process.
* Direct exposure to founders and hiring decisions, not a narrow HR\-admin role buried in a large company.
* Real ownership over recruitment and onboarding for a live, growing team — not a shadow/observation internship.
* Broad exposure to how an early\-stage tech startup actually operates, beyond HR alone.



  





**How to Apply** 




 Apply through LinkedIn or send your resume to sushil@zynence.com
 



 Subject: Application for HR Intern – Zynence
 



 Please mention your availability (start date, and how many months you can commit to) in your application.

Graduate (B.Tech, B.Com, BBA, BA, etc.), MBA preferred

**About House of EdTech**

**House of EdTech (Goenka Kachave LLP)** is a high\-growth, multi\-entity EdTech organization focused on delivering **large\-scale, outcome\-driven professional education** across high\-impact domains including **Artificial Intelligence, Finance, Data, Product Management, and Business Skills**.

Founded by **Aditya Goenka \- Founder @ Be10x \& Office Master \| Enabling People Upskill Themselves \| LinkedIn)** and **Aditya Kachave \- Be10x \| LinkedIn),** **IIT Kharagpur alumni**, the organization has rapidly emerged as one of India’s most dynamic EdTech groups by combining **cutting\-edge curriculum, practitioner\-led training, and performance\-driven execution**. With a strong learner\-first philosophy and deep expertise in digital education delivery, House of EdTech enables working professionals and entrepreneurs to **upskill, increase productivity, and unlock measurable career and income growth**.

Today, the organization:

* **Serves over 5 million learners** across India and global markets
* Operates at an **annual recurring revenue (ARR) exceeding ₹450 crore**
* Employs **2,000\+ professionals** across sales, marketing, tech, product, and operations
* Maintains a **strong on\-ground presence in Pune and Kolkata**, supported by pan\-India digital reach

**Diversified Brand Portfolio**

House of EdTech operates a **strategically diversified portfolio of category\-leading education brands**, each addressing distinct learner needs and professional outcomes:

* **Be10x** ()Focused on practical AI tools and productivity solutions that help professionals work smarter and faster using real\-world AI applications.
* **Office Master** ()Specializes in advanced MS Excel, Power BI, and Office productivity programs designed for business and data professionals.
* **AI for Techies** ()Caters to technical professionals seeking hands\-on AI, Python, and SQL skills for accelerated career growth in tech and analytics roles.
* **Dr. Finance** ()Delivers structured personal finance education, enabling individuals to make informed decisions around saving, investing, and wealth creation.
* **Profit Uni** ()Provides applied stock market and trading education, focusing on practical strategies, risk management, and consistent profitability.
* **Springpad** ()Offers specialized programs in analytics and business intelligence, empowering learners with job\-ready, insight\-driven skills.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic **Talent Acquisition Executive / Senior Talent Acquisition Executive** to join our HR team in Kolkata. In this role, you will be responsible for end\-to\-end recruitment, from sourcing and screening to interview coordination and offer management. This is an excellent opportunity for someone passionate about talent acquisition to work in a high\-growth EdTech environment and contribute to building world\-class teams.

**Key ResponsibilitiesTalent Sourcing \& Strategy**

* Develop and execute effective sourcing strategies to attract top candidates
* Utilize multiple channels such as job portals, social media, LinkedIn, referrals, and professional networks to source candidates
* Identify new and creative ways to reach out to potential candidates
* Research and implement innovative recruiting techniques
* Leverage employer branding to attract quality talent
* Create compelling job postings and recruitment advertisements

**Candidate Screening \& Shortlisting**

* Review resumes and applications to identify the best talent
* Conduct initial screening calls to evaluate candidates' skills, experience, and culture fit
* Assess candidate qualifications against job requirements
* Maintain timely and professional communication with all applicants
* Shortlist candidates efficiently to move them through the hiring funnel
* Evaluate both technical skills and cultural alignment

**Interview Coordination \& Process Management**

* Schedule interviews and coordinate between candidates and hiring managers
* Manage end\-to\-end interview logistics and communications
* Gather and document interview feedback to facilitate smooth decision\-making
* Ensure a seamless and positive candidate experience throughout the hiring process
* Track candidate progress through recruitment stages
* Follow up with candidates and provide timely updates

**Building \& Maintaining Talent Pipelines**

* Proactively build and maintain a pipeline of qualified candidates for future hiring needs
* Engage with passive candidates and develop long\-term relationships with potential hires
* Create talent pools segmented by role, skills, and experience level
* Keep track of industry hiring trends and market conditions
* Nurture candidate relationships for future opportunities
* Stay updated on salary benchmarks and competitive landscape

**Employer Branding \& Candidate Experience**

* Represent the company in a professional and engaging manner
* Actively contribute to enhancing the employer brand by ensuring a positive candidate experience
* Promote House of EdTech as a great place to work through social media, networking events, and recruitment campaigns
* Showcase company culture and values to attract the right talent
* Gather candidate feedback to improve recruitment experience
* Participate in job fairs, campus placements, and networking events

* Maintain accurate recruitment data and generate reports on key hiring metrics
* Use data\-driven insights to optimize recruitment strategies and improve hiring efficiency
* Track metrics such as time\-to\-hire, cost\-per\-hire, source effectiveness, and conversion rates
* Provide regular updates to leadership on recruitment status
* Utilize Applicant Tracking System (ATS) effectively
