JOB DESCRIPTIONGeneral Manager – HospitalPosition Details

**Designation:** General Manager – Hospital  
**Department:** Hospital Administration / Operations  
**Reporting To:** Managing Director / CEO / Hospital Director  
**Location:** Hospital  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

Job Summary

The General Manager will be responsible for the **overall operational, administrative, financial, and service management** of the hospital. The role involves ensuring smooth day\-to\-day functioning of all departments, maintaining high standards of patient care and service quality, managing employees and resources, ensuring regulatory and accreditation compliance, and supporting the hospital's growth and financial performance.

The General Manager will act as a key link between the **Management, Medical Team, Nursing, Administration, Finance, HR, Engineering, Operations, and Support Services**.

Key Responsibilities1\. Hospital Operations

* Oversee the day\-to\-day operations of the hospital and ensure smooth functioning of all departments.
* Ensure efficient utilization of hospital infrastructure, manpower, equipment, and other resources.
* Monitor patient flow, admissions, discharges, OPD, IPD, emergency, diagnostics, pharmacy, and support services.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure uninterrupted availability of essential hospital services.
* Coordinate with department heads to resolve operational issues promptly.
* Develop and implement SOPs, policies, and operational procedures.

2\. Patient Experience \& Service Quality

* Ensure high standards of **patient care, safety, satisfaction, and service quality**.
* Monitor patient complaints, feedback, grievances, and service recovery.
* Establish systems to improve patient experience and reduce waiting times.
* Ensure professional and courteous behavior by all hospital staff.
* Conduct regular rounds and review service standards across departments.

3\. Financial \& Business Management

* Monitor hospital revenue, expenses, profitability, and operating costs.
* Work closely with the Finance Department to prepare and monitor budgets.
* Review department\-wise financial performance and identify areas for improvement.
* Monitor billing, collections, credit management, insurance/TPA processes, and revenue leakage.
* Control unnecessary expenditure while maintaining quality of services.
* Support development of new revenue streams and business opportunities.
* Review monthly MIS and key financial indicators with management.

4\. Human Resources \& Team Management

* Coordinate with HR for recruitment, manpower planning, training, performance management, and employee retention.
* Ensure appropriate staffing levels across departments.
* Monitor employee attendance, discipline, productivity, and performance.
* Develop leadership and accountability among department heads.
* Conduct regular review meetings with HODs and key personnel.
* Promote teamwork, professional conduct, and a positive workplace culture.

5\. Medical \& Clinical Coordination

* Coordinate with the Medical Director, Consultants, Nursing Head, and Clinical HODs for smooth clinical operations.
* Facilitate resolution of operational issues affecting clinical departments.
* Ensure availability of required clinical support services.
* Support implementation of clinical quality and patient\-safety initiatives.
* Ensure proper coordination between clinical and non\-clinical departments.

6\. Quality, Accreditation \& Compliance

* Ensure compliance with applicable **healthcare laws, statutory requirements, hospital regulations, and accreditation standards**.
* Coordinate hospital quality and accreditation initiatives such as NABH or other applicable standards.
* Monitor implementation of SOPs, quality indicators, audits, corrective actions, and risk\-management programs.
* Ensure proper documentation and readiness for internal and external inspections.
* Promote a culture of continuous quality improvement and patient safety.

7\. Facility \& Infrastructure Management

* Oversee Engineering, Maintenance, Housekeeping, Security, Laundry, Dietary, Biomedical, Electrical, HVAC, Plumbing, and other support services.
* Ensure proper maintenance of hospital buildings, infrastructure, equipment, and utilities.
* Monitor preventive maintenance schedules and breakdown response.
* Ensure adequate safety, cleanliness, infection\-control support, and environmental standards.
* Coordinate hospital expansion, renovation, and infrastructure projects where required.

8\. Vendor \& Procurement Management

* Oversee procurement and vendor\-management activities in coordination with authorized departments.
* Evaluate vendor performance, quality, pricing, and service levels.
* Ensure timely availability of essential materials, consumables, and services.
* Support negotiation with vendors and service providers.
* Ensure appropriate inventory control and reduction of wastage.

9\. Safety, Risk \& Emergency Management

* Ensure implementation of hospital safety policies and emergency preparedness plans.
* Coordinate disaster management, fire safety, security, and emergency response systems.
* Monitor incident reports and ensure appropriate corrective and preventive actions.
* Conduct regular safety reviews and mock drills as required.
* Ensure patient, staff, visitor, and hospital property safety.

10\. MIS \& Management Reporting

* Prepare and review daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports.
* Monitor key performance indicators such as:
* OPD \& IPD volumes
* Bed occupancy
* Average length of stay
* Revenue
* Patient satisfaction
* OT utilization
* Diagnostic utilization
* Pharmacy performance
* Collection efficiency
* Employee productivity
* Complaints and grievances
* Present performance reports and improvement plans to senior management.

11\. Business Development

* Support the hospital's business growth and market\-development strategies.
* Develop relationships with corporates, insurance companies, TPAs, doctors, referral networks, and other stakeholders.
* Identify opportunities for new services, specialties, and partnerships.
* Support marketing and community outreach initiatives.
* Monitor competitor activities and local healthcare market trends.

Qualifications

* **MBA / PG Diploma in Hospital Management / Healthcare Management / Hospital Administration** preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in any relevant discipline; candidates with **MBBS, BHA, BHM, BBA, or related qualifications** may also be considered based on experience.
* Strong knowledge of hospital operations and healthcare administration.
* Knowledge of NABH/accreditation requirements is preferred.
* Strong understanding of hospital finance, HR, quality, and operational processes.

Experience

**Preferred:** 8–15 years of relevant experience in hospital administration/operations, with significant experience in a managerial or leadership position.

Experience in managing a **multi\-specialty hospital** will be an advantage.

Management Trainee – Business, Operations \& People

**Location: Thiruvananthapuram**

**Initial Training Period: 4 Months**

**Stipend: ₹8,000 per month**

**Post\-Training Role: Management Trainee — ₹20,000 per month, subject to successful completion**

**We are looking for a Bright Mind who Loves Learning, People \& Problem Solving**

We are creating a **Training \& Innovation Lab in Thiruvananthapuram** to develop young people into capable business professionals.

We are looking for someone who can eventually help **run the Lab, organise people, build systems and make things happen.**

This is not a conventional HR or administration job.

You will be exposed to **business development, people management, training, operations, AI, digital tools and entrepreneurship.**

**Your Role**

During the initial four months, you will learn and gradually take responsibility for:

* Organising and running the Training Lab
* Coordinating young trainees and team members
* Planning training programmes
* Recruiting Sales\& Marketing personnel.
* Developing induction and training processes
* Understanding business operations
* Supporting NETIMPAKT implementation and promotion
* Customer and business communication
* Creating processes and systems
* Recruitment coordination and people development
* Preparing presentations, documents and training material
* Using AI to improve everyday business work
* Researching new opportunities and solutions
* Identifying problems and finding practical solutions
* Helping the team become more productive and professional

You will work closely with the technical/creative trainee and together you will build the capabilities required to operate the Lab.

**We would particularly value someone who:**

* Is intelligent, curious and energetic
* Enjoys working with people
* Has excellent communication skills
* Can organise things and get people moving
* Thinks independently
* Enjoys solving problems
* Is comfortable learning technology and AI
* Can take responsibility rather than waiting for instructions
* Can teach others what they have learned
* Is interested in business, management and entrepreneurship

A degree in **Management, Commerce, Business, Engineering, Computer Applications, Psychology, Communications or a related field** may be useful, but **attitude and learning ability are more important than the degree.**

**The Bigger Opportunity**

The first four months are a **learning and proving period**.

We expect you to progress from:

**Learner → Coordinator → Trainer → Responsible Manager**

You will be expected to gradually take ownership of people, processes and outcomes.

If you successfully demonstrate the required capability, commitment and responsibility, you will move into a **Management Trainee position at ₹20,000 per month** after four months.

The longer\-term objective is for you to become one of the people who can **help run the Lab, train young professionals and manage business operations.**

**We are not looking for someone who merely wants a job.**  
**We are looking for someone who wants to become capable of running things.**

Should have your own laptop and ready to join immediately.

Pay: ₹8,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Tripees is looking for an experienced and commercially driven **MICE Head** to build, develop and lead its **MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences \& Events) business**.


The ideal candidate should have strong experience in **MICE sales, corporate travel, incentive travel, group movements and event management**, along with the ability to develop new business, build corporate relationships and create a scalable MICE vertical.


This role requires someone who can **build the business from the ground up, generate revenue, acquire corporate clients and lead end\-to\-end MICE execution**.

* Track sales pipeline, revenue, margins, client acquisition and business performance.
* Ensure high levels of client satisfaction and develop **repeat and referral business**.

**Candidate Profile**
---------------------


* **8ÔÇô15 years of relevant experience** in MICE, corporate travel, tourism, events, DMC or hospitality.

* Strong experience in **B2B corporate sales and business development**.

* Experience handling large group movements and corporate events.
* Strong negotiation, presentation and commercial skills.

* Strong leadership and team\-management capabilities.
* Willingness to travel as required for client meetings and event execution.

**Key Success Metrics**
-----------------------


* MICE revenue and profitability
* New corporate client acquisition
* Number and value of MICE events closed
* Repeat business and client retention
* Sales pipeline development
* Gross margin achievement
* Team productivity and business growth

**Ideal Candidate**
-------------------


We are looking for a **business builder and MICE specialist** who has successfully developed MICE business in the past and can take ownership of building Tripees into a strong **corporate MICE and incentive travel player**.


**Strong preference for candidates who bring an existing corporate network, proven revenue numbers and a demonstrated track record of independently acquiring MICE business.**

title: Compliance Manager
description:
**Compliance Manager**

**Department:** Compliance

**Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka  
**Reporting To:** CFO / CEO

**Role:** Compliance Manager / Head – Compliance

**1\. Job Purpose**

To lead and ensure end\-to\-end statutory, regulatory, food safety, factory, labour, licensing and business compliance across manufacturing units, offices, warehouses, distribution centres and other business locations.

The role will be responsible for identifying compliance requirements, maintaining statutory records and licences, coordinating inspections and audits, ensuring timely renewals/returns, monitoring compliance gaps and driving corrective actions to minimise legal, financial and operational risks.

**2\. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Food Safety \& FSSAI Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with all applicable **FSSAI requirements** across manufacturing, retail, warehouses and food\-service operations.
* Ensure timely renewal, modification and updating of FSSAI licences.
* Coordinate with Quality, Production, R\&D and Operations teams for food safety compliance.
* Monitor food safety documentation, hygiene standards, pest control, sanitation, water testing, product testing and related records.
* Ensure Food Safety Supervisors/FoSTaC requirements are complied with wherever applicable.
* Coordinate FSSAI inspections, audits and regulatory visits and ensure closure of observations.
* Maintain product traceability, complaint records, recall\-related documentation and corrective/preventive actions.
* Monitor compliance relating to food labelling, declarations and packaging requirements in coordination with Quality/R\&D.

FSSAI specifically identifies FSMS, GMP and GHP as important requirements for licensed food businesses, including manufacturing, processing, packaging, storage and distribution.

**B. Factory \& Labour Law Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable **Factories Act / OSH requirements and Karnataka factory regulations**.
* Maintain factory licences, registrations, statutory registers and returns.
* Monitor compliance relating to:
* Working hours
* Overtime
* Weekly offs
* Leave
* Wages
* Employment conditions
* Welfare facilities
* Health and safety
* Cafeteria
* First aid
* Accident reporting
* Safety committee requirements
* Coordinate factory inspections and government authority visits.
* Ensure timely closure of observations raised by statutory authorities.

**C. Labour \& Employment Compliance**

* Monitor compliance with applicable labour laws across all locations.
* Ensure compliance relating to **PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, Minimum Wages, Bonus, Gratuity, Payment of Wages and Contract Labour**.
* Review statutory payroll compliance in coordination with HR and Finance.
* Verify compliance of manpower contractors and third\-party agencies.
* Ensure contractors maintain required wage registers, attendance records, PF/ESI records, licences and statutory documentation.
* Conduct periodic audits of manpower vendors.

**D. Shops \& Establishments / Retail Compliance**

* Ensure compliance for all manufacturing units, retail outlets, offices and other applicable establishments.
* Maintain Shops \& Establishments registrations and related statutory documentation.
* Track renewal dates, inspections and statutory returns.
* Ensure statutory notices and mandatory displays are maintained at all locations.

**E. Legal Metrology \& Product Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable **Legal Metrology requirements** for packaged products.
* Coordinate verification/stamping of weighing instruments wherever applicable.
* Review product packaging declarations in coordination with Quality, R\&D and Marketing.
* Ensure correct declarations relating to MRP, net quantity, manufacturer/packer details, consumer care information and other applicable requirements.
* Monitor compliance of packaging and labelling across SKUs.

**F. Licences \& Registrations Management**

Maintain a central **Compliance \& Licence Master** covering all company locations, including:

* FSSAI licences
* Factory licences
* Shops \& Establishments registrations
* Trade licences
* Fire NOC / Fire Safety compliance
* Pollution Control Board consents
* Legal Metrology registrations
* Professional Tax
* Labour Welfare Fund
* PF / ESI registrations
* Contract Labour licences
* Weights \& Measures
* Local municipal licences
* Any other business\-specific statutory registrations

Ensure **zero lapse in licence validity** through advance renewal planning.

**3\. Audit \& Compliance Monitoring**

* Develop an annual compliance audit calendar.
* Conduct periodic compliance audits across manufacturing units, warehouses and offices.
* Prepare location\-wise compliance checklists.
* Identify gaps and assign corrective actions with timelines.
* Follow up with respective department heads until closure.
* Maintain evidence/documentation for all closed observations.
* Prepare monthly/quarterly compliance reports for senior management.

**4\. Regulatory \& Government Liaison**

* Act as the primary compliance coordinator with statutory and regulatory authorities.
* Coordinate inspections, notices, hearings and regulatory correspondence.
* Maintain proper records of government communications.
* Ensure timely responses to notices and observations.
* Escalate critical legal or regulatory risks to management immediately.

**5\. Legal \& Risk Management**

* Coordinate with external legal counsel on compliance\-related matters.
* Review compliance implications of new business initiatives, new locations, products and processes.
* Support HR in employee\-related legal matters, disciplinary actions and statutory compliance.
* Support management in handling labour disputes, regulatory notices and government proceedings.
* Maintain a **Compliance Risk Register** and track high\-risk areas.

**6\. POSH \& Workplace Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable POSH requirements.
* Maintain Internal Committee documentation.
* Coordinate POSH awareness/training programmes.
* Ensure statutory reporting and documentation are completed within applicable timelines.
* Support HR in maintaining workplace conduct and statutory documentation.

**7\. Vendor \& Third\-Party Compliance**

* Establish minimum compliance requirements for contractors and vendors.
* Conduct periodic compliance verification of:
* Housekeeping vendors
* Security agencies
* Manpower contractors
* Transporters
* Facility management vendors
* Food/service vendors
* Ensure required statutory documents are collected and periodically validated.
* Flag non\-compliant vendors to Procurement/Finance/Management.

**8\. Compliance MIS \& Reporting**

Prepare and present a monthly **Management Compliance Dashboard** covering:

* Licence status
* Upcoming renewals
* Statutory returns
* Statutory payments
* Audit observations
* Open/closed compliance gaps
* Government notices
* Labour compliance
* Contractor compliance
* Food safety compliance
* Fire \& safety compliance
* High\-risk compliance matters

**4\. Qualification**

**For Compliance Manager:**

* Graduate/Post Graduate in Law, Commerce, HR, Food Technology, Business Administration or related discipline.
* 8–15 years of relevant compliance experience, preferably in **FMCG / Food Manufacturing / Retail / Hospitality**.
* Strong exposure to food manufacturing, factory compliance, labour laws and multi\-location compliance.
* Experience in managing regulatory authorities, audits and legal/compliance risks.

**5\. Experience \& Skills**

**Mandatory Experience**

* Food/FMCG/manufacturing compliance
* FSSAI compliance
* Factory compliance
* Labour law compliance
* Statutory licences and renewals
* Contract labour compliance
* Compliance audits
* Government liaison
* Legal Metrology
* Multi\-location compliance

**Key Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of Indian statutory and regulatory requirements
* Excellent documentation and record\-management skills
* Strong audit and inspection handling capability
* Strong follow\-up and closure orientation
* Excellent communication and drafting skills
* Ability to work independently with senior management
* Strong coordination with HR, Finance, Quality, Production, Operations and Procurement

He/She should be capable of visiting the **manufacturing units, DCs and other locations**, identifying compliance gaps on the ground, coordinating with department heads and ensuring corrective actions are implemented.

The person should also be comfortable interacting with **FSSAI, Labour Department, Factory Inspectorate, Legal Metrology, Fire Department, Pollution Control Board and other government authorities**.

Pay: From ₹130,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Collections Agent
description:
**Position:** Telecaller / Collections Executive  
**Department:** Collections

**Role Summary**

Responsible for calling clients and customers to follow up on pending payments, coordinating with the field recovery team to track case progress, and maintaining accurate records of all interactions and collections in Excel or the internal portal.

Key responsibilities

**Telecalling \& collections**

* Call customers/clients with overdue payments to remind, negotiate, and follow up on dues
* Explain payment terms, outstanding amounts, and settlement options clearly
* Collect payments over the phone (where applicable) or guide customers to payment channels
* Log every call outcome — promise to pay, dispute, no response, refusal, etc.

**Field team coordination**

* Liaise daily with field agents to share updated customer lists, addresses, and case notes
* Collect feedback from the field team on visit outcomes and customer responses
* Relay customer\-side information (change of address, disputes, payment promises) to field agents
* Escalate difficult or high\-value cases to the manager for further action

**Record keeping**

* Maintain daily/weekly Excel trackers of calls made, outcomes, and payments collected
* Update loan/customer records with payment status, dates, and amounts
* Reconcile collection entries against bank/portal records to avoid mismatches
* Prepare simple summary reports (calls made, amount collected, pending cases) for the manager

Requirements

* Prior experience in telecalling, collections, or customer service preferred
* Comfortable with basic Excel (data entry, sorting, simple formulas)
* Clear communication skills; polite but firm negotiation ability
* Patience to handle difficult or uncooperative customers
* Local language fluency \+ working Hindi/English as needed for the customer base

* Coordinate between Clients, Site Teams, Accounts, HR, Recruitment Agencies and Management.

* Prepare MIS reports, trackers and management updates.
* Handle multiple project requirements and ensure timely follow\-up.

**Preferred:**

Experience

title: Group Vice President Human Resources
description:
**GROUP VICE PRESIDENT** 

  
 




**HUMAN RESOURCES** 




*Enterprise People Leadership • Culture • Capability • Compliance* 




  





**About Star Worldwide Group** 




 Star Worldwide Group is an India\-headquartered integrated services group providing domestic and international relocation, global mobility, fine art and exhibition handling, specialized logistics, information and records management, storage and related technology\-enabled solutions. The Group serves corporate, institutional and individual customers through a network of offices in major Indian cities and global alliance partners.
 



 • Customer promise: precise execution, responsible custody, service consistency and a high\-quality experience across every customer touchpoint.
 



 • Operating context: a distributed, service\-intensive workforce spanning corporate functions, branch offices, warehouses, field operations and specialist handling teams.
 



 • Growth agenda: strengthen leadership depth, scalable systems, digital ways of working, compliance discipline and performance\-led culture.
 



 • Values emphasis: professionalism, integrity, customer centricity, innovation, quality, safety and responsible business practices.
 



  





**Leadership Mandate** 




 The Group Vice President – Human Resources will be the enterprise people leader for Star Worldwide Group. The role will translate business strategy into a practical people agenda, build leadership capability, strengthen organizational effectiveness and ensure reliable HR governance across entities and locations. This is a hands\-on leadership role requiring equal confidence in boardroom discussions and frontline operating environments.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities** 




**1\. Enterprise HR Strategy \& Governance** 




 • Create a three\-year people strategy and annual operating plan aligned to the Group’s business priorities, service model and growth ambitions.
 



 • Advise Board and business leadership on organization, talent, workforce cost, risk and change priorities.
 



 • Establish a clear HR governance rhythm covering workforce plans, talent, succession, employee relations, compliance, people, metrics and priority interventions.
 



 • Clarify HR operating roles across corporate HR, business leaders, branch teams and external partners; build a service\-oriented HR function with defined SLAs.
 



  





**2\. Organization Design, Workforce Planning \& Productivity** 




 • Lead organization design, role clarity, spans and layers review, manpower planning and workforce productivity initiatives across corporate and operating teams.
 



 • Create a disciplined position\-control and hiring\-approval process linked to budgets, capacity requirements and business cases.
 



 • Partner with Finance and business heads on workforce cost planning, deployment, overtime, contract labour governance and productivity improvement.
 



 • Ensure job architecture, job descriptions, grade structures and career paths are clear, consistent and scalable.
 



  





**3\. Leadership, Talent \& Succession** 




 • Build a leadership competency framework and use it for selection, assessment, development and succession decisions.
 



 • Run periodic talent reviews for critical roles, identify successors and develop evidence\-based individual development plans.
 



 • Coach senior leaders on team effectiveness, accountability, difficult conversations and change leadership.
 



 • Create capability academies for managers, frontline supervisors, customer\-facing teams and specialist operational roles.
 



  





**4\. Performance, Rewards \& PLI** 




 • Design and institutionalize a KRA/KPI\-based performance management system with role scorecards, goal calibration, mid\-year reviews and fair year\-end decisions.
 



 • Link Performance Linked Incentive plans to a balanced set of financial, customer, operational, people and compliance outcomes, with clear thresholds and governance.
 



 • Lead compensation benchmarking, annual increment and promotion cycles, internal equity reviews and recognition programmes within approved budgets.
 



 • Build manager capability to differentiate performance, document outcomes and provide constructive feedback.
 



  





**5\. Talent Acquisition, Employer Brand \& Retention** 




 • Own workforce acquisition strategy for leadership, specialist, corporate, branch and ground operations roles.
 



 • Improve hiring quality, speed, source effectiveness, candidate experience and joining conversion through measurable recruitment governance.
 



 • Build succession and talent pipelines for business\-critical and hard\-to\-fill roles; use structured selection and reference\-check practices.
 



 • Analyze regrettable attrition and early\-tenure exits; sponsor practical retention actions by role, location and talent segment.
 



  





**6\. Culture, Engagement \& Employee Relations** 




 • Define and embed leadership behaviours and workplace practices that reinforce accountability, collaboration, customer focus, safety and respect.
 



 • Establish credible listening channels, grievance redressal, disciplinary governance, whistleblowing coordination and employee communication routines.
 



 • Strengthen engagement for field and ground operations employees through visible leadership, supervisor capability and locally relevant interventions.
 



 • Lead sensitive employee relations matters with fairness, confidentiality, documentation and timely escalation.
 



  





**7\. Compliance, Industrial Relations, Safety \& POSH** 




 • Own the HR compliance framework across locations and entities, including applicable labour laws, registrations, licences, notices, registers, returns and inspections.
 



 • Ensure governance of wages, working hours, leave, contractor workforce, social security, provident fund, ESI, gratuity, maternity benefits and statutory records, as applicable.
 



 • Maintain effective POSH governance, including policy, Internal Committee support, awareness, reporting, confidentiality and timely case administration.
 



 • Partner with Operations and EHS on workforce safety, welfare, accident reporting, training and corrective actions; maintain audit\-ready evidence.
 



 • Monitor legislative changes and obtain specialist legal advice for complex matters. The role is accountable for governance, not a substitute for legal counsel.
 



  





**8\. HR Technology, Data \& Operating Excellence** 




 • Lead selection, implementation and adoption of an integrated HRIS covering employee master data, attendance, payroll interfaces, recruitment, performance, learning and analytics.
 



 • Establish data ownership, access controls, audit trails, document retention and privacy\-conscious people\-data practices.
 



 • Create a monthly people dashboard and convert workforce data into decisions, interventions and accountable follow\-through.
 



 • Simplify HR policies, SOPs and employee journeys while maintaining control, consistency and service quality.
 



  





**9\. Change, Integration \& Business Partnership** 




 • Lead the people workstream for expansion, restructuring, new locations, system rollouts, acquisitions or business integration, as applicable.
 



 • Build change plans covering stakeholder alignment, communication, capability, adoption, risk and benefit tracking.
 



 • Serve as a pragmatic business partner who challenges constructively, makes trade\-offs visible and follows decisions through to execution.
 



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 • Postgraduate qualification in Human Resources, Business Administration or related discipline.
 



 • Approximately 15\+ years of progressive HR experience, including 5–7\+ years leading an HR function or a substantial business HR portfolio.
 



 • Demonstrated experience with both white\-collar and blue\-collar / frontline workforces in a multi\-location, service\-intensive environment.
 



 • Strong command of organization design, workforce planning, performance and rewards, talent acquisition, leadership development, employee relations and HR operations.
 



 • Practical knowledge of Indian labour and employment compliance, PF, ESI, POSH, contractor governance and audit management.
 



 • Experience implementing HR technology and building reliable people analytics and governance routines.
 



 • Industry background in logistics, supply chain, transportation, services, retail, warehousing or manufacturing is preferred.
 



 • Executive presence, commercial acumen, high integrity, sound judgement and the ability to influence while remaining hands\-on.
 



  





**Role Relationships** 




**Reports to:** 
 Group leadership / designated executive sponsor
 



**Direct team:** 
 HR Manager and HR support team; structure to be reviewed by the incumbent
 



**Key stakeholders:** 
 Chairman, JMD, CFO, business and functional leaders, branch and operations heads, Finance, Legal, EHS, IT and external advisors
 



**Travel:** 
 Travel to operating locations may be required

**About HI Labs**

HI Labs is building serious, outcome\-focused technology education programs for students who want to become industry\-ready software engineers.

Our programs focus on **strong computer science fundamentals, practical software development, AI\-native engineering practices, real\-world projects, discipline, and internship readiness.**

We believe students should not just learn how to write code. They should understand **how and why software works**, develop strong problem\-solving skills, and learn how to approach problems like engineers.

We are looking for a **Software Mentor/Faculty Trainee** who is passionate about software development, enjoys helping others learn, and wants to develop strong skills in both **software engineering and technical mentoring**.

As a Software Mentor Trainee, you will work with students and the academic team to help learners understand programming, computer science fundamentals, software development concepts, assignments, and projects.

This is **not a traditional coding trainer role**. You will be expected to understand concepts deeply and gradually learn how to explain them clearly, guide students through problems, review their work, and connect theoretical concepts with practical software development.

This role is particularly suitable for **fresh graduates, recent graduates, developers with 0–2 years of experience, and candidates with strong technical fundamentals who are interested in teaching or mentoring.**

**Key Areas You May Work With**

Depending on your skills and program requirements, you may work on the following areas:

**Programming \& Problem Solving**

* Programming fundamentals
* Logic building
* Problem\-solving techniques

* Basic algorithmic thinking
* Programming exercises

**Computer Science Fundamentals**

* Data Structures \& Algorithms
* Database Management Systems
* SQL fundamentals
* PostgreSQL basics
* Operating Systems fundamentals
* Computer Networks basics
* Software Engineering principles

**Software Development**

* JavaScript / TypeScript fundamentals
* Backend development basics
* APIs and request\-response concepts
* Node.js / Express.js
* MERN stack fundamentals
* Git and GitHub
* Clean code and project structure
* Real\-world software development workflows

**AI\-Native Development**

* Responsible use of AI tools in software development
* AI\-assisted debugging
* Using AI for development workflows
* Effective prompting for coding tasks
* Understanding when AI can be used and when strong fundamentals are required

**Key Responsibilities**

As a Software Mentor Trainee, you will:

* Assist in conducting technical learning sessions for students.
* Explain programming and computer science concepts using simple examples.
* Conduct doubt\-clearing sessions under the guidance of the academic team.
* Help students with assignments, exercises, and programming problems.
* Review student code and provide constructive feedback.
* Help students identify and fix errors in their code.
* Guide students through small software development projects.
* Assist students in understanding programming concepts and development workflows.
* Prepare basic exercises, assignments, and revision materials.
* Track student progress and identify areas where additional support is required.
* Maintain session notes and basic learning documentation.
* Collaborate with the academic team to improve learning materials.
* Gradually take ownership of selected topics or modules based on your performance and technical ability.
* Encourage students to develop strong fundamentals, problem\-solving ability, discipline, and an engineering mindset.

**Educational QualificationsPreferred Qualifications**

* B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
* M.Tech / M.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
* MCA

Candidates from other educational backgrounds may also be considered if they demonstrate **strong programming fundamentals and genuine interest in software development and mentoring.**

**Experience**

**Experience Required: 0–2 Years**

We welcome:

* Freshers and recent graduates
* Candidates with 0–2 years of software development experience
* Candidates with internship experience
* Candidates with teaching, tutoring, or mentoring experience
* Candidates who have helped peers or juniors learn technical concepts
* Candidates with strong academic or personal software projects

**Prior teaching or mentoring experience is not mandatory.**

For this role, we value **technical fundamentals, communication ability, problem\-solving skills, and willingness to learn** more than years of experience.

**Required Skills**

* Strong programming fundamentals
* Basic understanding of Data Structures and Algorithms
* Basic SQL and database knowledge
* Basic understanding of software development
* Good problem\-solving ability
* Ability to explain technical concepts clearly
* Good verbal and written communication skills
* Patience when working with beginners
* Basic Git / GitHub knowledge
* Willingness to learn new technologies
* Ability to work collaboratively with students and the academic team

**Good to Have**

Knowledge or experience with any of the following will be an advantage:

* JavaScript
* TypeScript
* Node.js
* Express.js
* React
* MongoDB
* PostgreSQL
* Git / GitHub
* Real\-world software projects
* Technical tutoring or mentoring
* Code review
* AI development tools

**You do not need to know everything listed above.** Strong fundamentals and the ability to learn are more important.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

You may be a strong fit for this role if you:

* Enjoy explaining technical concepts to others.
* Can explain **why** something works, not just how to implement it.
* Have strong programming fundamentals.
* Can break complex concepts into simple steps.
* Enjoy solving programming and technical problems.
* Are patient when working with beginners.

* Are unwilling to work on\-site.
* Are uncomfortable communicating with students.

**What You Will Gain**

During the internship, you will get exposure to:

 The role will be responsible for designing, developing, and executing scalable automation solutions across complex enterprise applications, CRM platforms, mobile applications, APIs, integrations, and data pipelines.
   

  

 The successful candidate will play a key role in increasing automation coverage, reducing manual regression effort, accelerating release validation, and improving overall product quality. The engineer will also leverage AI\-assisted testing capabilities to improve test design, automation development, test\-data generation, defect analysis, and QA productivity.
   

  

 This role requires strong hands\-on technical capability along with ownership of QA processes including test strategy, test planning, automation framework development, defect management, regression testing, and continuous quality improvement.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with Developers, QA, Product, Data Engineering, DevOps, and business stakeholders to define and implement end\-to\-end test strategies, test plans, test cases, test data, traceability, regression planning, release validation, and quality improvements across CRM Salesforce/Veeva, mobile/iPad, API, integration, data validation, and data migration scenarios.
* Perform manual and automated validation of data pipelines across structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data, including source\-to\-target mapping, transformation logic, business\-rule verification, schema checks, record\-count reconciliation, null/duplicate checks, referential integrity, thresholds, anomaly detection, ingestion, transformation, delivery, consumption, and migration\-quality validation.
* Design, develop, maintain, and execute reusable automation frameworks, automated regression suites, and data\-validation scripts using tools and technologies such as Selenium, Copado Robotic Testing, COFTA, Microsoft Playwright, PyTest, Postman/Newman, Python, PySpark, and equivalent frameworks for CRM, web, mobile/iPad, API, integration, batch, real\-time, and data testing.

* Automate API and integration testing across middleware, CRM, cloud platforms, data platforms, and upstream/downstream systems, covering request/response validation, authentication, payloads, business rules, error handling, negative scenarios, retries, and batch or real\-time integration failures.

* Practical experience with manual validation of data pipelines and source\-to\-target testing.

* Strong understanding of test planning, defect tracking, bug lifecycle management, and QA documentation.

* Knowledge of test case and defect management tools (e.g., JIRA, TestRail, Zephyr).
* Strong understanding of QA methodologies, test planning, test case design, and defect lifecycle management.
* Deep hands\-on expertise in SQL, Python, and PySpark for testing and automating validation.
* Proven experience in manual and automated testing of batch and real\-time data pipelines.
* Familiarity with data processing and analytics stacks: Databricks, Spark, AWS (Glue, S3, Athena, Redshift).
* Experience with bug tracking and test management tools like JIRA, TestRail, or Zephyr.
* Ability to troubleshoot data issues independently and collaborate with engineering for root cause analysis.

* Strong ability to validate and automate data quality checks: schema validation, null checks, duplicates, thresholds, and transformation validation

Job Description – App Tester / Bug Testing Executive

**Company/App:** ZoraMeeto  
**Position:** App Tester / Bug Testing Executive  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time / Part\-Time  
**Work Mode:** Remote / Work From Home  
**Experience:** Fresher \& Experienced Both Can Apply

Job Summary

We are looking for responsible and detail\-oriented individuals to help us **test the App, identify bugs, report technical issues, and provide user feedback**.

The selected candidate will use the app regularly, test different features and user flows, identify any errors or issues, and communicate with **2–4 users every day** to understand their experience and collect feedback.

Key Responsibilities

* Regularly use and test the App.
* Test different features, screens, buttons, registration/login processes, profiles, chat, notifications, and other app functions.
* Identify bugs, errors, crashes, broken links, UI/UX issues, and unexpected behavior.
* Record and report bugs with proper details, screenshots, screen recordings, or other relevant information.
* Test the app on different devices and internet conditions wherever possible.
* Communicate with **2–4 users daily** and guide them through basic app testing.
* Collect feedback from users regarding their experience, usability, and difficulties.
* Report user feedback and recurring issues to the concerned team.
* Re\-test bugs after they have been fixed and confirm whether the issue has been resolved.
* Maintain a daily testing and activity report.
* Maintain confidentiality of app\-related information and user data.

Daily Activities

The candidate will generally be expected to:

**1\. App Testing:**  
Test the assigned features and identify bugs or usability problems.

**2\. User Interaction:**  
Speak with **2–4 users per day** to help them test the application and collect genuine feedback.

**3\. Bug Reporting:**  
Document issues clearly with steps to reproduce, screenshots/videos, device details, and expected vs. actual results.

**4\. Feedback Reporting:**  
Share user suggestions, complaints, and improvement points with the team.

Required Skills

* Basic understanding of mobile applications.
* Good observation and attention to detail.
* Good communication skills.
* Ability to clearly explain and report problems.
* Comfortable speaking with 2–4 people daily.
* Basic knowledge of smartphones and internet applications.
* Ability to maintain daily reports.
* Patient and responsible approach toward testing.
* Knowledge of bug\-reporting tools will be an advantage.

Eligibility

* 12th Pass / Graduate.
* Freshers are welcome.
* Candidates with experience in **App Testing, QA, Customer Support, Telecalling, User Testing, or Technical Support** will be preferred.
* Must have an Android/iOS smartphone and a stable internet connection.

Performance Metrics (KPIs)

* Number of app features tested.
* Quality and accuracy of bug reports.
* Number of users contacted/tested daily.
* Quality of user feedback collected.
* Timely submission of testing reports.
* Successful verification of resolved bugs.

Important Note

This role is **not limited to telecalling**. The primary responsibility is **app testing and bug identification**, while daily interaction with 2–4 users is required for real\-user testing and feedback collection.

**If you are observant, comfortable using mobile apps, and enjoy finding problems and helping improve products, this role is a good opportunity for you.**

title: Engineering & Infrastructure Associate
description:
Every clever product still needs somewhere solid to run. This role owns that ground — servers, security, and everything that has to work at 3 a.m. without anyone noticing.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Set up and manage servers, hosting, VPS environments, domains, and development environments.
* Implement security, load balancing, and service/microservice infrastructure.
* Run penetration testing and harden systems against real\-world threats.
* Manage backups, remote systems, network development, and display/integration technologies.


 What You Bring
   

  

* Genuine expertise across Linux, UNIX, macOS, and Windows, with strong CLI and remote\-systems fluency.
* Solid understanding of networking, security, and load\-balanced/microservice architecture.
* Practical experience with penetration testing or security hardening.
* For tier\-1 engineering graduates especially: depth over breadth — you understand why systems fail, not just how to restart them.


**Bonus Points:** 
*Experience securing infrastructure for a live production product, not just personal projects.*
 For all positions: we’re looking for people who learn quickly, adapt to new and emerging technologies, and want to help build the future of advertising technology. This is an office\-based role in South Delhi — we value genuine enthusiasm for working from office, tinkering with LLMs, AI, programmatic, ad insertion, and even gaming, inside a startup\-style, operationally flexible environment. Hard work and a real focus on building a long\-term career in ad\-tech software development matter more to us than a polished résumé.
   

  

*Disclaimer: due to the large volume of applications received, we are only able to respond to successful candidates.*
 On the Early\-Career Program
   

  

 Programmatic ad\-tech is an exceptionally niche industry, and very few schools or workplaces truly expose people to its technical, operational, or business realities — especially combined with emerging interactive and immersive advertising experiences. Because of this, we understand that strong candidates may come from lateral career shifts or seemingly unrelated backgrounds. While we review every application for relevant experience and education, résumés alone rarely reveal curiosity, systems thinking, adaptability, or genuine interest in the industry.
   

  

 Established players in this space rarely let experienced talent circulate freely, and we recognize the challenge of building in such a rare ecosystem while bootstrapping. We encourage applicants to research the industry before applying, avoid applying blindly, and tell us why this space excites you — especially if you’re willing to pursue an early\-career journey of learning, exploration, and growth while transitioning from another field.
   

  

 Application Requirements
   

  

* A completed application form, including your resume.
* Essay 1 — Statement of Purpose: why Blowtrumpet is for you, why you want to be part of ad\-tech, and how ad\-tech differs from other industries (e.g. ed\-tech) in ways that interest you.
* Essay 2 — Your Workflow in the Emerging Technologies Age: your view on AI and where it’s heading, how you’re incorporating AI into your workflow today, and real examples of difficulties you’ve faced and how you resolved them.
* Essay 3 — Gamification: what gamification means to you, a real\-life example, what the gamification loop looks like, and how you’d apply it to create an engaging experience for friends, family, or coworkers.


 You may use AI tools to help write these essays.
 **If you do, disclose which tools you used, your prompts and guidance, and confirm your agreement with the output. If you choose not to use AI, tell us that too.**
 Optional Guiding Questions
   

  

 You’re welcome to draw on any of the following while writing your three essays — they’re prompts, not a separate form to fill out line by line.
   

  

* 1\. Provide us with your present PIN Code. We won’t be processing applications without a valid PIN Code and address location. You’re encouraged to join our Discord server, “Hire For Work” (linked in the website footer) — introduce yourself and interact there; it goes a long way for our assessment and lets us connect with you in real time. Also define, in your own words, the difference between ed\-tech and ad\-tech.
* 2\. Name 5 ed\-tech platforms you find useful. What did you like about them, who is their target audience, and how do they help you? What skills have you developed through ed\-tech?
* 3\. Name 5 ad\-tech platforms you find useful. What did you like about them, who is their target audience, and how do they help you?
* 4\. Why is ad\-tech for you?
* 5\. Why do you want to work with a startup? Talk about one area of expertise you feel will add value to our products, and the clients or industry it serves.
* 6\. We also hire for our legacy services business. Would you like your application considered for a client\-facing, incentive/ROI\-driven role in advertising services? How would you add value to that practice, which role would you prefer for your career progression, and for which clients or sector?
* 7\. Why do you use AI? How do you envision AI being used in the years to come? Talk about a recent development in AI — is it close to the ad\-tech or fin\-tech industries?
* 8\. Do you feel knowledge of fin\-tech systems is useful for product development in ad\-tech? What are the advantages of AI in building or managing a fin\-tech environment?
* 9\. How do you keep up with the latest innovations? Name 5 websites you consult for staying updated, learning new skills, or troubleshooting.
* 10\. Describe your troubleshooting workflow.
* 11\. Are you a gamer? Which games have you played? How often, when, and with what objective?
* 12\. Are you a streamer / content creator? What software and platforms do you use? Share your channel details and your content development/management workflow.
* 13\. What do you understand by gamification? Create a sample gamification loop for an ad\-tech environment that you feel would be useful for the industry — mention the checkpoints, endpoints, rewards, and your approach to quantifying them.
* 14\. Share a real\-world example of gamification you’ve practiced with friends, family, or coworkers.
* 15\. Write a clear statement of purpose to complete your application. How does Blowtrumpet fit with your aspirations, and what would you like to achieve? Discuss your plans for the next 3–5 years.


 Status \& Contact
   

  

 We make a sincere effort to respond early to fully completed applications. Because of application volume, we’re sometimes only able to respond to shortlisted candidates. You can check on your application status by writing to hr@blowtrumpet.com.
   

  

*Disclaimer: due to the large volume of applications received, we are only able to respond to successful candidates.*

**Summary**
 Seeking a highly motivated Cloud IAM Engineer with 3\-5 years of hands\-on experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM) across public cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure (Entra ID), AWS, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, automating, and supporting cloud\-native identity and access management services, ensuring secure access to cloud resources while maintaining compliance with enterprise security standards.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, implement, and support IAM solutions across Azure, AWS, and GCP environments.
* Manage Microsoft Entra ID, AWS IAM, IAM Identity Center, and GCP IAM services.
* Implement and maintain RBAC, ABAC, least privilege, and privileged access controls.
* Configure and manage Conditional Access policies, Identity Protection, and Zero Trust controls.
* Deploy and support MFA, passwordless authentication, and adaptive authentication solutions.
* Integrate enterprise and cloud applications using SAML, OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and SCIM.
* Manage service principals, managed identities, workload identities, and non\-human accounts.
* Automate IAM processes using PowerShell, Python, REST APIs, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools.
* Collaborate with Cloud Security and DevOps teams to integrate IAM controls into CI/CD pipelines.
* Perform access reviews, entitlement governance, and policy compliance activities.
* Monitor cloud identity risks and remediate excessive permissions and security findings.
* Support security audits, compliance requirements, and identity governance initiatives.
* Develop technical documentation, standards, and operational runbooks.


**Required Skills**
* 3\-5 years of hands\-on experience in Cloud IAM, Identity Security, or Access Management.
* Strong experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), AWS IAM, and GCP IAM.
* Expertise in RBAC, ABAC, entitlement management, and least privilege access models.
* Experience implementing Conditional Access, MFA, Identity Protection, and Zero Trust controls.
* Strong understanding of SAML, OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and SCIM.
* Experience with service accounts, service principals, managed identities, and workload identities.
* Proficiency in PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar scripting languages.
* Experience with Terraform, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices.
* Knowledge of cloud security best practices and compliance frameworks.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

 Yes, 10% of the Time

 No

title: Assistant Manager
description:
**Job Description:**


**About Us**


At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

  

  

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.  



  

We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.  



  

Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.  



  

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!


**Global Business Services**


Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.


Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.


In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.


**Process Overview**


***FEO***


**ARQ** supports global businesses of the Bank with solutions requiring judgment application, sound business understanding and analytical perspective. We support onshore teams in the areas of Financial Research \& Analysis, Quantitative Modeling, Risk Management and Prospecting Support provide solutions for revenue enhancement, risk mitigation and cost optimization. The division comprising of highly qualified associates operates from four locations i.e. Mumbai, Gurgaon, Hyderabad and GIFT.


Individual will be closely working with teams across Consumer and Small Business Card portfolios, Digital Analytics, Consumer Credit Strategies team providing qualitative and quantitative analytical support to Consumer Credit Borrowing Strategies team on the state side.


**GWIM Analytics and Reporting team**, will be involved in designing, running and maintaining daily, weekly and monthly dashboards and provide meaningful insights on current business trends. The incumbent will be required to liaise with onshore partners across global locations on a regular basis to understand the requirements, get fresh reporting requirement, and provide clarifications, among other things.


*The Consumer Client Protection Organization includes fraud strategies \& analytics, fraud detection operations (FDO), and consumer \& small business claims operations (C\&SBCO) working together to detect risks, prevent fraud and safeguard our customers. FDO protects against fraud \& scams while C\&SBCO resolves fraud claims and billing disputes for consumer, commercial, and small business accounts.*


**Fraud detection** team reviews potentially fraudulent transactions exceptioned out by the fraud filters and decisions them basis judgmental review for products like New Accounts, Checks, Deposits \& Online. The team also provides fraud support through activities like closure fulfillment of deposit accounts \& loss allocation as well as specialized fraud work like defect analysis, secondary closure review and hold audit.


**C\&SBC** is responsible for the research and timely resolution of fraud claims , billing disputes \& Payment queries on consumer, commercial and small business credit/debit card account. The key actions involves processing Chargeback to recover money from merchant, accepting or denying merchant response on chargeback processed and various other exception actions like providing provisional credit, Fraud reporting and merchant Credit adjustment.


**Responsibilities**


* Develop and enhance sophisticated analytical systems that support enterprise\-wide banking strategies, including credit risk, fraud analytics, customer segmentation, and operational efficiency.
* Research, extract, and integrate datasets from multiple banking data warehouses and source systems (e.g., loan servicing systems, card platforms, deposits, risk engines).
* Collaborate with cross\-functional partners—Risk, Finance, Technology, Compliance, and Product—to convert business requirements into analytical deliverables.
* Conduct end\-to\-end data management activities, including data collection, validation, profiling, transformation, and quality assurance for critical banking datasets.
* Design, build, and automate executive dashboards and reports using BI tools, applying statistical techniques to highlight portfolio performance and emerging risk trends.
* Perform deep\-dive portfolio analysis on credit behavior, delinquency trends, loss forecasting, segmentation, and operational bottlenecks to drive strategic recommendations.
* Support the development, optimization, and tuning of ETL pipelines, production jobs, and analytical processes across the risk and operations lifecycle.
* Contribute to risk modeling initiatives including PD/LGD/EAD calculations, early warning indicators, stress testing, and model monitoring while adhering to regulatory and governance standards.
* Critically assess and challenge models on conceptual soundness, assumptions and limitations, data, developmental evidence in support of modeling choices, performance, implementation, and documentation.
* Implement model governance for various lines of businesses that involves monitoring model performance and identifying plans to mitigate performance issues.
* Understand the core methodology in AI solutions and the context in which it will be deployed to identify potential risks/gaps.
* Build predictive models and machine\-learning based models as needed and propose solutions and strategies to tackle business challenges.

**Requirements**


**Education:** MBA/ PGDM / Maters in Economics / Quantitative Technique \& Economics/ Mathematics Statistics/ Data Sciences


**Certification if any**\- NA


**Experience Range**\- Fresher / 0 years


**Foundational Skills**


* Knowledge about interfacing models with software applications for enhancing usability
* Knowledge of factor models and machine learning will be preferred, Business process skills,
* Analytical problem solving, Technical skills (MS Office: Excel \& PowerPoint), Communication skills

**Good to have skills**


* Banking industry knowledge/ background would be an added advantage

**GCIB Coverage team** is made up of focused industry / product groups or geography groups that support onshore deal teams orchestrate capital raising and strategic advisory transactions.


Specifically, the team helps Global Investment Bankers of Bank of America Merrill Lynch in their business origination and client coverage efforts through building of client pitchbooks and supporting business analysis.


**Client Services \-** An associate working for the process would be expected to not only look for the company/industry information from the published reports but also be able to analyze and understand which data points and financial metrics are important for a particular industry. The candidate should be able to convert factual information into a highly analytical and incisive presentation. GMC also coordinates engagement with key control partners including Global Risk, Legal / Documentation, Onboarding teams, Collateral management, Credit Review and Audit in accordance with the Risk Framework and Internal and External standards. **About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**  


The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.

**Job Purpose:**  


To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.

 **Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations*** Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence*** Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management*** Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance*** Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security*** Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility*** Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation*** Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration*** Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.

**Qualifications \& Experience:**  

**Education**:* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:*** Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**

* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:*** Customer Focus

* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork

* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance

Here’s what makes us stand out:

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

**Role Overview**

The Junior Academic Counsellor plays a key role in guiding prospective students toward the right deep\-tech career pathways at Technovalley. The role involves student counselling, program explanation, admissions support, and maintaining high levels of student satisfaction across our five technology stacks.

The candidate must possess strong communication skills, fundamental technical understanding, and a passion for helping students build global\-standard careers.

**Key Responsibilities1\. Student Counselling \& Guidance**

* Provide accurate information on all Technovalley programs—Cybersecurity, AI/ML, Data Science, Cloud, Full\-Stack Development, etc.
* Identify students’ educational background, interests, and career goals to recommend suitable programs.
* Conduct one\-to\-one career counselling sessions via phone, WhatsApp, email, or walk\-ins.

**2\. Admissions Support**

* Follow up with enquiries, nurture leads, and convert them into admissions.
* Assist prospective learners with application processes, fee details, scholarship eligibility, and batch selection.
* Maintain a detailed record of all leads, follow\-ups, and conversions on CRM systems.

**3\. Communication \& Coordination**

* Collaborate closely with the admissions team, academic operations, and marketing department.
* Provide timely updates to senior counsellors and reporting managers.
* Clarify student concerns related to schedules, program structure, certifications, and assessments.

**4\. Documentation \& Reporting**

* Maintain accurate daily logs of counselling activities.
* Update student details, enquiry status, and performance metrics as required.
* Prepare weekly reports on counselling outcomes and targets achieved.

**5\. Quality \& Student Satisfaction**

* Ensure every prospective student receives a warm, professional, and supportive experience.
* Uphold Technovalley’s standards as the most trusted destination for deep\-tech upskilling.
* Address initial academic queries and escalate complex concerns to senior team members.

**Required Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong communication skills in English and Malayalam.
* Good technical understanding of IT concepts (basic level).
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
* Ability to understand student needs and map them to suitable courses.
* Goal\-oriented with the ability to meet weekly and monthly admissions targets.
* Professional attitude, discipline, and commitment to organisational values.

**Work Environment**

* Location: Technovalley Headquarters, Kochi
* Work Mode: On\-site
* Reporting To: Senior Academic Counsellor / Admissions Manager
* Attractive performance incentives based on conversions and student satisfaction

* Work with Kerala’s leading deep\-tech education and consulting organisation
* Exposure to 21 global technology partnerships
* Opportunity for rapid career growth in academic counselling and education management
* Comprehensive training on all technology stacks and compliance standards

**Company:** Rorko India Private Limited

**Qualification:** MBA/PGDM in Marketing or Sales preferred  
About the Role  
Rorko India is looking for a confident and organised Sales \& Marketing Executive to support and gradually take ownership of our sales and marketing activities.  
You will interact with prospects and clients, manage outreach campaigns, coordinate meetings, maintain the CRM and ensure every opportunity is followed up properly. You will also support marketing programs designed to generate qualified meetings for Rorko’s technology services.  
This role is suitable for an MBA fresher who understands the fundamentals of sales and marketing, communicates professionally and wants to build a career in B2B technology sales.  
Key Responsibilities

* Learn and clearly communicate Rorko’s technology services and capabilities.
* Research target companies, industries and decision\-makers.
* Build and maintain qualified prospect lists.
* Conduct sales outreach through email, LinkedIn, telephone and other relevant channels.
* Write clear, personalised outreach emails and follow\-up messages.
* Schedule client and prospect meetings, send invitations and manage calendars.
* Prepare meeting agendas and record minutes, requirements and next actions.
* Participate in discovery calls, presentations and client meetings.
* Coordinate internally for proposals, presentations, case studies and follow\-ups.
* Maintain accurate lead, contact, company and opportunity information in the CRM.
* Track every conversation, follow\-up date, task and sales\-pipeline movement.
* Plan and execute marketing campaigns focused on generating qualified meetings.
* Support webinars, email campaigns, LinkedIn activities, partnerships and other lead\-generation programs.
* Coordinate the preparation of sales collateral and marketing content.
* Follow up consistently with prospects without becoming repetitive or spam\-oriented.
* Support existing client communication and coordination when required.
* Prepare weekly reports covering outreach, responses, meetings, opportunities and pending actions.
* Ensure that no active lead or client requirement is missed.

What We Are Looking For

* MBA or PGDM in Marketing, Sales or a related specialisation is preferred.
* Fresh graduates with relevant internships or practical project experience are encouraged to apply.
* Good understanding of marketing, sales funnels and customer journeys.
* Strong spoken and written English.
* Confidence speaking with clients and senior decision\-makers.
* Ability to write professional emails and manage business communication.
* Good working knowledge of email, calendars, online meetings and presentation tools.
* Familiarity with CRM platforms or a strong willingness to learn.
* Comfortable using Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for tracking and reporting.
* Strong follow\-up discipline, attention to detail and organisational ability.
* Ability to understand business requirements and coordinate with internal teams.
* Curiosity about technology, software and digital solutions.
* Ability to work independently after initial training and guidance.

Coding or a technical degree is not required. However, you must be willing to learn how websites, mobile applications, custom software, cloud and AI solutions create business value.  
This Role Is Not Suitable If

* You are uncomfortable initiating conversations with new prospects.
* You avoid calls, meetings or follow\-ups.
* You are interested only in social media or creative marketing.
* You need repeated reminders to update tasks and CRM records.
* You send generic bulk messages without researching the prospect.
* You are unwilling to learn about technology services and consultative selling.

How Success Will Be Measured

* Number and quality of qualified meetings generated.
* Consistency and quality of sales outreach.
* Timeliness of follow\-ups and next actions.
* Accuracy and completeness of CRM records.
* Movement of leads through the sales pipeline.
* Quality of client communication and meeting coordination.
* Execution and results of marketing programs.
* Ability to gradually manage sales activities with less supervision.

Working Expectations  
The role is primarily based at our Bengaluru office. Because Rorko works with international prospects and clients, occasional calls outside normal Indian business hours may be required with advance planning.  
Application Process  
Please apply with your résumé and include a short response covering:

* Why you want to build a career in B2B technology sales and marketing.
* Any internship, academic project or practical experience involving sales, marketing or client interaction.
* Your current location and availability to join.

Shortlisted candidates will complete a qualification questionnaire followed by an interview and practical communication assessment.
