title: CloudOps Engineer (L3)
description:
**Job Purpose** 




 Frontline Infrastructure Support Engineer (L3\) serves as the Senior technical support for enterprise infrastructure, providing expert\-level administration, troubleshooting, architecture guidance, and technical leadership across complex IT environments. The role is responsible for resolving critical infrastructure issues, driving automation, implementing infrastructure improvements, supporting strategic initiatives, and ensuring the reliability, scalability, security, and performance of enterprise platforms.
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities** 




**Infrastructure Architecture \& Engineering** 



* Design, implement, administer, and optimize enterprise infrastructure across Windows, Linux, virtualization, Kubernetes, storage, backup, cloud, and GPU platforms.
* Define technical standards, best practices, and operational procedures to improve infrastructure reliability and scalability.



**Advanced Incident \& Problem Management** 



* Lead the resolution of complex and business\-critical infrastructure incidents.
* Perform detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA), incident chronology and implement permanent corrective and preventive actions.
* Provide technical leadership during Major Incident Management and disaster recovery scenarios.
* Act as the highest escalation point for L1 and L2 support teams.



**Windows \& Active Directory Engineering** 



* Design and administer enterprise Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, Certificate Services, Federation Services, and Windows Server environments.
* Lead server lifecycle management, security hardening, patch strategy, and performance optimization.



**Linux Platform Engineering** 



* Administer enterprise Linux platforms, including kernel tuning, automation, clustering, security hardening, high availability, and performance optimization.
* Troubleshoot complex OS, application, and platform\-related issues.



**Virtualization \& Container Platform Engineering** 



* Design, administer, and optimize VMware, Hyper\-V, and Kubernetes/OpenShift environments.
* Manage cluster architecture, capacity planning, workload optimization, upgrades, and platform lifecycle management.



**Storage, Backup \& Disaster Recovery** 



* Design and administer enterprise storage and backup solutions.
* Lead disaster recovery planning, backup architecture, replication, capacity planning, and business continuity initiatives.



**Cloud Infrastructure** 



* Support Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud infrastructure, hybrid networking, and cloud platform administration.



**GPU \& AI Infrastructure** 



* Design, administer, and optimize GPU infrastructure supporting AI, Machine Learning, and High\-Performance Computing (HPC) workloads.
* Manage GPU resource allocation, driver lifecycle, firmware updates, monitoring, and performance optimization.



**Automation \& Infrastructure as Code** 



* Develop infrastructure automation using PowerShell, Bash, Python, Ansible, Terraform, or similar technologies.
* Drive Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC), configuration management, and operational automation initiatives.



**Change, Release \& Capacity Management** 



* Review and implement complex infrastructure changes.
* Lead infrastructure upgrades, migrations, platform refresh, and technology transformation projects.
* Perform capacity planning and infrastructure performance optimization.



**Technical Leadership** 



* Mentor L1 and L2 engineers through technical guidance and knowledge sharing.
* Develop technical standards, runbooks, SOPs, and operational documentation.
* Collaborate with architects, engineering teams, OEMs, and vendors on strategic initiatives.



  





**Experience \& Educational Requirement** 




 BE/B\-Tech or equivalent with Computer Science or Electronics \& Communication
 



  





**RELEVANT EXPERIENCE** 



* 6 to 10\+ years in Enterprise Infrastructure Engineering, Managed Services, Data Center Operations, Cloud Infrastructure, or Platform Engineering.
* Proven experience supporting business\-critical production environments with 24×7 operations.
* Hands\-on experience with enterprise monitoring tools (SolarWinds, SCOM, Zabbix, Nagios, PRTG, Prometheus, Grafana) and ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow, ManageEngine, BMC Remedy, or Jira Service Management. Expertise in virtualization (VMware, Hyper\-V, Kubernetes, OpenShift), enterprise storage, backup solutions, and hybrid cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP). Strong exposure to GPU infrastructure for AI/ML and HPC workloads, Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform, Ansible), container platforms, CI/CD pipelines, and enterprise security technologies.

 On the Early\-Career Program
   

  

 Programmatic ad\-tech is an exceptionally niche industry, and very few schools or workplaces truly expose people to its technical, operational, or business realities — especially combined with emerging interactive and immersive advertising experiences. Because of this, we understand that strong candidates may come from lateral career shifts or seemingly unrelated backgrounds. While we review every application for relevant experience and education, résumés alone rarely reveal curiosity, systems thinking, adaptability, or genuine interest in the industry.
   

  

 Established players in this space rarely let experienced talent circulate freely, and we recognize the challenge of building in such a rare ecosystem while bootstrapping. We encourage applicants to research the industry before applying, avoid applying blindly, and tell us why this space excites you — especially if you’re willing to pursue an early\-career journey of learning, exploration, and growth while transitioning from another field.

title: Junior Instructional Designer
description:
Hexr Factory is a next\-generation immersive technology company and an Unreal Engine Authorized Service Partner, creating real\-time 3D, interactive, visualisation and digital\-learning experiences for global clients.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for two Junior Instructional Designers to convert client\-supplied scripts, lesson briefs and storyboards into clear, structured production plans for 3D animation and video content. This role sits at the intersection of learning design and creative production. You will help make sure that a concept is instructionally sound, visually expressible and ready for storyboard, asset, animation, voice\-over, edit and final\-video teams.
   

  

 This is not a conventional content\-QA role. Quality review is part of the work, but the primary responsibility is to interpret, develop and structure source material before and during production.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Study client scripts, storyboards, learning objectives and content briefs to understand the intended concept, audience and learning outcome.
* Break content into a practical lesson, segment, scene and shot structure for 3D animation and video production.
* Convert abstract concepts into visual actions, demonstrations, character behaviour, backgrounds, props, on\-screen text, transitions and camera requirements.
* Develop and maintain script\-to\-storyboard mappings, scene breakdowns, shot lists, asset lists, VO cues, subtitle cues and production notes.
* Restructure content when the sequence is unclear, too dense, repetitive or difficult to represent visually, while preserving the client’s intent and documenting open decisions.
* Prepare clear handoffs for storyboard, 3D, Unreal, animation, voice\-over, editing and post\-production teams.
* Identify character, prop, environment, animation, camera, timing and continuity requirements before production begins.
* Work with client\-facing teams and subject\-matter experts to clarify content, references, terminology and expected outcomes.
* Participate in pre\-production reviews, animatic reviews, WIP reviews and final\-video reviews.
* Check that narration, visuals, animation, on\-screen text, subtitles and pacing work together to communicate the intended concept.
* Provide concise, actionable feedback with scene, shot or timestamp references and follow through until important issues are closed.
* Maintain version records, review trackers, feedback logs, approvals and handover documentation.
* Convert recurring production or content issues into practical guidelines, examples, templates and checklists.
* Coordinate with writers, storyboard artists, 3D artists, animators, video editors, voice\-over teams, project coordinators and production leads.
* Flag blockers, dependencies, scope questions and delivery risks early, and support the team in meeting agreed deadlines.
* Handle client, project and learner content with discretion and confidentiality.


**Required Skills**
* Basic understanding of instructional design, learning objectives, learner\-centred content and educational storytelling.
* Ability to read, interpret and improve scripts and storyboards for clarity, sequence, pacing and visual communication.
* Ability to structure content into scenes, shots, actions, assets and production\-ready notes.
* Basic understanding of 3D animation, video production or creative\-production workflows.
* Strong written communication, documentation and attention to detail.
* Mandatory ability to read, write and review Hindi accurately, along with strong working proficiency in English.
* Ability to communicate clearly with creative, technical, client\-facing and project teams.
* Working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets, PowerPoint or Google Slides and document/review tools.
* Ability to manage multiple content packages, review cycles and deadlines.
* Openness to feedback, learning new tools and working in a structured production environment.


**Preferred Experience**
* 0–2 years of experience, including internships, academic projects or freelance work, in instructional design, educational content, content writing, animation, storyboarding, video production or digital learning.
* Experience developing or reviewing scripts, storyboards, animatics, videos, digital lessons, VO, subtitles or interactive content.
* Exposure to 3D, animation, VFX, Unreal Engine, video editing, motion graphics or e\-learning authoring tools is an advantage.
* A portfolio or sample showing instructional writing, educational content, storyboard structuring, visual breakdowns or production documentation.
* A degree or equivalent practical experience in instructional design, education, animation, media, communication, English or a related field.
